%% The atoms of the contract at their argument types: a machine state is a list of them, in the view the agent writes, Output ::= view(List(Atom), List(Key), List(Approved)), and the agent writes each atom it holds, g(Name, Vals), as atom_of gives it (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation"); the day, today(d), is no atom of the machine state the view shows (Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications").
Atom ::=

;
knows(Peer)
;
friend(Peer)
;
received(Speech, Peer)
;
member(CName)
;
listed(Peer, Speech)
;
closed(Speech)
;

;
delivered(Speech, Peer, Speech)
;
received_in(Speech, Peer, Speech)

procedure atom_of(GAtom?, Shown).
atom_of(g(identity, []), shown(identity))
.
atom_of(g(knows, [p(V1)]), shown(knows(V1?)))
.
atom_of(g(friend, [p(V1)]), shown(friend(V1?)))
.
atom_of(g(received, [s(V1), p(V2)]), shown(received(V1?, V2?)))
.
atom_of(g(member, [c(V1)]), shown(member(V1?)))
.
atom_of(g(listed, [p(V1), s(V2)]), shown(listed(V1?, V2?)))
.
atom_of(g(closed, [s(V1)]), shown(closed(V1?)))
.
atom_of(g(posted, [s(V1), s(V2)]), shown(posted(V1?, V2?)))
.
atom_of(g(delivered, [s(V1), p(V2), s(V3)]), shown(delivered(V1?, V2?, V3?)))
.
atom_of(g(received_in, [s(V1), p(V2), s(V3)]), shown(received_in(V1?, V2?, V3?)))
.
atom_of(_, unshown) :- otherwise | true.

.

%% The peer a request name N of an acquaintance part names beside the agent Me, peer(Q), or none, nopeer: the acquaintance schemas, each of two roles, both guarding, that requires at neither role an atom naming the other (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation").
procedure meeting_peer(Proposal?, Peer?, MeetPeer).
meeting_peer(acquaint(V1, V2), Me, P?)
:-
ground(V1?)
,
ground(V2?)
,
ground(Me?)
|
meet_other(V1?, V2?, Me?, P)
.
meeting_peer(_, _, nopeer) :- otherwise | true.

%% ===========================================================================
%% The agent (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation"): it calls the agent goal on the fair merge of the answers to its request questions, the arriving messages, the answers of its responders and its own triggers, which the agent goal writes on a stream of its own, one at a time (vGLP 6c8c663, Section 5.4, "The compilation").  A request question is a goal of a volitional procedure whose question, Menu, shows the agent's own key and the persons it knows and takes one request (vGLP 321127a, Section 5.4); the agent asks one when it starts and the agent goal the next when it reads the answer to the last.  On the request propose(N) the agent takes a Request, its person's approval, which stands until the transaction is taken or refused; its machine proposes, and proposes again an attempt that yields, with no further question to its person; and a machine that cannot carry out a transaction its person approved refuses it (vGLP f0acbc1, Section 5.4, "Triggers").  On the program's output to its person, Output, construct 0, the agent goal writes its view, view(S, K, A), the machine state S of its app state, the persons K it knows and the approvals A its person made that are pending, each by its request name, when it starts and whenever any changes, and the person's screen shows the last view written; and, when an approval its person made, by a request or by an answer yes, ends by a refusal, a notice refused(N, Q, D), N the request name of the part of the refused attempt, Q its refuser and D the reason, declined or unable, from the abort outcome, or from its own vote where its own vote no refused the attempt (vGLP e286276, Section 5.4, "The compilation").
%% ===========================================================================

%% An attempt (i, k, pi, [t]_j, r) (vGLP f0acbc1, Definition "Attempt"): its initiator, its number, its rank, its part, named by a term of Class, a schema-binding of the part, of the attempt's class (Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications": "each schema-binding determines a part [t]_j of its class"), the part's guard set the people in the schema-binding's marked roles, and the request it names, request(Rho, K), where its part is guarded and has an opener, and none otherwise.  The cargoes (Definition "Cargo, App State, Question, Approval, Free, Ready") are its start; a vote on it, a vote no carrying its reason, declined or unable; its outcome, an abort carrying its refuser, the participant whose vote no refused it, with that vote's reason; a yield of it; and a request, request(Rho, K).  A message carries its sender and a cargo, a hello, an ihello, or an introduction, intro(P, Q), P's cargo intro(Q), which Commit and Introduce peers send (Definitions "CVA Platform", "Deciding" and "Introduction Rule, Introduce Peers").  A request is a set of classes (Definition "Local Specification, Part, Guard Set, Opener, Request"): one(C), the class of a guarded part with no opener that the agent guards, C the term naming the class at the agent, a request of the agent to itself; or rho(N), rho_N, the classes of the guarded parts with an opener named N, a request to their opener, the message of the Request carrying N (Section 5.4, "The compilation").  A vote unable of the compiled program carries the atoms the schema requires at the voter that its state lacks and those it forbids that its state has, as the contract writes them (Section 5.4, "Act schemas").
Peer      ::= Key.
%% A speech act is an utterance or a speech act, signed by a person (GSC,
%% Section 3): "A speech act forwarded with its provenance is signed again at
%% each forward, so its type is recursive, and a request to forward it carries
%% it.  With no mode inversion, a recursive type is written whole by the
%% program or whole by the person" (vGLP, Section 5.1, Definition "Volitional
%% Procedure, Interactive Type" and the paragraph after it).
Speech    ::= speech(Utterance, Peer).
Utterance ::= utterance(String) ; Speech.
YesNo     ::= yes ; no.
%% A notice of a request dropped because the agent can carry out no part it names carries the reason unable alone (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "with a notice refused(N, p, unable)").
Reason    ::= declined ; unable ; unable(List(Atom), List(Atom)).
Vote      ::= yes ; no(Reason).
Decision  ::= commit ; abort(Peer, Reason) ; yield.
Rho       ::= one(Class) ; rho(Proposal).
Names     ::= none ; request(Rho, Integer).
Attempt   ::= attempt(Peer, Integer, Integer, Class, Names).
Cargo     ::= start(Attempt) ; vote(Attempt, Vote) ; outcome(Attempt, Decision)
            ; yield(Attempt) ; request(Rho, Integer).
%% A hello carries the request name N of the acquaintance part its sender requested, hello(P, N), P the sender (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "On the request propose(N), N the request name of an acquaintance part with a peer Q, the agent goal, besides what it does on any request, sends Q hello carrying N"); a contract with no guarded part has no acquaintance part, and its agents send no hello.
Content   ::= hello(Peer, Proposal) ; ihello(Peer) ; intro(Peer, Peer) ; cargo(Peer, Cargo).
Net       ::= msg(Peer, Content).
%% An approval question asks of an attempt, the question Start raises, or of the acquaintance a hello carries, hello(Q, N), Q its sender and N the request name of the acquaintance part (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation": an arriving hello from Q "asks its person the approval question of the clause of N, with its pragma, by a goal that shows Q and takes yes or no").
Asking    ::= Attempt ; hello(Peer, Proposal).
%% The approval question of a contract with pragmas carries the sentence the contract puts to the guarding role, which the platform writes, its roles and variables filled in from the binding of the attempt it asks about, each word text(S), as the contract writes it, or person(P), a person the sentence names (vGLP, Section 6.2, "The words a platform shows": "A sentence put to a guarding role names the roles and the variables of the attempt, so the platform writes it into the approval question, and its widget draws it as it draws any output of the program"; Section 5.4, "The contract's words").
Approval  ::= approval(Asking, List(Word), YesNo?).
Word      ::= text(String) ; person(Peer) ; named(String, Peer) ; valued(String, Integer).
%% The question of a guarding role beyond the proposer's, q(R, Words), R the person in that role (sentence_of; GSC, Section 2, its first paragraph).
RoleAsk   ::= q(Peer, List(Word)).
Menu      ::= menu(Key, List(Key), Request?).
Close     ::= close.
Trigger   ::= req(Request) ; again(Proposal) ; greeted(Proposal) ; net(Net) ; answered(Attempt, YesNo) ; recheck ; own ; day(Integer).
%% The peer an acquaintance part names beside the agent, peer(Q), or none, nopeer (meeting_peer, which the compiler prints from the contract's acquaintance schemas).
MeetPeer  ::= peer(Peer) ; nopeer.

%% The contract, as programs/gsc writes it: a schema's roles, each rs(Guard,
%% Add, Del, Keep, Forb), a role named by its index; sgn(y, i) is the signed
%% term of an added atom: "a signed term sgn(y, i) in an added atom is the
%% speech act bound to y, signed by the person in role i" (vGLP, Section
%% 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications"; GSC, Definition "Act schema").
%% A name term <u>.y_1...y_n, nterm(N): N is own(I), <pi_I>, or own_var(X), <x>, followed by ext(N, Y) for each y; "a name term <u>.y_1...y_n is the community name of the person bound to u followed by the speech acts bound to y_1, ..., y_n, as <a>.n names the group n led by a" (vGLP c649c0d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications"; GSC, Appendix D).
Var       ::= role(Integer) ; pvar(Constant) ; svar(Constant)
%% A cleared atom (vGLP f8127b1, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications": "A schema may mark an atom it deletes as cleared, with the wildcard * among its arguments or as the speech act of a name term: the act deletes every atom of the state that it matches, and requires none"), written among the deleted atoms of a role as programs/gsc writes it (GSC 327e035, Definition "Speech-act schema"): any is the wildcard as an argument, and ext_any(N) the name term N.*, the wildcard as its speech act.
            ; sgn(Constant, Integer) ; nterm(NTerm) ; num(Constant) ; any.
NTerm     ::= own(Integer) ; own_var(Constant) ; ext(NTerm, Constant) ; ext_any(NTerm).
Vars      ::= [] ; [Var | Vars].
%% An atom a schema adds or deletes may carry a multiplicity, times(K, A), K a number or a numeric variable, for that many copies of A (vGLP 613ee8d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications").
SAtom     ::= atom(Constant, Vars) ; times(Var, SAtom).
SAtoms    ::= [] ; [SAtom | SAtoms].
Guard     ::= guarded ; unguarded.
RoleSpec  ::= rs(Guard, SAtoms, SAtoms, SAtoms, SAtoms).
RoleSpecs ::= [] ; [RoleSpec | RoleSpecs].
%% A schema's second argument is its variables, in the order of its head (GSC 0228e79, Definition "Act schema"; programs/gsc/README.md, "Writing a contract").
Schema    ::= schema(Constant, Vars, RoleSpecs) ; lschema(Constant, Vars, RoleSpecs, Listings).
%% A schema with listed roles pi[rho(*, u_2, ..., u_r)], lschema(Name, Vars, Roles, Listings): each listed role written as a party role of its atoms, and listing(I, Base, Rho, Args) in Listings, in the order of the roles, I its index, Base the index of its base, an agent role, Rho the predicate rho and Args its arguments u_2, ..., u_r; "A listed role ... has as its people at a schema-binding the persons q with rho(q, u_2, ..., u_r), so bound, in the state of the person in pi", and "the listed roles of a schema have one base" (vGLP c649c0d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications").  A schema-binding of it with the lists L_1, ..., L_m of the people of its listed roles, in the order of the roles, is carried as a schema-binding of its roles, each listed role's place bound to the base person and its atoms at none; of one role more for each person of each list, of that listed role's atoms, the roles after its own, the people of L_1 first; and of an entry b(role(-I), p(Q)) for each person Q of the list of the listed role of index I, which names its people (bound_spec, listed_binding, copies_of): "each schema-binding determines a part [t]_j of a class for each list L of the people of its listed roles: the set of transactions it determines with L in those roles" (ibid.).
Listing   ::= listing(Integer, Integer, Constant, Vars).
Listings  ::= [] ; [Listing | Listings].
PeerLists ::= [] ; [Peers | PeerLists].
ListTuples ::= [] ; [PeerLists | ListTuples].
Schemas   ::= [] ; [Schema | Schemas].
Preds     ::= [] ; [Constant | Preds].
%% Numbers (vGLP 613ee8d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications"): an argument of an atom may be a number or a numeric variable, num(X), the number X where X is a number and the variable X otherwise; a schema may carry a constraint on its numeric variables, "a conjunction of linear equalities and inequalities over its value variables and values" (GSC bcc1891, Definition "Schema with values"), as programs/gsc writes it: true, and(C1, C2), eq, le, lt, ge and gt of two expressions (X = Y, X =< Y, X < Y, X >= Y, X > Y), succ(X, Y) (Y = X + 1) and or(C1, C2); an expression is a numeric argument, plus(X, Y), minus(X, Y) or mul(X, Y).  The values are whole numbers, Integer, the realisation's type (GSC, ibid.: "Which types the values have --- numbers, strings, dates --- is the realisation's").  schema_numeric(Name, numeric(C, Ls, R)), which the compiler prints from the contract, gives a schema's constraint C, its variables local to a role, Ls, and the role whose local variables the constraint names, at(I), or every where it names none: "a constraint is local to the role whose local variables it names, and to every role where it names none, which each checks" (ibid.).
%% A constraint is "a decidable condition on the values its binding assigns, in the relations their types provide --- linear arithmetic on its numeric variables, and signed(u, y) and unsigned(u, y), that the person bound to u signed the speech act bound to y or did not --- which is evaluated when the schema is bound" (vGLP dd37d2a, Section 5.4, "Speech-act schemas as local specifications"): signed(U, Y) and unsigned(U, Y), U a role or an agent variable and Y a speech-act variable, as programs/gsc writes them (GSC 10fcc92, def:numbers).
Constraint ::= true ; and(Constraint, Constraint) ; eq(Expr, Expr) ; le(Expr, Expr) ; lt(Expr, Expr) ; ge(Expr, Expr) ; gt(Expr, Expr) ; succ(Var, Var) ; or(Constraint, Constraint) ; signed(Var, Var) ; unsigned(Var, Var).
Expr      ::= Var ; plus(Expr, Expr) ; minus(Expr, Expr) ; mul(Expr, Expr).
CRole     ::= every ; at(Integer).
Numeric   ::= numeric(Constraint, Vars, CRole).
NumRes    ::= num_is(Integer) ; no_num.
LNorm     ::= norm(Binding) ; badnorm.

%% A machine state is a multiset of ground atoms, a list; an atom's arguments
%% are people and speech acts.  A binding sends roles and party variables to
%% people and speech-act variables to speech acts.
%% The value of a name term is a community name, c(N): community(P) the community name of the person P, dot(N, S) the community name N followed by the speech act S, as dot(community(a), n) names the group n led by a.
%% Under a binding the wildcard of a cleared atom is itself, any, and N.* the community name of N followed by it, dot_any(C) (GSC 327e035, Definition "Binding": beta(*) := *): the image of a cleared atom, which matches the atoms of a state obtained from it by replacing each wildcard by an argument, a speech act where the wildcard is in a name term (ibid.).
CName     ::= community(Peer) ; dot(CName, Speech) ; dot_any(CName).
%% A number, n(K); and lv(S, X), the value a schema-binding of the schema S gives a numeric variable X local to a role, which it does not bind: it stands for the variable, which the state of the person in that role binds (vGLP 613ee8d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications": "A numeric variable that occurs only in atoms the schema requires or deletes at one role, and in the constraint, is local to that role: the schema-binding does not bind it").
Val       ::= p(Peer) ; s(Speech) ; c(CName) ; n(Integer) ; lv(Constant, Constant) ; any.
NameParts ::= parts(Vars, Vals) ; noparts.
Vals      ::= [] ; [Val | Vals].
GAtom     ::= g(Constant, Vals).
GAtoms    ::= [] ; [GAtom | GAtoms].
%% The program's output to its person is of the type of the views, view(S, K, A): S a machine state, a list of the contract's atoms, each of the type Atom the compiler prints from the contract and written as the contract writes it; K the persons the agent knows, in the order of identifiers; and A the approvals its person made that are pending, each by its request name, a request's own and an answer's that of its attempt's part, a term of Proposal, in which no Stream or List occurs (Definition "Effective Local Specification"), so that no Stream or List is under another (Definition "Volitional Procedure, Interactive Type": "never under another Stream or List"); and the notices, refused(N, Q, D), N the request name of the part of the refused attempt, Q its refuser and D the reason, declined, or unable(Lacks, Has), the atoms the schema requires at the voter that its state lacks and those it forbids that its state has, as the contract writes them (vGLP e286276, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "the approvals A its person made that are pending, each by its request name, a request's own and an answer's that of its attempt's part"; "a notice refused(N, q, d): N the request name of the part of the refused attempt, q its refuser and d the reason"; "The compilation defines Output as the type of the views and the notices, and declares for the type Stream(Output) of the output a widget that draws the last view written and the notices written after it"; "Act schemas"; Definition "Widget Declaration").  A contract with no guarded part has no approvals, and its A is always empty: Approved is then Constant, of which it holds none.
Approved  ::= Proposal.
%% The view of a contract with pragmas carries also the lists its app shows, each tab(Name, P), its name and the predicate P whose atoms in the machine state it lists, as the contract's pragmas give them, or tab(Name, P, counted) where the contract adds or deletes P with a multiplicity, its rows showing their counts (vGLP 110caf4, Section 5.4) (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The contract's words": "a tab's name and what it lists into the view the agent writes"), view(S, K, A, Ts).
Output    ::= view(List(Atom), List(Key), List(Approved), List(Tab)) ; refused(Approved, Key, Reason).
Tab       ::= tab(String, Constant) ; tab(String, Constant, Constant).
Shown     ::= shown(Atom) ; unshown.
Stream(Output) =::= last_state.
Bind      ::= b(Var, Val).
Binding   ::= [] ; [Bind | Binding].
Bindings  ::= [] ; [Binding | Bindings].
Found     ::= found(Val) ; free.
Match     ::= match(Binding) ; nomatch.
SgnParts  ::= signed(Val, Peer) ; unsigned.
Peers     ::= [] ; [Peer | Peers].
Nets      ::= [] ; [Net | Nets].
Ints      ::= [] ; [Integer | Ints].

%% A class, as the paper defines it: "The classes are those of the contract's equivalence, generated by relating two transactions when one schema-binding determines both" (vGLP 099f876, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications").  Two schema-bindings of the same participants and the same atoms deleted and added at each determine a common transaction, and are linked, when no atom one requires at a participant the other forbids there; a class is what a chain of links joins.  Each schema-binding determines a part of its class, the set of transactions it determines, with the people in its marked roles as its guard set (ibid.), and two schema-bindings determine one part where they require the same atoms, as multisets, and forbid the same atoms at every participant, and mark the same people (same_part; vGLP #15, Code_inbox.md, 2026-10-19 10:50 UTC, item 1).  An entry for a class holds its participants and the atoms each deletes and adds, delta(P, D, A); its parts, each pt(T, GuardSet, Opener), named by the term T of the first of its schema-bindings in the order of the entry's, with its guard set and, for an unguarded part, its opener, opener(P), "the least, in the order of identifiers, of the people in the first role of the schema-bindings that determine it" (ibid.); for a guarded part determined by a schema with a listed role whose base is not a guarding role, its opener likewise, opener(P), P the least person in the first role of those schema-bindings, that person not a guard of the part (vGLP a890465, ibid.: "and so is the opener of a guarded part determined by a schema with a listed role whose base is not a guarding role, where that person is not a guard of the part"); and guarded_part for every other guarded part, which has no opener; and its schema-bindings, each mate(Schema, Binding, GuardSet, FirstPerson), every variable bound, the contract being effective (local.glp: every variable of an atom a schema requires or forbids is a variable of an atom it deletes or adds).  ci(C, Deltas, Participants, Parts, Mates), C the term that names it, the first the agent met.
Delta     ::= delta(Peer, GAtoms, GAtoms).
Deltas    ::= [] ; [Delta | Deltas].
Mate      ::= mate(Constant, Binding, Peers, Peer).
Mates     ::= [] ; [Mate | Mates].
Opener    ::= opener(Peer) ; guarded_part.
Part      ::= pt(Class, Peers, Opener).
Parts     ::= [] ; [Part | Parts].
Info      ::= ci(Class, Deltas, Peers, Parts, Mates).
Infos     ::= [] ; [Info | Infos].
ClassRes  ::= cls(Info) ; nocls.
%% An atom of a schema-binding as it is compared, within the schema-binding and with another's: a variable the binding leaves free stands for itself, cmp_free(V), one person or speech act in every atom it occurs in and named by no other variable.
CVal      ::= cmp_val(Val) ; cmp_free(Var).
CVals     ::= [] ; [CVal | CVals].
CAtom     ::= cmp_atom(Constant, CVals).
CAtoms    ::= [] ; [CAtom | CAtoms].

%% The app state (s, k, L, R) (vGLP f0acbc1, Definition "Cargo, App State, Question, Approval, Free, Ready"): the machine state; the agent's number, the largest number of an attempt it has proposed or read a start of, or of a request it has made; the lock, unlocked or the attempt it holds prepared; and the record, which holds besides requested(Rho, K), a request it has made, and ended(Rho, K) and ended(At), the end of an approval, a request or an answer yes.  The agent state (Section 5.4, "The compilation"): its identifier, the app state, the count of the own transactions it has taken, the peers hello has been sent to and received from, and ihello, the count at which each class of its own transactions it has met began to wait --- the proposing class op([t]_j) of a part, named by the part's term, the Vote vt(At) and the Commit cm(At) on an attempt, the Wound wd(A, B) of A against B, and the Introduce peers ip(Q, R) of a pair, Q preceding R --- the classes met, the starts it holds waiting, deferred(M), the requests it has made, in the order it last made them, the least recent first, and the requests it holds, held(Q, Rho, K), each a message request(Rho, K) from Q (Definition "Equivalence of the Canonical Platform": "for a part [t]_j and an agent p, p's proposing class on [t]_j").
Lock      ::= unlocked ; held(Attempt).
Rec       ::= asked(Attempt) ; answered(Attempt, YesNo) ; voted(Attempt, YesNo)
            ; got(Attempt, Peer, YesNo) ; closed(Attempt) ; wounded(Attempt)
            ; yielded(Attempt) ; requested(Rho, Integer) ; ended(Rho, Integer)
            ; ended(Attempt) ; introduced(Peer, Peer).
Recs      ::= [] ; [Rec | Recs].
App       ::= app(GAtoms, Integer, Lock, Recs).
Pend      ::= deferred(Net).
Pends     ::= [] ; [Pend | Pends].
WKey      ::= op(Class) ; vt(Attempt) ; cm(Attempt) ; wd(Attempt, Attempt)
            ; ip(Peer, Peer).
Wait      ::= w(WKey, Integer).
Waits     ::= [] ; [Wait | Waits].
WFound    ::= at(Integer) ; unseen.
Held      ::= held(Peer, Rho, Integer).
Helds     ::= [] ; [Held | Helds].
Rhos      ::= [] ; [Rho | Rhos].
%% The record indexed by attempt (Code #12's change 2 of 2026-10-20 11:55 UTC, approved by vGLP #18 Cowork as implementation, Code_inbox.md 12:03 UTC: "index the record by attempt, so that no own trigger and no condition scans a closed attempt's terms, and only open attempts are examined.  Memory stays as the specification's"): the record R of the app state is whole and append-only (Definition "Cargo, App State, Question, Approval, Free, Ready"), and the agent goal holds it in three parts, which no entry leaves.  The live record, the fourth field of App, holds the entries of the attempts not closed at the agent, the answers yes whose approval has not ended, the requests not ended, newest first, the record's own order; once a dispatch closes an attempt or ends a request, its entries leave the live record for the record of the closed attempts, which the agent goal holds beside its state and no trigger and no condition reads (spend); and the index, the agent state's last field, holds the introductions recorded, introduced(Q, R), and what a condition asks of the entries that have left: which attempts are closed and which requests ended, a trie keyed by the attempt's number or the request's, the attempt by its initiator, a(I), the request by itself, r(Rho), and the agent's own attempts recorded wounded that are the last it proposed of their parts, of which Propose takes the rank (Definition "Proposing", Propose).
Tag       ::= a(Peer) ; r(Rho).
Tags      ::= [] ; [Tag | Tags].
Trie      ::= nil ; t(Tags, Trie, Trie).
Attempts  ::= [] ; [Attempt | Attempts].
%% The pairs the introduction rule gives the agent that it has not introduced, computed where its friends change and not on every own trigger (Code #12's change 4, vGLP #18 Cowork, Code_inbox.md 2026-10-20 12:03 UTC): ic(S, Ns, Pend), the machine state S they were computed at, the persons Ns its introduction predicates name there, in the order of identifiers, and the pairs of Ns not recorded introduced, Pend, in the order Introduce peers forms them; a pair recorded introduced leaves Pend.
IC        ::= ic(GAtoms, Peers, Pairs).
Ix        ::= ix(Trie, Attempts, Recs, IC).
Fate      ::= keep ; move ; intro.
%% The parts of the agent state a condition tests (Code #12's change 3, vGLP #18 Cowork, Code_inbox.md 2026-10-20 12:03 UTC: "a condition reads only the parts of the state it tests"): the agent's identifier, its machine state, the lock, the live record, the starts it holds waiting and the hellos and ihellos sent and received, kn(Sent, Received, ISent, IReceived).  A condition taken for each record, pair, participant, start held or class reads these, and not the whole state; the classes it needs it reads from the state, which it gives back.
Kn        ::= kn(Peers, Peers, Peers, Peers).
V         ::= v(Peer, GAtoms, Lock, Recs, Pends, Kn).
Proposals ::= [] ; [Proposal | Proposals].
St        ::= st(Peer, App, Integer, Peers, Peers, Peers, Peers, Waits, Infos, Pends, Rhos, Helds, Ix, Proposals).
OpenApproval ::= oc(Attempt, Close?).
OpenApprovals ::= [] ; [OpenApproval | OpenApprovals].
Send      ::= to(Peer, Cargo).
Sends     ::= [] ; [Send | Sends].
Subj      ::= sub(Info) ; pair ; prop(Info, Class, Names).
Cand      ::= cand(WKey, Subj).
Cands     ::= [] ; [Cand | Cands].
Choice    ::= take(WKey, Subj) ; none.
Pair      ::= pr(Peer, Peer).
Pairs     ::= [] ; [Pair | Pairs].
PKey      ::= key(WKey) ; nokey.
Cond      ::= go(Info) ; drop.
PCond     ::= pgo(Info, Class, Names) ; pdrop.
RCond     ::= rgo(Rho, Peer) ; rdrop ; rhold(Proposal) ; rrefuse(Proposal).
RQ        ::= rq(RCands, YesNo, YesNo).
RCand     ::= rc(Rho, Peer).
RCands    ::= [] ; [RCand | RCands].
PName     ::= pname(Proposal) ; nopname.
PartRes   ::= part(Part) ; nopart.
Mine      ::= mine(Rho, Integer) ; notmine.
Outputs   ::= [] ; [Output | Outputs].
Classes   ::= [] ; [Class | Classes].
MCond     ::= mgo(Info) ; mdefer ; mhold ; noparticipant.
Blocker   ::= blk(Attempt) ; noblk.
FoundNet  ::= found(Net) ; nonefound.
Last      ::= last(Attempt) ; nolast.
Known     ::= allknown ; unknown(Peer).
Then      ::= write_own ; own_unread ; no_own.
ApprovalRes ::= approval_for(Attempt) ; noapproval.

%% When it starts, its view is written on the output: the machine state of the initial app state, the empty multiset, and no person known; and an own trigger on its stream of own triggers, which the agent goal reads in the fair merge of the answers to its request questions, the arriving messages, the answers to its approval questions and its own triggers (vGLP 6c8c663, Section 5.4, "The compilation").
%% Where the contract requires the day, the agent reads also the calendar, a stream of dates the device writes, one a day, merged with its triggers (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "the fair merge ... of the answers to its request questions, the messages arriving on the network, the answers to its approval questions, its own triggers and, where the contract requires the day, the calendar").
exported procedure agent(Peer?, Stream(Net)?, Stream(Net), Stream(Output)).
agent(Id, NetIn, Out?, [view([], [], [], Ts?)|Thr?]) :- ground(Id?) |
    tabs(Ts),
    request(Id?, [], Rq),
    tag_net(NetIn?, Nt),
    merge(Rq?, Nt?, M1),
    merge(M1?, Ans?, M2),
    merge(M2?, [own|Ow?], In),
    agent_goal([], In?, yes, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, [], [],
        st(Id?, app([], 0, unlocked, []), 0, [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], ix(nil, [], [], ic([], [], [])), [])).

%% A request question: the agent's own key, its identifier, the persons the
%% agent knows, in the order of identifiers, and the person's one request,
%% put up once it is made, of a type with the alternative propose(N) for the request name N of each guarded part (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation").  A contract with no guarded part has no request, and its agent asks no request question.
procedure (Menu)*request(Key?, List(Key)?, Stream(Trigger)).
(menu(Id?, Ks?, R))*request(Id, Ks, Out?) :- ground(Id?), ground(Ks?) |
    await_request(R?, Out).
procedure await_request(Request?, Stream(Trigger)).
await_request(propose(C), [req(propose(C?))]).

%% The next request question, asked on reading the answer to the last, its
%% answers joining the agent goal's input.
procedure ask_next(St?, Stream(Trigger), Stream(Trigger)?).
ask_next(St, Ans?, Ans1) :- ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    st_known(St?, Ks),
    request(Id?, Ks?, R),
    merge(R?, Ans1?, Ans).

procedure tag_net(Stream(Net)?, Stream(Trigger)).
tag_net([M|Ms], [net(M?)|Ts?]) :- tag_net(Ms?, Ts).
tag_net([], []).

%% A responder: the approval question Start raises shows the attempt and takes yes or no.
%% The agent goal holds the writer of its close signal and closes it once the
%% question is no longer pending, as when Outcome closes the attempt first; the
%% responder then reduces without the answer, dropping the person's reader on
%% it.
%% With pragmas, the question shows also the sentence the contract puts to the agent's role, as sentence_of gives it for the attempt's part (vGLP, Section 6.2, "The words a platform shows").
procedure (Approval)*respond(Attempt?, List(Word)?, Close?, Stream(Trigger)).
(approval(At?, Ws?, YN))*respond(At, Ws, Cl, Out?) :- ground(At?) |
    await(At?, YN?, Cl?, Out).
procedure await(Attempt?, YesNo?, Close?, Stream(Trigger)).
await(At, yes, _, [answered(At?, yes)]).
await(At, no, _, [answered(At?, no)]).
await(_, _, close, []).

%% The approval question an arriving hello from Q asks: the clause of the acquaintance part N that hello carries, with its pragma, showing Q and taking yes or no; the person's yes is their request propose(N), which the agent goal reads as any request, and their no does nothing (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation").
procedure (Approval)*greet(Peer?, Proposal?, List(Word)?, Stream(Trigger)).
(approval(hello(Q?, N?), Ws?, YN))*greet(Q, N, Ws, Out?) :- ground(Q?), ground(N?) |
    await_greet(N?, YN?, Out).
procedure await_greet(Proposal?, YesNo?, Stream(Trigger)).
await_greet(N, yes, [greeted(N?)]).
await_greet(_, no, []).

%% ===========================================================================
%% The agent goal: one clause per kind of trigger, which computes the conditions of the schemas the trigger puts up and calls the dispatch.  It reads first the recheck of the starts it holds waiting, which a dispatch puts up, and then its input stream, the fair merge of the answers to its request questions, the arriving messages, the answers to its approval questions and its own triggers.  It holds the writer of its stream of own triggers, Ow, and whether an own trigger it has written is still unread, U; and, beside its state St, the record of the closed attempts, H, the entries of the attempts closed at the agent and of the requests it has ended, which leave the live record of its app state after the dispatch that closes or ends them (spend) and which no trigger and no condition reads.  It takes its own transactions one at a time, one on each own trigger it reads; it writes an own trigger when it starts, after each other trigger it reads unless an own trigger it has written is still unread, and after each own transaction it takes, so that it reads its other triggers between its own transactions and writes none once none holds (vGLP 6c8c663, Section 5.4, "The compilation").
%% ===========================================================================

procedure agent_goal(Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger)?, YesNo?, Stream(Trigger),
    Stream(Output), Stream(Net), Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
agent_goal([T|Ls], In, U, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    then_local(U?, Th),
    step(T?, Th?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).
agent_goal([], [T|In], U, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    then_read(U?, Th),
    step(T?, Th?, [], In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).
agent_goal([], [], _, [], [], [], [], _, _, _).

%% After a recheck, read from the agent goal's own list, an own trigger is unread exactly when one was before it (own_unread, no_own); after another trigger, read from the input stream, an own trigger is written unless one is unread (write_own, own_unread).  An own trigger is read from the input stream, and its clause, step(own, ...), takes no Then: dispatch_own writes the next own trigger after an own transaction taken, and none where none holds.
procedure then_local(YesNo?, Then).
then_local(yes, own_unread).
then_local(no, no_own).
procedure then_read(YesNo?, Then).
then_read(yes, own_unread).
then_read(no, write_own).

procedure step(Trigger?, Then?, Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger)?,
    Stream(Trigger), Stream(Output), Stream(Net), Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
step(req(propose(N)), Th, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(N?), ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap0),
    ask_next(St?, Ans, Ans1?),
    st_id(St?, Id),
    meeting_peer(N?, Id?, Mp),
    meet_hello(Mp?, N?, St?, Out, Out1?, Thr, Thr1?, St0),
    request_cond(N?, St0?, Cd, St1),
    dispatch_request(Cd?, Th?, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans1, Thr1, Out1, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St1?).
%% The person's yes to the question an arriving hello asks, their request propose(N), read as any request, its hello sent back; no next request question is asked on it, being no answer to one (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "the person's yes is their request propose(N) with Q, which the agent goal reads as any request"; the agent goal asks a request question "when it starts and the next when it reads the answer to the last").
step(greeted(N), Th, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(N?), ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap0),
    st_id(St?, Id),
    meeting_peer(N?, Id?, Mp),
    meet_hello(Mp?, N?, St?, Out, Out1?, Thr, Thr1?, St0),
    request_cond(N?, St0?, Cd, St1),
    dispatch_request(Cd?, Th?, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr1, Out1, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St1?).
%% A request of the person the agent held, put up again: read as the request, its hello sent and its next request question asked when it was first read (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "it holds the request and puts it up again after every dispatch").
step(again(N), Th, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(N?), ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap0),
    request_cond(N?, St?, Cd, St1),
    dispatch_request(Cd?, Th?, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St1?).
step(net(msg(_, hello(P, N))), Th, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(P?), ground(N?), ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap0),
    hello_cond(P?, St?, Cd),
    dispatch_hello(Cd?, P?, N?, Th?, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).
step(net(msg(_, ihello(P))), Th, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(P?), ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap0),
    ihello_cond(P?, St?, Cd),
    dispatch_ihello(Cd?, P?, Th?, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).
step(net(msg(_, intro(_, Q))), Th, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(Q?), ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap0),
    intro_cond(Q?, St?, Cd),
    dispatch_intro(Cd?, Q?, Th?, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).
step(net(msg(To, cargo(F, X))), Th, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(To?), ground(F?), ground(X?), ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap0),
    message_cond(X?, St?, Cd, St1),
    dispatch_message(Cd?, msg(To?, cargo(F?, X?)), F?, X?, Th?, Ap0?, Ls?,
        In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St1?).
step(answered(At, YN), Th, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(At?), ground(YN?), ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap0),
    close_approval(At?, Approvals?, Approvals1),
    answer_cond(At?, St?, Cd, St1),
    dispatch_answer(Cd?, YN?, At?, Th?, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out,
        Ow, Approvals1?, H?, St1?).
step(recheck, Th, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :- ground(St?) |
    st_pends(St?, Pd),
    st_view(St?, V),
    st_trie(St?, Tr),
    recheck_find(Pd?, V?, Tr?, St?, F),
    recheck1(F?, Th?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).
%% A date of the calendar: today(d) replaced in the state beside the app state, which the conditions read and the view does not show; the app state changing, the starts and the requests the agent holds are put up again (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "on each date of which it replaces today(d) and puts up again the starts and requests it holds").  The agent holds today(d) as an atom of the machine state of its app state, which no schema adds or deletes, which atom_of does not show and show_state does not compare.
step(day(D), Th, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    integer(D?), ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap0),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    set_today(D?, Ap?, Ap1),
    set_app(St?, Ap1?, St1),
    next(Th?, yes, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St1?).
step(own, _, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    take_own(Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).

%% After a dispatch: where the machine state has changed, the new view is written on the output (vGLP b7e3517, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "where the machine state changes, it writes the new view on the output"); where the app state has changed, the approval questions whose question the new app state no longer holds pending are closed; where it has, or the dispatch consumed a start (Kick), the starts held waiting are put up again, by a recheck; and the agent goal writes an own trigger on its stream of own triggers after another trigger read from the input stream, unless an own trigger it has written is still unread, and after an own transaction taken (Then write_own), and none after an own trigger on which none holds (no_own) or while one is unread (own_unread), so that at most one own trigger it has written is unread (vGLP 6c8c663, Section 5.4, "The compilation").
procedure next(Then?, YesNo?, App?, Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger)?,
    Stream(Trigger), Stream(Output), Stream(Net), Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
next(Th, Kick, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    next_n(Th?, Kick?, Ap0?, [], Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).
%% The same, with the notices Ns the dispatch gives, written after the view (put_notices).
procedure next_n(Then?, YesNo?, App?, Outputs?, Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger)?,
    Stream(Trigger), Stream(Output), Stream(Net), Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
next_n(Th, Kick, Ap0, Ns, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(Ap0?), ground(St?) |
    app_changed(Ap0?, St?, Ca1),
    app_changed(Ap0?, St?, Ca2),
    app_changed(Ap0?, St?, Ca3),
    or(Ca2?, Kick?, Re),
    close_falsified(Ca1?, Approvals?, St?, Approvals1),
    spend(Ca3?, St?, H?, St0, H1),
    repend(Re?, St0?, Ag, St1),
    own_after(Th?, Ow, Ow1?, U),
    app(Ag?, Ls?, L1),
    show_state(Ap0?, St?, Thr, Thr1?),
    put_notices(Ns?, Thr1, Thr2?),
    agent_goal(L1?, In?, U?, Ans, Thr2, Out, Ow1, Approvals1?, H1?, St1?).

%% The view after the dispatch, written where the machine state differs, as a multiset, from that before it, or the approvals pending differ.
procedure show_state(App?, St?, Stream(Output), Stream(Output)?).
show_state(Ap0, St, Thr?, Thr1) :- ground(Ap0?), ground(St?) |
    app_ms(Ap0?, S00),
    st_ms(St?, S10),
    not_today(S00?, S0),
    not_today(S10?, S1),
    ms_eq(S0?, S1?, Sm),
    neg(Sm?, Ch1),
    app_recs(Ap0?, R0),
    approvals_of(R0?, A0),
    st_app(St?, Ap1),
    app_recs(Ap1?, R1),
    approvals_of(R1?, A1),
    same(A0?, A1?, Sa),
    neg(Sa?, Ch2),
    or(Ch1?, Ch2?, Ch),
    show_view(Ch?, St?, Thr, Thr1?).
%% The view after a hello or an ihello is sent or recorded, written where the peer Q, not known before, is known now: on whichever of the two hellos, or of the two ihellos, comes second (vGLP b7e3517, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "when a peer becomes known, the agent goal writes the new view on the output").
procedure show_known(Peer?, St?, St?, Stream(Output), Stream(Output)?, St).
show_known(Q, St0, St, Thr?, Thr1, St?) :- ground(Q?), ground(St0?), ground(St?) |
    known_st(Q?, St0?, B0),
    known_st(Q?, St?, B1),
    neg(B0?, N0),
    and(N0?, B1?, B),
    show_view(B?, St?, Thr, Thr1?).
procedure show_view(YesNo?, St?, Stream(Output), Stream(Output)?).
show_view(no, _, Thr1?, Thr1).
show_view(yes, St, [V?|Thr1?], Thr1) :- view_of(St?, V).
%% The view at the agent state: its machine state, the contract's atoms; the persons it knows, in the order of identifiers; and the approvals its person made that are pending, each by its request name, in the order they were made.
procedure view_of(St?, Output).
view_of(St, view(A?, Ks?, Ps?, Ts?)) :- ground(St?) |
    tabs(Ts),
    st_ms(St?, S),
    atoms_of(S?, A),
    st_known(St?, Ks),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    app_recs(Ap?, R),
    approvals_of(R?, Ps).
%% The approvals pending in the record R, newest first: each request requested(Rho, K) not ended, by its name, and each answer yes answered(At, yes) not ended, by the request name of its attempt's part (request_name); given oldest first (vGLP e286276, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "each by its request name, a request's own and an answer's that of its attempt's part").
procedure approvals_of(Recs?, List(Approved)).
approvals_of(R, As?) :- ground(R?) | approvals1(R?, R?, [], As).
procedure approvals1(Recs?, Recs?, List(Approved)?, List(Approved)).
approvals1([], _, Acc, Acc?).
approvals1([requested(Rr, K)|Rs], R, Acc, As?) :- ground(Rr?), integer(K?), ground(R?) |
    mem(ended(Rr?, K?), R?, En),
    rho_name(Rr?, Pn),
    keep_pname(En?, Pn?, Acc?, Acc1),
    approvals1(Rs?, R?, Acc1?, As).
approvals1([answered(At, yes)|Rs], R, Acc, As?) :- ground(At?), ground(R?) |
    mem(ended(At?), R?, En),
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    request_name(C?, Pn),
    keep_pname(En?, Pn?, Acc?, Acc1),
    approvals1(Rs?, R?, Acc1?, As).
approvals1([_|Rs], R, Acc, As?) :- otherwise | approvals1(Rs?, R?, Acc?, As).
procedure rho_name(Rho?, PName).
rho_name(one(C), Pn?) :- request_name(C?, Pn).
rho_name(rho(N), pname(N?)).
procedure keep_pname(YesNo?, PName?, List(Approved)?, List(Approved)).
keep_pname(no, pname(N), Acc, [N?|Acc?]).
keep_pname(_, _, Acc, Acc?) :- otherwise | true.
procedure set_today(Integer?, App?, App).
set_today(D, app(S, K, L, R), app([g(today, [n(D?)])|S1?], K?, L?, R?)) :- not_today(S?, S1).
%% The machine state less the day, today(d).
procedure not_today(GAtoms?, GAtoms).
not_today([], []).
not_today([g(today, _)|S], S1?) :- not_today(S?, S1).
not_today([G|S], [G?|S1?]) :- otherwise | not_today(S?, S1).
procedure app_ms(App?, GAtoms).
app_ms(app(S, _, _, _), S?).
procedure st_ms(St?, GAtoms).
st_ms(st(_, app(S, _, _, _), _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _), S?).
%% The machine state as the contract writes its atoms, each by atom_of, which the compiler prints from the contract and whose last clause, giving unshown for an atom of no alternative of Atom, covers the type and is never reached.
procedure atoms_of(GAtoms?, List(Atom)).
atoms_of([], []).
atoms_of([G|Gs], As?) :- atom_of(G?, Sh), atoms_of(Gs?, As1), shown_cons(Sh?, As1?, As).
procedure shown_cons(Shown?, List(Atom)?, List(Atom)).
shown_cons(shown(A), As, [A?|As?]).
shown_cons(unshown, As, As?).

%% The notices a dispatch writes on the output, after the view it writes, if any (vGLP e286276, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "when an approval its person made, by a request or by an answer yes, ends by a refusal, a notice refused(N, q, d): N the request name of the part of the refused attempt, q its refuser and d the reason, from the abort outcome, or from the vote where the agent's own vote no refused it").  The effects of the transactions that end an approval by a refusal give the notice, one for each such end: the Propose that refuses at once, a guard's vote no, by Start or by Vote, the Tally that records a no, and the Outcome of an abort (ended_notice).
procedure put_notices(Outputs?, Stream(Output), Stream(Output)?).
put_notices([], Thr1?, Thr1).
put_notices([N|Ns], [N?|Thr?], Thr1) :- put_notices(Ns?, Thr, Thr1?).
%% ended_notice(Ended?, Part?, Refuser?, Reason?, Notices): the notice refused(N, Q, D), N the request name of the part (request_name), where an approval ended, and none where none did; a contract with no guarded part has no approvals, and none ends.
procedure ended_notice(YesNo?, Class?, Peer?, Reason?, Outputs).
ended_notice(yes, C, Q, D, Ns?) :- ground(C?) | request_name(C?, Pn), named_notice(Pn?, Q?, D?, Ns).
ended_notice(no, _, _, _, []).
procedure named_notice(PName?, Peer?, Reason?, Outputs).
named_notice(pname(N), Q, D, [refused(N?, Q?, D?)]).
named_notice(nopname, _, _, []).
procedure some_peer(Peers?, YesNo).
some_peer([], no).
some_peer([_|_], yes).

procedure app_changed(App?, St?, YesNo).
app_changed(Ap0, St, C?) :- ground(Ap0?), ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap1),
    same(Ap0?, Ap1?, Sm),
    neg(Sm?, C).

%% own_after(Then?, Ow, Ow1?, U): an own trigger written on Ow, or none, Ow1 the rest of the stream of own triggers, and U whether an own trigger written is unread after it.
procedure own_after(Then?, Stream(Trigger), Stream(Trigger)?, YesNo).
own_after(write_own, [own|Ow1?], Ow1, yes).
own_after(own_unread, Ow1?, Ow1, yes).
own_after(no_own, Ow1?, Ow1, no).

%% repend(Again?, St?, Ag, St1): where the dispatch changed the app state or consumed a start, the requests of its person the agent holds, each put up again, and then a recheck of the starts held waiting, where there are any (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "After every dispatch the agent goal puts up again the starts and the requests of its person it holds").  The requests come first, so that a request held while the agent was busy is an approval again before a start of its class is taken, and the person who made it is not asked on that start: "The two-phase commit of the meet then runs with both approvals standing, so no second question is asked" (vGLP #20 Cowork to Code, 2026-10-23 22:09 UTC, item 1).
procedure repend(YesNo?, St?, Stream(Trigger), St).
repend(no, St, [], St?).
repend(yes, St, Ag?, St1?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_pends(St?, Pd),
    pend_triggers(Pd?, Ag0),
    st_reqs(St?, Rq),
    again_triggers(Rq?, Ag1),
    app(Ag1?, Ag0?, Ag),
    set_reqs(St?, [], St1).
%% The requests of its person the agent holds, each put up again, again(N), and taken, held again or dropped on its reading as a request read is.
procedure again_triggers(Proposals?, Stream(Trigger)).
again_triggers([], []).
again_triggers([N|Ns], [again(N?)|Ts?]) :- again_triggers(Ns?, Ts).
procedure pend_triggers(Pends?, Stream(Trigger)).
pend_triggers([], []).
pend_triggers([_|_], [recheck]).

%% --- Request, on the request propose(N) ------------------------------------
%% On the answer propose(N) to a request question, N the request name of a guarded part, the dispatch takes, among the Request of {[t]} to the agent itself for each class [t] of a guarded part with no opener named N that it guards and is ready for, where it is free for [t] and no such request is pending at it, and the Request of rho_N to the opener of the guarded parts with an opener named N, where the agent is free for every class of rho_N, guards one of those parts it is ready for, and rho_N is not pending at it, the one it has taken least recently, where there is one, and drops the request otherwise; the message of the Request carries N for rho_N (vGLP f0acbc1, Section 5.4, "Triggers" and "The compilation"; Definition "Proposing", Request).  The part named N at the agent is the part of the class term that N names at its state (name_class: for a schema with listed roles, with the people its state lists at the place of each), and its class is the class [t] of the Request; for rho_N, the agent's precondition is the same in every part named N, the agent not being the base of its listed roles, whose opener lists their people.  A Request to another agent sends request(rho(N), K), so that agent is known.  The Request is the agent's person's approval of each class of the request, pending until ended (Definition "Cargo, App State, Question, Approval, Free, Ready").
procedure request_cond(Proposal?, St?, RCond, St).
request_cond(N, St, Cd?, St2?) :- ground(N?), ground(St?) |
    st_ms(St?, S),
    name_class(N?, S?, C),
    request_cond0(C?, N?, St?, Cd, St2).
procedure request_cond0(Class?, Proposal?, St?, RCond, St).
request_cond0(C, N, St, Cd?, St2?) :- ground(C?), ground(N?), ground(St?) |
    st_class(C?, St?, R, St1),
    request_cond1(R?, N?, C?, St1?, Cd, St2).
procedure request_cond1(ClassRes?, Proposal?, Class?, St?, RCond, St).
request_cond1(nocls, N, _, St, rrefuse(N?), St?).
request_cond1(cls(I), N, C, St, Cd?, St?) :- ground(I?), ground(N?), ground(C?), ground(St?) |
    term_part_of(I?, C?, Pr),
    request_cands(Pr?, I?, N?, C?, St?, Rq),
    st_made(St?, Md),
    pick_request(Rq?, N?, C?, Md?, Cd).
%% The candidate Request of the part Pr that the request name names, where its condition holds: for a guarded part with no opener, the Request of {[t]} to the agent itself, one(C0), C0 the term that names the class at the agent, where it is free for [t], ready for the part named N, which it guards, and has no request of {[t]} pending (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "the Request of {[t]} to itself for each class [t] of a guarded part with no opener named N that it guards and is ready for"); for a guarded part with an opener, the Request of rho_N to the opener, where the agent is a guard of the part and not its opener, is free for every class of rho_N, its state is in the domain of its effect in the part, rho_N is not pending at it, and the opener is known.  With the candidates, rq(Cs, Busy, Ready): Busy, whether the agent, a guard of the part and not its opener, is not free for a class of its Request, and Ready, whether it is ready for the part, which it guards or opens.
procedure request_cands(PartRes?, Info?, Proposal?, Class?, St?, RQ).
request_cands(nopart, _, _, _, _, rq([], no, no)).
request_cands(part(pt(_, G, guarded_part)), I, _, C, St, rq(Cs?, Bz?, RdN?)) :- ground(G?), ground(I?), ground(C?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    mem(Id?, G?, Gd),
    free_i(I?, St?, Fr),
    st_ms(St?, S),
    part_dom(C?, Id?, S?, Dm),
    self_request(I?, St?, NPd),
    and(Gd?, Fr?, B1),
    and(B1?, Dm?, B2),
    and(B2?, NPd?, B),
    self_cand(B?, C?, Id?, Cs),
    neg(Fr?, NFr),
    and(Gd?, NFr?, Bz),
    and(Gd?, Dm?, RdN).
request_cands(part(pt(_, G, opener(O))), _, N, C, St, rq(Cs?, Bz?, RdN?)) :-
    ground(G?), ground(N?), ground(C?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    mem(Id?, G?, Gd),
    same(O?, Id?, Me),
    neg(Me?, NMe),
    free_rho(N?, St?, Fr),
    st_ms(St?, S),
    part_dom(C?, Id?, S?, Rd),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    app_recs(Ap?, Rc),
    pending_request(rho(N?), Rc?, Pd),
    neg(Pd?, NPd),
    known_st(O?, St?, Kn),
    and(Gd?, NMe?, B1),
    and(B1?, Fr?, B2),
    and(B2?, Rd?, B3),
    and(B3?, NPd?, B4),
    and(B4?, Kn?, B),
    rho_cand(B?, N?, O?, Cs),
    neg(Fr?, NFr),
    and(B1?, NFr?, Bz),
    or(Gd?, Me?, GO),
    st_ms(St?, S2),
    part_dom(C?, Id?, S2?, Dm),
    and(GO?, Dm?, RdN).
procedure rho_cand(YesNo?, Proposal?, Peer?, RCands).
rho_cand(yes, N, O, [rc(rho(N?), O?)]).
rho_cand(no, _, _, []).
%% Whether no request of the agent to itself of the class I is pending: "where it is free for [t] and no such request is pending at it" (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation").  A request of {[t]} is recorded by the term of the part it names, one(C), so that it is proposed on, and shown in the view, by its name (Section 5.4: "the requests by their names"; "of the class of a pending request, only the parts that request names"), and it is of the class of that term.
procedure self_request(Info?, St?, YesNo).
self_request(I, St, NPd?) :- ground(I?), ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    app_recs(Ap?, Rc),
    class_request0(Rc?, I?, Pd),
    neg(Pd?, NPd).
procedure class_request0(Recs?, Info?, YesNo).
class_request0(R, I, B?) :- ground(R?) | class_request(R?, I?, R?, B).
procedure class_request(Recs?, Info?, Recs?, YesNo).
class_request([], _, _, no).
class_request([requested(one(C), K)|Rs], I, R, B?) :- ground(C?), ground(I?), ground(R?), integer(K?) |
    mem(ended(one(C?), K?), R?, Done),
    neg(Done?, Open),
    term_of_class(C?, I?, Of),
    and(Open?, Of?, P),
    class_request1(P?, Rs?, I?, R?, B).
class_request([_|Rs], I, R, B?) :- otherwise | class_request(Rs?, I?, R?, B).
procedure class_request1(YesNo?, Recs?, Info?, Recs?, YesNo).
class_request1(yes, _, _, _, yes).
class_request1(no, Rs, I, R, B?) :- class_request(Rs?, I?, R?, B).
procedure self_cand(YesNo?, Class?, Peer?, RCands).
self_cand(yes, C, Id, [rc(one(C?), Id?)]).
self_cand(no, _, _, []).
%% A request pending at the agent: recorded requested(Rho, K) and not ended(Rho, K).
procedure pending_request(Rho?, Recs?, YesNo).
pending_request(R, Rc, B?) :- ground(Rc?) | pending_request1(Rc?, R?, Rc?, B).
procedure pending_request1(Recs?, Rho?, Recs?, YesNo).
pending_request1([], _, _, no).
pending_request1([requested(R1, K)|Rs], R, Rc, B?) :- ground(R1?), ground(R?), ground(Rc?), integer(K?) |
    same(R1?, R?, Sm),
    mem(ended(R1?, K?), Rc?, En),
    neg(En?, NEn),
    and(Sm?, NEn?, P),
    pending_request2(P?, Rs?, R?, Rc?, B).
pending_request1([_|Rs], R, Rc, B?) :- otherwise | pending_request1(Rs?, R?, Rc?, B).
procedure pending_request2(YesNo?, Recs?, Rho?, Recs?, YesNo).
pending_request2(yes, _, _, _, yes).
pending_request2(no, Rs, R, Rc, B?) :- pending_request1(Rs?, R?, Rc?, B).
%% Free for every class of rho_N: the lock unset and no question pending of a class of rho_N.
procedure free_rho(Proposal?, St?, YesNo).
free_rho(N, St, B?) :- ground(N?), ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    app_lock_recs(Ap?, L, R),
    st_id(St?, Id),
    free_rho1(L?, R?, N?, Id?, St?, B).
procedure free_rho1(Lock?, Recs?, Proposal?, Peer?, St?, YesNo).
free_rho1(L, R, N, Id, St, B?) :- ground(R?) |
    unlocked(L?, U),
    no_rho_question(R?, N?, Id?, St?, R?, Q),
    and(U?, Q?, B).
procedure no_rho_question(Recs?, Proposal?, Peer?, St?, Recs?, YesNo).
no_rho_question([], _, _, _, _, yes).
no_rho_question([asked(At)|Rs], N, Id, St, R, B?) :- ground(At?), ground(N?), ground(Id?), ground(R?) |
    pending_rec(At?, R?, P),
    rho_question(P?, At?, N?, Id?, St?, Q, St1),
    no_rho_question1(Q?, Rs?, N?, Id?, St1?, R?, B).
no_rho_question([_|Rs], N, Id, St, R, B?) :- otherwise | no_rho_question(Rs?, N?, Id?, St?, R?, B).
%% A question pending, and only then its class, which Start found and the state keeps, read from the state, which is given back: whether it is a class of rho_N.
procedure rho_question(YesNo?, Attempt?, Proposal?, Peer?, St?, YesNo, St).
rho_question(no, _, _, _, St, no, St?).
rho_question(yes, At, N, Id, St, Q?, St1?) :-
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    st_class(C?, St?, Cr, St1),
    cls_in_rho(Cr?, N?, Id?, Q).
procedure no_rho_question1(YesNo?, Recs?, Proposal?, Peer?, St?, Recs?, YesNo).
no_rho_question1(yes, _, _, _, _, _, no).
no_rho_question1(no, Rs, N, Id, St, R, B?) :- no_rho_question(Rs?, N?, Id?, St?, R?, B).
procedure cls_in_rho(ClassRes?, Proposal?, Peer?, YesNo).
cls_in_rho(nocls, _, _, no).
cls_in_rho(cls(I), N, Id, B?) :- in_rho(I?, N?, Id?, B).
%% Whether the class I is a class of rho_N: a guarded part of it with an opener is named N, one of the schema-bindings that determine the part having the request name N (request_name; Definition "Effective Local Specification": "whether a class is in rho_N being decidable from a part of it and N").
procedure in_rho(Info?, Proposal?, Peer?, YesNo).
in_rho(ci(_, _, Q, Pts, Ms), N, Id, B?) :- ground(Q?), ground(Ms?), ground(N?) |
    opener_parts(Pts?, Q?, Ms?, N?, Id?, B).
procedure opener_parts(Parts?, Peers?, Mates?, Proposal?, Peer?, YesNo).
opener_parts([], _, _, _, _, no).
opener_parts([pt(T, G, opener(_))|Ps], Q, Ms, N, Id, B?) :-
    ground(T?), ground(G?), ground(Q?), ground(Ms?), ground(N?) |
    part_named(Ms?, T?, G?, Q?, N?, Id?, B1),
    opener_parts1(B1?, Ps?, Q?, Ms?, N?, Id?, B).
opener_parts([pt(_, _, guarded_part)|Ps], Q, Ms, N, Id, B?) :- opener_parts(Ps?, Q?, Ms?, N?, Id?, B).
procedure opener_parts1(YesNo?, Parts?, Peers?, Mates?, Proposal?, Peer?, YesNo).
opener_parts1(yes, _, _, _, _, _, yes).
opener_parts1(no, Ps, Q, Ms, N, Id, B?) :- opener_parts(Ps?, Q?, Ms?, N?, Id?, B).
procedure part_named(Mates?, Class?, Peers?, Peers?, Proposal?, Peer?, YesNo).
part_named([], _, _, _, _, _, no).
part_named([mate(Nm, Bn, G1, _)|Ms], T, G, Q, N, Id, B?) :-
    ground(Nm?), ground(Bn?), ground(G1?), ground(T?), ground(G?), ground(Q?), ground(N?) |
    binding_of(T?, Nm2, Bn2),
    same_bpart(Q?, Nm?, Bn?, G1?, Nm2?, Bn2?, G?, Sp),
    class_of(Nm?, Bn?, Id?, C),
    request_name(C?, Pn),
    pname_is(Pn?, N?, Nn),
    and(Sp?, Nn?, B1),
    part_named1(B1?, Ms?, T?, G?, Q?, N?, Id?, B).
procedure part_named1(YesNo?, Mates?, Class?, Peers?, Peers?, Proposal?, Peer?, YesNo).
part_named1(yes, _, _, _, _, _, _, yes).
part_named1(no, Ms, T, G, Q, N, Id, B?) :- part_named(Ms?, T?, G?, Q?, N?, Id?, B).
procedure pname_is(PName?, Proposal?, YesNo).
pname_is(pname(M), N, B?) :- same(M?, N?, B).
pname_is(nopname, _, no).
%% The part of the class I that the schema-binding the term C names determines.
procedure term_part_of(Info?, Class?, PartRes).
term_part_of(I, C, Pr?) :- ground(I?), ground(C?) |
    info_parts(I?, Pts),
    term_part_of1(Pts?, I?, C?, Pr).
procedure term_part_of1(Parts?, Info?, Class?, PartRes).
term_part_of1([], _, _, nopart).
term_part_of1([pt(T, G, Op)|Ps], I, C, Pr?) :- ground(T?), ground(G?), ground(Op?), ground(I?), ground(C?) |
    same_part(I?, C?, T?, B),
    term_part_of2(B?, pt(T?, G?, Op?), Ps?, I?, C?, Pr).
procedure term_part_of2(YesNo?, Part?, Parts?, Info?, Class?, PartRes).
term_part_of2(yes, P, _, _, _, part(P?)).
term_part_of2(no, _, Ps, I, C, Pr?) :- term_part_of1(Ps?, I?, C?, Pr).
%% Of the candidate Requests, the one the agent has taken least recently: one never taken before one taken, and of those taken, the one taken longest ago, the requests the agent has made being in the order it last made them; ties to the first.  Where there is none: the request held, rhold(N), where the agent is not free for a class of its Request; and otherwise dropped, rdrop, or, where the agent is ready for no part named N that it guards or opens, dropped with the notice refused(N, p, unable), rrefuse(N) (vGLP e286276, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "where the agent is not free for a class of such a Request, it holds the request and puts it up again after every dispatch; and it drops the request where the agent is free and none is enabled, with a notice refused(N, p, unable) where the agent is ready for no part named N that it guards or opens").
procedure pick_request(RQ?, Proposal?, Class?, Rhos?, RCond).
pick_request(rq([X|Xs], _, _), _, _, Md, Cd?) :- ground(Md?) |
    least_rcand(Xs?, Md?, X?, Y),
    rcand_go(Y?, Cd).
pick_request(rq([], yes, _), N, _, _, rhold(N?)).
pick_request(rq([], no, yes), _, _, _, rdrop).
pick_request(rq([], no, no), N, _, _, rrefuse(N?)).
procedure least_rcand(RCands?, Rhos?, RCand?, RCand).
least_rcand([], _, Y, Y?).
least_rcand([X|Xs], Md, Y, Z?) :- ground(X?), ground(Y?), ground(Md?) |
    rcand_place(X?, Md?, AX),
    rcand_place(Y?, Md?, AY),
    less_int(AX?, AY?, L),
    least_rcand1(L?, X?, Y?, Xs?, Md?, Z).
procedure least_rcand1(YesNo?, RCand?, RCand?, RCands?, Rhos?, RCand).
least_rcand1(yes, X, _, Xs, Md, Z?) :- least_rcand(Xs?, Md?, X?, Z).
least_rcand1(no, _, Y, Xs, Md, Z?) :- least_rcand(Xs?, Md?, Y?, Z).
procedure rcand_place(RCand?, Rhos?, Integer).
rcand_place(rc(R, _), Md, A?) :- rho_place(Md?, R?, 1, A).
procedure rho_place(Rhos?, Rho?, Integer?, Integer).
rho_place([], _, _, 0).
rho_place([X|Xs], R, K, A?) :- ground(X?), ground(R?), integer(K?) |
    same(X?, R?, Sm),
    rho_place1(Sm?, Xs?, R?, K?, A).
procedure rho_place1(YesNo?, Rhos?, Rho?, Integer?, Integer).
rho_place1(yes, _, _, K, K?).
rho_place1(no, Xs, R, K, A?) :- K1 := K? + 1, rho_place(Xs?, R?, K1?, A).
procedure less_int(Integer?, Integer?, YesNo).
less_int(A, B, yes) :- A? < B? | true.
less_int(A, B, no) :- A? >= B? | true.
procedure rcand_go(RCand?, RCond).
rcand_go(rc(R, O), rgo(R?, O?)).

procedure dispatch_request(RCond?, Then?, App?, Stream(Trigger)?,
    Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger), Stream(Output), Stream(Net),
    Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
dispatch_request(rgo(R, O), Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(R?), ground(St?) |
    request_effect(R?, O?, St?, Ss, St1),
    send_all(Ss?, St1?, Ms, St2),
    put_all(Ms?, Out, Out1?),
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out1, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St2?).
dispatch_request(rdrop, Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).
dispatch_request(rhold(N), Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(N?), ground(St?) |
    st_reqs(St?, Rq),
    remove_all(N?, Rq?, Rq1),
    app(Rq1?, [N?], Rq2),
    set_reqs(St?, Rq2?, St1),
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St1?).
dispatch_request(rrefuse(N), Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(N?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    next_n(Th?, no, Ap0?, [refused(N?, Id?, unable)], Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).

%% Request rho to O: the agent's number one more, the new value the request's number K; requested(rho, K) recorded; the request noted last among those the agent has made; and, where O is not the agent, request(rho, K) sent to O (Definition "Proposing", Request).
procedure request_effect(Rho?, Peer?, St?, Sends, St).
request_effect(R, O, St, Ss?, St2?) :- ground(R?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    request_app(R?, Ap?, K, Ap1),
    request_sends(O?, Id?, R?, K?, Ss),
    set_app(St?, Ap1?, St1),
    note_made(R?, St1?, St2).
procedure request_app(Rho?, App?, Integer, App).
request_app(R, app(S, K, L, Rc), K1?, app(S?, K2?, L?, [requested(R?, K3?)|Rc?])) :- integer(K?) |
    K1 := K? + 1,
    K2 := K? + 1,
    K3 := K? + 1.
procedure request_sends(Peer?, Peer?, Rho?, Integer?, Sends).
request_sends(O, Id, _, _, []) :- O? =?= Id? | true.
request_sends(O, _, R, K, [to(O?, request(R?, K?))]) :- otherwise | true.
%% The requests the agent has made, R put last and its earlier place dropped.
procedure note_made(Rho?, St?, St).
note_made(R, St, St1?) :- ground(R?), ground(St?) |
    st_made(St?, Md),
    remove_all(R?, Md?, Md1),
    app(Md1?, [R?], Md2),
    set_made(St?, Md2?, St1).

%% --- Propose, an own transaction ---------------------------------------------
%% The Propose of the part P of the class I, its attempt naming Nm (Definition "Proposing", Propose), taken on an own trigger (own_cond): its effect, and on it the views and notices written.
procedure dispatch_propose(PCond?, Then?, App?, Stream(Trigger)?,
    Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger), Stream(Output), Stream(Net),
    Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
dispatch_propose(pgo(I, P, Nm), Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(I?), ground(P?), ground(Nm?), ground(St?) |
    propose_effect(I?, P?, Nm?, St?, Ss, Ns, St1),
    send_all(Ss?, St1?, Ms, St2),
    put_all(Ms?, Out, Out1?),
    next_n(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ns?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out1, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St2?).
dispatch_propose(pdrop, Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).

%% The words of the first question whose role holds the agent Me, and none, [], where none does.
procedure ask_of(List(RoleAsk)?, Peer?, List(Word)).
ask_of([], _, []).
ask_of([q(P, Ws)|_], Me, Ws?) :- P? =?= Me? | true.
ask_of([_|Qs], Me, Ws?) :- otherwise | ask_of(Qs?, Me?, Ws).

%% --- Discover: the hellos ---------------------------------------------------
%% A peer is known once hello has been sent to it and received from it.  On the request propose(N), N the request name of an acquaintance part with a peer Q, the agent goal, besides what it does on any request, sends Q hello carrying N and records Q as sent to, unless Q is known or already sent to (meet_hello).  On an arriving hello from Q it records Q as received from and, unless it has sent Q a hello, asks its person the approval question of the clause of N, with its pragma, by a goal that shows Q and takes yes or no: the person's yes is their request propose(N) with Q, which the agent goal reads as any request, and on their no it does nothing (greet_unless).  Where a peer becomes known the agent goal writes the new view on the output (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation").  A contract with no guarded part has no acquaintance part, and its agents send no hello.
procedure meet_hello(MeetPeer?, Proposal?, St?, Stream(Net), Stream(Net)?,
    Stream(Output), Stream(Output)?, St).
meet_hello(nopeer, _, St, Out1?, Out1, Thr1?, Thr1, St?).
meet_hello(peer(Q), N, St, Out?, Out1, Thr?, Thr1, St1?) :- ground(Q?), ground(N?), ground(St?) |
    known_st(Q?, St?, K),
    st_sent(St?, Se),
    mem(Q?, Se?, S),
    or(K?, S?, B),
    meet_hello1(B?, Q?, N?, St?, Out, Out1?, Thr, Thr1?, St1).
procedure meet_hello1(YesNo?, Peer?, Proposal?, St?, Stream(Net), Stream(Net)?,
    Stream(Output), Stream(Output)?, St).
meet_hello1(yes, _, _, St, Out1?, Out1, Thr1?, Thr1, St?).
meet_hello1(no, Q, N, St, [msg(Q?, hello(Id?, N?))|Out1?], Out1, Thr?, Thr1, St2?) :-
    ground(Q?), ground(N?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    add_sent(Q?, St?, St1),
    show_known(Q?, St?, St1?, Thr, Thr1?, St2).
%% The peer of an acquaintance part whose two roles hold A and B, beside the agent Me (meeting_peer): the other, where Me holds one of them and another person the other; none otherwise.
procedure meet_other(Peer?, Peer?, Peer?, MeetPeer).
meet_other(A, B, Me, P?) :- ground(A?), ground(B?), ground(Me?) |
    same(A?, Me?, SA),
    same(B?, Me?, SB),
    meet_other1(SA?, SB?, A?, B?, P).
procedure meet_other1(YesNo?, YesNo?, Peer?, Peer?, MeetPeer).
meet_other1(yes, no, _, B, peer(B?)).
meet_other1(no, yes, A, _, peer(A?)).
meet_other1(yes, yes, _, _, nopeer).
meet_other1(no, no, _, _, nopeer).

%% An arriving hello, recorded unless recorded already.
procedure hello_cond(Peer?, St?, YesNo).
hello_cond(P, St, R?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_recd(St?, Rc),
    mem(P?, Rc?, B),
    neg(B?, R).

procedure dispatch_hello(YesNo?, Peer?, Proposal?, Then?, App?, Stream(Trigger)?,
    Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger), Stream(Output), Stream(Net),
    Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
dispatch_hello(yes, P, N, Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(P?), ground(N?), ground(St?) |
    st_sent(St?, Se),
    mem(P?, Se?, Sent),
    add_recd(P?, St?, St1),
    show_known(P?, St?, St1?, Thr, Thr1?, St2),
    greet_unless(Sent?, P?, N?, St2?, Ans, Ans1?, St3),
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans1, Thr1, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St3?).
dispatch_hello(no, _, _, Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).
%% The approval question of the acquaintance a hello from P carries, N, asked unless the agent has sent P a hello, its answers joining the agent goal's input; with pragmas, with the sentence of the clause of N, Me the agent, as sentence_of gives it for the class N names at its machine state.
procedure greet_unless(YesNo?, Peer?, Proposal?, St?, Stream(Trigger), Stream(Trigger)?, St).
greet_unless(yes, _, _, St, Ans1?, Ans1, St?).
greet_unless(no, P, N, St, Ans?, Ans1, St?) :- ground(P?), ground(N?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Me),
    st_ms(St?, S),
    name_class(N?, S?, C),
    sentence_of(C?, Me?, Ws),
    greet(P?, N?, Ws?, R),
    merge(R?, Ans1?, Ans).

%% --- Introduce: the ihellos --------------------------------------------------
%% On reading an introduction intro(Q) the agent sends Q ihello, unless Q is itself or known or it has sent one; an arriving ihello is recorded; and where a peer becomes known by the two the agent writes the new view on the output (Section 5.4).
procedure intro_cond(Peer?, St?, YesNo).
intro_cond(Q, St, R?) :- ground(Q?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    st_isent(St?, ISe),
    same(Q?, Id?, S1),
    mem(Q?, ISe?, S2),
    known_st(Q?, St?, S3),
    or(S1?, S2?, S12),
    or(S12?, S3?, S),
    neg(S?, R).

procedure dispatch_intro(YesNo?, Peer?, Then?, App?, Stream(Trigger)?,
    Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger), Stream(Output), Stream(Net),
    Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
dispatch_intro(yes, Q, Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, [msg(Q?, ihello(Id?))|Out?],
        Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(Q?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    add_isent(Q?, St?, St1),
    show_known(Q?, St?, St1?, Thr, Thr1?, St2),
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr1, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St2?).
dispatch_intro(no, _, Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).

procedure ihello_cond(Peer?, St?, YesNo).
ihello_cond(P, St, R?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_irecd(St?, Rc),
    mem(P?, Rc?, B),
    neg(B?, R).

procedure dispatch_ihello(YesNo?, Peer?, Then?, App?, Stream(Trigger)?,
    Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger), Stream(Output), Stream(Net),
    Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
dispatch_ihello(yes, P, Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(P?), ground(St?) |
    add_irecd(P?, St?, St1),
    show_known(P?, St?, St1?, Thr, Thr1?, St2),
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr1, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St2?).
dispatch_ihello(no, _, Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).

%% --- Start, Tally, Yield and Outcome, on the arriving message ---------------
%% One schema to a cargo, none needing a peer known: the initiator's hello
%% precedes its start on one stream, and an initiator knows every other
%% participant from its Propose.  Start is taken where the
%% start does not wait or its attempt is closed at the agent, and otherwise
%% the agent holds it waiting (Definition "Priority, Waiting, Blocked,
%% Clear"), putting it up again, by a
%% recheck, after every dispatch that changes the app state or consumes a
%% start.  A request, request(Rho, K), is held, mhold, until the refusal of an
%% attempt naming it or a commit of its class (vGLP f0acbc1, Section 5.4,
%% "The compilation": "On a message request(rho, k) it holds the request until
%% it deletes it").
procedure message_cond(Cargo?, St?, MCond, St).
message_cond(request(_, _), St, mhold, St?).
message_cond(start(At), St, Cd?, St1?) :- ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    st_class(C?, St?, R, St0),
    message_cond1(R?, start(At?), St0?, Cd, St1).
message_cond(vote(At, V), St, Cd?, St1?) :- ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    st_class(C?, St?, R, St0),
    message_cond1(R?, vote(At?, V?), St0?, Cd, St1).
message_cond(yield(At), St, Cd?, St1?) :- ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    st_class(C?, St?, R, St0),
    message_cond1(R?, yield(At?), St0?, Cd, St1).
message_cond(outcome(At, Z), St, Cd?, St1?) :- ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    st_class(C?, St?, R, St0),
    message_cond1(R?, outcome(At?, Z?), St0?, Cd, St1).
procedure message_cond1(ClassRes?, Cargo?, St?, MCond, St).
%% A cargo reaches only a participant of its attempt, so its class is always
%% one the agent takes part in; noparticipant, the other alternative of ClassRes,
%% which the type requires covered, is never reached; nor is a request, which
%% message_cond holds.
message_cond1(nocls, _, St, noparticipant, St?).
message_cond1(_, request(_, _), St, mhold, St?).
message_cond1(cls(I), start(At), St, Cd?, St?) :- ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    st_closed(At?, St?, Cl),
    start_cond(Cl?, I?, At?, St?, Cd).
message_cond1(cls(I), vote(_, _), St, mgo(I?), St?).
message_cond1(cls(I), yield(_), St, mgo(I?), St?).
message_cond1(cls(I), outcome(_, _), St, mgo(I?), St?).
procedure start_cond(YesNo?, Info?, Attempt?, St?, MCond).
start_cond(yes, I, _, _, mgo(I?)).
start_cond(no, I, At, St, Cd?) :- ground(I?) |
    start_waits(I?, At?, St?, W),
    defer_cond1(W?, I?, Cd).
procedure defer_cond1(YesNo?, Info?, MCond).
defer_cond1(yes, _, mdefer).
defer_cond1(no, I, mgo(I?)).

%% A start of A, of the class I, waits while a start of an attempt with
%% priority over A is held, or a question with priority over A and answered
%% yes is pending, or while the agent is not free for the class.
procedure start_waits(Info?, Attempt?, St?, YesNo).
start_waits(I, A, St, W?) :- st_view(St?, V), start_waits_v(I?, A?, V?, W).
procedure start_waits_v(Info?, Attempt?, V?, YesNo).
start_waits_v(I, A, V, W?) :- ground(A?), ground(V?) |
    v_pends(V?, Pd),
    held_prior(Pd?, A?, W1),
    v_recs(V?, R),
    question_prior(R?, A?, W2),
    free_v(I?, V?, Fr),
    neg(Fr?, W3),
    or(W1?, W2?, W12),
    or(W12?, W3?, W).
procedure held_prior(Pends?, Attempt?, YesNo).
held_prior([], _, no).
held_prior([deferred(msg(_, cargo(_, start(B))))|Ps], A, W?) :- ground(A?), ground(B?) |
    same(A?, B?, Sm),
    prio(B?, A?, Pr),
    neg(Sm?, NSm),
    and(NSm?, Pr?, W1),
    held_prior1(W1?, Ps?, A?, W).
held_prior([_|Ps], A, W?) :- otherwise | held_prior(Ps?, A?, W).
procedure held_prior1(YesNo?, Pends?, Attempt?, YesNo).
held_prior1(yes, _, _, yes).
held_prior1(no, Ps, A, W?) :- held_prior(Ps?, A?, W).
%% A question pending, answered yes, other than A and with priority over it.
procedure question_prior(Recs?, Attempt?, YesNo).
question_prior(R, A, W?) :- ground(R?) | question_prior1(R?, R?, A?, W).
procedure question_prior1(Recs?, Recs?, Attempt?, YesNo).
question_prior1([], _, _, no).
question_prior1([answered(G, yes)|Rs], R, A, W?) :- ground(G?), ground(R?), ground(A?) |
    pending_rec(G?, R?, P),
    same(G?, A?, Sm),
    neg(Sm?, NSm),
    prio(G?, A?, Pr),
    and(P?, NSm?, W0),
    and(W0?, Pr?, W1),
    question_prior2(W1?, Rs?, R?, A?, W).
question_prior1([_|Rs], R, A, W?) :- otherwise | question_prior1(Rs?, R?, A?, W).
procedure question_prior2(YesNo?, Recs?, Recs?, Attempt?, YesNo).
question_prior2(yes, _, _, _, yes).
question_prior2(no, Rs, R, A, W?) :- question_prior1(Rs?, R?, A?, W).
%% A question pending and answered yes waits while one with priority over it
%% and answered yes is pending, or while the lock is set.
procedure question_waits(Attempt?, V?, YesNo).
question_waits(A, v(_, _, L, R, _, _), W?) :-
    question_prior(R?, A?, W1),
    unlocked(L?, U),
    neg(U?, W2),
    or(W1?, W2?, W).
procedure app_lock_recs(App?, Lock, Recs).
app_lock_recs(app(_, _, L, R), L?, R?).
%% Free for the class: the lock unset and no question of the class pending.
procedure free_i(Info?, St?, YesNo).
free_i(I, st(_, app(_, _, L, R), _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _), B?) :- free_lr(I?, L?, R?, B).
procedure free_v(Info?, V?, YesNo).
free_v(I, v(_, _, L, R, _, _), B?) :- free_lr(I?, L?, R?, B).
procedure free_lr(Info?, Lock?, Recs?, YesNo).
free_lr(I, L, R, B?) :- ground(R?) |
    unlocked(L?, B1),
    no_question(I?, R?, R?, B2),
    and(B1?, B2?, B).
%% What blocks a waiting start of the class I: the lock where set, and
%% otherwise the question of I pending; and a question answered yes: the lock.
procedure start_blocker(YesNo?, Info?, V?, Blocker).
start_blocker(no, _, _, noblk).
start_blocker(yes, I, v(_, _, L, R, _, _), Bk?) :- start_blocker1(L?, I?, R?, Bk).
procedure start_blocker1(Lock?, Info?, Recs?, Blocker).
start_blocker1(held(B), _, _, blk(B?)).
start_blocker1(unlocked, I, R, Bk?) :- ground(R?) | class_question(R?, I?, R?, Bk).
procedure class_question(Recs?, Info?, Recs?, Blocker).
class_question([], _, _, noblk).
class_question([asked(G)|Rs], I, R, Bk?) :- ground(G?), ground(I?), ground(R?) |
    pending_rec(G?, R?, P),
    of_class(G?, I?, Cl),
    and(P?, Cl?, B),
    class_question1(B?, G?, Rs?, I?, R?, Bk).
class_question([_|Rs], I, R, Bk?) :- otherwise | class_question(Rs?, I?, R?, Bk).
procedure class_question1(YesNo?, Attempt?, Recs?, Info?, Recs?, Blocker).
class_question1(yes, G, _, _, _, blk(G?)).
class_question1(no, _, Rs, I, R, Bk?) :- class_question(Rs?, I?, R?, Bk).
procedure question_blocker(YesNo?, V?, Blocker).
question_blocker(no, _, noblk).
question_blocker(yes, v(_, _, L, _, _, _), Bk?) :- lock_blocker(L?, Bk).
procedure lock_blocker(Lock?, Blocker).
lock_blocker(held(B), blk(B?)).
lock_blocker(unlocked, noblk).
%% Priority: the smaller rank first, ties broken by the order of identifiers.
procedure prio(Attempt?, Attempt?, YesNo).
prio(A, B, P?) :- ground(A?), ground(B?) |
    attempt_rank(A?, RA),
    attempt_rank(B?, RB),
    attempt_id(A?, IA),
    attempt_id(B?, IB),
    prio1(RA?, RB?, IA?, IB?, P).
procedure prio1(Integer?, Integer?, Peer?, Peer?, YesNo).
prio1(RA, RB, _, _, yes) :- RA? < RB? | true.
prio1(RA, RB, _, _, no) :- RA? > RB? | true.
prio1(RA, RB, IA, IB, P?) :- RA? =:= RB? | precedes(IA?, IB?, P).



%% The recheck, after a dispatch that changes the app state or consumes a
%% start: the first start held that does not wait, or whose attempt is
%% closed, is put up, and taken; none, nothing.
procedure recheck_find(Pends?, V?, Trie?, St?, FoundNet).
recheck_find([], _, _, _, nonefound).
recheck_find([deferred(M)|Ps], V, Tr, St, F?) :- ground(M?), ground(V?) |
    held_takeable(M?, V?, Tr?, St?, T, Tr1, St1),
    recheck_find1(T?, M?, Ps?, V?, Tr1?, St1?, F).
recheck_find([_|Ps], V, Tr, St, F?) :- otherwise | recheck_find(Ps?, V?, Tr?, St?, F).
