procedure recheck_find1(YesNo?, Net?, Pends?, V?, Trie?, St?, FoundNet).
recheck_find1(yes, M, _, _, _, _, found(M?)).
recheck_find1(no, _, Ps, V, Tr, St, F?) :- recheck_find(Ps?, V?, Tr?, St?, F).
%% A start held is taken where its attempt is closed or it does not wait; its class, which Start found and the state keeps, read from the state, which is given back.
procedure held_takeable(Net?, V?, Trie?, St?, YesNo, Trie, St).
held_takeable(msg(_, cargo(_, start(A))), V, Tr, St, T?, Tr1?, St1?) :- ground(A?) |
    attempt_class(A?, C),
    st_class(C?, St?, Cr, St1),
    held_takeable1(Cr?, A?, V?, Tr?, T, Tr1).
held_takeable(_, _, Tr, St, no, Tr?, St?) :- otherwise | true.
procedure held_takeable1(ClassRes?, Attempt?, V?, Trie?, YesNo, Trie).
held_takeable1(nocls, _, _, Tr, no, Tr?).
held_takeable1(cls(I), A, V, Tr, T?, Tr1?) :- ground(A?), ground(V?) |
    v_recs(V?, R),
    trie_closed(A?, R?, Tr?, Cl, Tr1),
    start_waits_v(I?, A?, V?, W),
    neg(W?, NW),
    or(Cl?, NW?, T).
procedure recheck1(FoundNet?, Then?, Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger)?,
    Stream(Trigger), Stream(Output), Stream(Net), Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
recheck1(found(M), Th, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    step(net(M?), Th?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).
recheck1(nonefound, Th, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :- ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap0),
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).

procedure dispatch_message(MCond?, Net?, Peer?, Cargo?, Then?, App?,
    Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger),
    Stream(Output), Stream(Net), Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
dispatch_message(noparticipant, _, _, _, Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).
dispatch_message(mdefer, M, _, _, Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H,
        St) :-
    add_pend_once(deferred(M?), St?, St1),
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St1?).
dispatch_message(mgo(I), M, _, start(At), Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?,
        Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Me),
    drop_pend(deferred(M?), St?, St0),
    start_effect(I?, At?, St0?, Ss, Cr, Ns, St1),
    send_all(Ss?, St1?, Ms, St2),
    put_all(Ms?, Out, Out1?),
    spawn(Cr?, Me?, Approvals?, Approvals1, Ans, Ans1?),
    next_n(Th?, yes, Ap0?, Ns?, Ls?, In?, Ans1, Thr, Out1, Ow, Approvals1?, H?, St2?).
dispatch_message(mgo(I), _, F, vote(At, V), Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?,
        Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(At?) |
    tally_effect(I?, At?, F?, V?, St?, Ss, Ns, St1),
    send_all(Ss?, St1?, Ms, St2),
    put_all(Ms?, Out, Out1?),
    next_n(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ns?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out1, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St2?).
dispatch_message(mgo(I), _, _, yield(At), Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?,
        Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(At?) |
    yield_effect(I?, At?, St?, Ss, St1),
    send_all(Ss?, St1?, Ms, St2),
    put_all(Ms?, Out, Out1?),
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out1, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St2?).
dispatch_message(mgo(I), _, _, outcome(At, Z), Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?,
        Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(At?) |
    outcome_effect(I?, At?, Z?, St?, Ns, Ms, St1),
    put_all(Ms?, Out, Out1?),
    next_n(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ns?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out1, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St1?).
dispatch_message(mhold, _, F, request(R, K), Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?,
        Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    hold_request(F?, R?, K?, St?, St1),
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St1?).
%% A request held, held(Q, Rho, K), once, after those held before it.
procedure hold_request(Peer?, Rho?, Integer?, St?, St).
hold_request(F, R, K, St, St1?) :- ground(R?), ground(St?) |
    st_held(St?, Hd),
    hold_once(held(F?, R?, K?), Hd?, Hd1),
    set_held(St?, Hd1?, St1).
procedure hold_once(Held?, Helds?, Helds).
hold_once(X, Hd, Hd1?) :- ground(X?), ground(Hd?) |
    mem(X?, Hd?, In),
    hold_once1(In?, X?, Hd?, Hd1).
procedure hold_once1(YesNo?, Held?, Helds?, Helds).
hold_once1(yes, _, Hd, Hd?).
hold_once1(no, X, Hd, Hd1?) :- app(Hd?, [X?], Hd1).

%% Start raises the approval question, whose answers join the agent goal's input.
%% With pragmas, the question carries the sentence the contract puts to the agent's role, Me the agent, as sentence_of gives it for the part of the attempt (vGLP, Section 6.2, "The words a platform shows").
procedure spawn(ApprovalRes?, Peer?, OpenApprovals?, OpenApprovals, Stream(Trigger),
    Stream(Trigger)?).
spawn(noapproval, _, Cs, Cs?, Ans?, Ans).
spawn(approval_for(At), Me, Cs, [oc(At?, Cl)|Cs?], Ans?, Ans1) :- ground(At?) |
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    sentence_of(C?, Me?, Ws),
    respond(At?, Ws?, Cl?, R),
    merge(R?, Ans1?, Ans).

%% --- Answer, on the person's answer to the approval question Start raises ---------------
%% Its condition: the attempt a question pending at the agent, and no answer
%% to it recorded.  It sends nothing, so it needs no peer known.  It is taken
%% where its condition holds, and the answer dropped otherwise.
procedure answer_cond(Attempt?, St?, Cond, St).
answer_cond(At, St, Cd?, St2?) :- ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    st_class(C?, St?, R, St1),
    answer_cond1(R?, At?, St1?, Cd, St2).
procedure answer_cond1(ClassRes?, Attempt?, St?, Cond, St).
answer_cond1(nocls, _, St, drop, St?).
answer_cond1(cls(I), At, St, Cd?, St?) :- ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    app_recs(Ap?, R),
    unanswered(At?, R?, Ok),
    go_or_drop(Ok?, I?, Cd).
procedure unanswered(Attempt?, Recs?, YesNo).
unanswered(At, R, B?) :- ground(At?), ground(R?) |
    pending_rec(At?, R?, P),
    has_answer(At?, R?, H),
    neg(H?, Un),
    and(P?, Un?, B).

procedure dispatch_answer(Cond?, YesNo?, Attempt?, Then?, App?, Stream(Trigger)?,
    Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger), Stream(Output), Stream(Net),
    Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
dispatch_answer(go(_), YN, At, Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(At?) |
    answer_effect(YN?, At?, St?, St1),
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St1?).
dispatch_answer(drop, _, _, Th, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    next(Th?, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).

%% An approval question is closed by binding its close signal, which also forgets it.
procedure close_approval(Attempt?, OpenApprovals?, OpenApprovals).
close_approval(_, [], []).
close_approval(At, [oc(B, close)|Cs], Cs?) :- At? =?= B? | true.
close_approval(At, [oc(B, Cl?)|Cs], [oc(B?, Cl)|Cs1?]) :- otherwise |
    close_approval(At?, Cs?, Cs1).

%% The approval questions whose question is no longer pending, closed, where the app state
%% has changed.
procedure close_falsified(YesNo?, OpenApprovals?, St?, OpenApprovals).
close_falsified(no, Cs, _, Cs?).
close_falsified(yes, Cs, St, Cs1?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    app_recs(Ap?, R),
    close_approvals(Cs?, R?, Cs1).
procedure close_approvals(OpenApprovals?, Recs?, OpenApprovals).
close_approvals([], _, []).
close_approvals([oc(At, Cl?)|Cs], R, Cs1?) :- ground(At?), ground(R?) |
    pending_rec(At?, R?, P),
    close_one(P?, At?, Cl, Cs?, R?, Cs1).
procedure close_one(YesNo?, Attempt?, Close, OpenApprovals?, Recs?, OpenApprovals).
close_one(no, _, close, Cs, R, Cs1?) :- close_approvals(Cs?, R?, Cs1).
close_one(yes, At, Cl?, Cs, R, [oc(At?, Cl)|Cs1?]) :- close_approvals(Cs?, R?, Cs1).

%% --- The own transactions: Propose, Vote, Commit, Wound, Introduce peers ---
%% On own the agent goal puts up the Propose of each unguarded part the agent opens, and of each guarded part with no opener that it guards of the class of an approval pending at it, where its machine state is in the part's domain, or, where it is in the domain of no such part of that class, of one of them, which it refuses at once; for each request it holds, the Propose of each guarded part named by the request's name that it opens and whose domain holds its machine state, naming that request, or, where there is none, of one such part, which it refuses at once; the Vote on each answered question pending at it, the Commit of each attempt it initiated with a yes of every other participant recorded, the Wound of each start it holds waiting, or answered question, blocked by an attempt over which it has priority, and the Introduce peers of each pair the introduction rule gives it at its machine state; the dispatch takes, among those whose condition holds, one of the class that has waited longest --- since it was last taken or, never taken, since its condition was first found holding --- ties broken in a fixed order: the Proposes of the unguarded parts in the order they are opened, of the guarded parts in the order of the approvals, the oldest first, and on the requests held, in the order they arrived, then the Votes, the Commits, the Wounds and the introductions, each in the order of the record, of the starts held or of identifiers; and counts it, and writes an own trigger on its stream of own triggers; and where none holds, takes nothing and writes none (vGLP f0acbc1, Section 5.4, "The compilation"; Definition "Equivalence of the Canonical Platform": "for a part [t]_j and an agent p, p's proposing class on [t]_j").
procedure take_own(Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger),
    Stream(Output), Stream(Net), Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
take_own(Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :- ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap0),
    own_cond(St?, Ch, St1),
    dispatch_own(Ch?, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St1?).

procedure own_cond(St?, Choice, St).
own_cond(St, Ch?, St2?) :- ground(St?) |
    opening(St?, Is, St1),
    own_cond1(Is?, St1?, Ch, St2).
procedure own_cond1(Infos?, St?, Choice, St).
own_cond1(Is, St, Ch?, St3?) :- ground(Is?), ground(St?) |
    st_view(St?, V),
    op_cands(Is?, V?, Cs1),
    guard_cands(St?, Csg, St1),
    held_cands(St1?, Csh, St2),
    own_cond1a(St2?, Cs1?, Csg?, Csh?, Ch, St3).
procedure own_cond1a(St?, Cands?, Cands?, Cands?, Choice, St).
own_cond1a(St, Cs1, Csg, Csh, Ch?, St5?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    app_recs(Ap?, R),
    st_view(St?, V),
    vote_cands0(R?, V?, St?, Cs2, St2),
    commit_cands_st(St2?, Cs3, St3),
    wound_cands0(St3?, Cs4, St4),
    intro_cands(St4?, Cs5, St6),
    app(Cs1?, Csg?, Ca),
    app(Ca?, Csh?, Cb),
    app(Cb?, Cs2?, C12),
    app(C12?, Cs3?, C123),
    app(C123?, Cs4?, C1234),
    app(C1234?, Cs5?, Cs),
    own_cond2(Cs?, St6?, Ch, St5).
procedure own_cond2(Cands?, St?, Choice, St).
own_cond2(Cs, St, Ch?, St2?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_waits(St?, W),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    app_recs(Ap?, R),
    st_ix(St?, Ix),
    prune_waits(W?, R?, Ix?, W0),
    st_count(St?, D),
    choose(Cs?, W0?, D?, Ch0, W1),
    set_waits(St?, W1?, St1),
    count_own(Ch0?, St1?, Ch, St2).
%% The own transaction taken, counted.
procedure count_own(Choice?, St?, Choice, St).
count_own(none, St, none, St?).
count_own(take(K, S), St, take(K?, S?), St1?) :- advance(St?, St1).

%% Propose of an unguarded part, by its opener: each unguarded part of the class I that the agent opens (opening_parts), where Propose's condition holds on the agent (may_propose) and its machine state is in the part's domain; each part the proposing class op(P), P the part's term, and the attempt naming none.
procedure op_cands(Infos?, V?, Cands).
op_cands([], _, []).
op_cands([I|Is], V, Cs?) :- ground(I?), ground(V?) |
    v_id(V?, Id),
    info_parts(I?, Pts),
    opening_parts(Pts?, Id?, Ps),
    part_cands(Ps?, I?, V?, Cs1),
    op_cands(Is?, V?, Cs2),
    app(Cs1?, Cs2?, Cs).
procedure part_cands(Classes?, Info?, V?, Cands).
part_cands([], _, _, []).
part_cands([P|Ps], I, V, Cs?) :- ground(P?), ground(I?), ground(V?) |
    may_propose(I?, V?, B1),
    v_id(V?, Id),
    v_ms(V?, S),
    part_dom(P?, Id?, S?, B2),
    and(B1?, B2?, B),
    part_cands(Ps?, I?, V?, Cs1),
    keep_pcand(B?, I?, P?, none, Cs1?, Cs).
procedure keep_pcand(YesNo?, Info?, Class?, Names?, Cands?, Cands).
keep_pcand(yes, I, P, Nm, Cs, [cand(op(P?), prop(I?, P?, Nm?))|Cs?]) :- ground(P?) | true.
keep_pcand(no, _, _, _, Cs, Cs?).
%% Propose's condition on the agent, the part's domain aside (Definition "Proposing", Propose): free for the class, so unlocked, and clear, and knowing every other participant, to each of whom it tells the start, or the outcome where it refuses at once.
procedure may_propose(Info?, V?, YesNo).
may_propose(I, V, B?) :- ground(I?), ground(V?) |
    free_v(I?, V?, Fr),
    no_prior_start(V?, Np),
    others_known(I?, V?, K),
    known_ok(K?, Kn),
    and(Fr?, Np?, B1),
    and(B1?, Kn?, B).

%% Propose of a guarded part with no opener that the agent guards, of the class of an approval pending at it, a request of the class or an answer yes to an attempt of it, neither ended (Definition "Cargo, App State, Question, Approval, Free, Ready"): of the class of a request, the parts the request names, and of the class of an answer yes, each such part (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "On an own trigger it puts up the Propose ... of each guarded part with no opener that it guards of the class of an approval pending at it, named by that approval where the approval is a request"); where Propose's condition holds on the agent, each of those parts whose domain holds its machine state, or, where none does, one of them, the first, which propose_effect refuses at once (Definition "Proposing", Propose: "an approval of [t] is pending at p, and s in dom(f^[t]_j_p) or s not in dom(f^[t]_j'_p) for every guarded part [t]_j' of [t] with no opener that p guards").  A request rho_N is of classes whose guarded parts that the agent guards have an opener, which proposes them (Definition "Local Specification, Part, Guard Set, Opener, Request"), so it is no approval the agent proposes on.  The approvals in their order, the oldest first, each class and its parts once.
%% An approval's class and the parts of it the agent proposes on it: ap(I, by_name(C)) for a request, the parts named as the part of the class term C is named, and ap(I, any_part) for an answer yes, every part.
Appr      ::= ap(Info, PartsOf).
Apprs     ::= [] ; [Appr | Apprs].
PartsOf   ::= by_name(Class) ; any_part.
procedure guard_cands(St?, Cands, St).
guard_cands(St, Cs?, St1?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    app_recs(Ap?, R),
    st_view(St?, V),
    approval_classes(R?, St?, Is, St1),
    guard_cands1(Is?, V?, Cs).
procedure approval_classes(Recs?, St?, Apprs, St).
approval_classes(R, St, Is?, St1?) :- ground(R?) | approval_classes1(R?, R?, St?, [], Is, St1).
procedure approval_classes1(Recs?, Recs?, St?, Apprs?, Apprs, St).
approval_classes1([], _, St, Acc, Is?, St?) :- dedup(Acc?, Is).
approval_classes1([requested(one(C), K)|Rs], R, St, Acc, Is?, St2?) :- ground(C?), ground(R?) |
    mem(ended(one(C?), K?), R?, Done),
    approval_class(Done?, C?, by_name(C?), St?, Acc?, Acc1, St1),
    approval_classes1(Rs?, R?, St1?, Acc1?, Is, St2).
approval_classes1([answered(At, yes)|Rs], R, St, Acc, Is?, St2?) :- ground(At?), ground(R?) |
    mem(ended(At?), R?, Done),
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    approval_class(Done?, C?, any_part, St?, Acc?, Acc1, St1),
    approval_classes1(Rs?, R?, St1?, Acc1?, Is, St2).
approval_classes1([_|Rs], R, St, Acc, Is?, St1?) :- otherwise | approval_classes1(Rs?, R?, St?, Acc?, Is, St1).
%% The class of an approval, computed only where the approval has not ended.
procedure approval_class(YesNo?, Class?, PartsOf?, St?, Apprs?, Apprs, St).
approval_class(yes, _, _, St, Acc, Acc?, St?).
approval_class(no, C, F, St, Acc, Acc1?, St1?) :-
    st_class(C?, St?, Cr, St1),
    open_class(no, Cr?, F?, Acc?, Acc1).
procedure open_class(YesNo?, ClassRes?, PartsOf?, Apprs?, Apprs).
open_class(no, cls(I), F, Acc, [ap(I?, F?)|Acc?]).
open_class(no, nocls, _, Acc, Acc?).
open_class(yes, _, _, Acc, Acc?).
procedure guard_cands1(Apprs?, V?, Cands).
guard_cands1([], _, []).
guard_cands1([ap(I, F)|Is], V, Cs?) :- ground(I?), ground(F?), ground(V?) |
    v_id(V?, Id),
    v_ms(V?, S),
    info_parts(I?, Pts),
    guarding_parts(Pts?, Id?, Ps0),
    approval_parts(F?, I?, Ps0?, Ps),
    may_propose(I?, V?, B),
    guard_parts_cands(B?, Ps?, I?, Id?, S?, Cs1),
    guard_cands1(Is?, V?, Cs2),
    app(Cs1?, Cs2?, Cs).
%% The parts an approval proposes: of a request, the part its schema-binding C determines, proposed by that schema-binding, where it is a part the agent guards; of an answer yes, all.  "A request names a schema-binding, and the part is the one that schema-binding determines, so where two schema-bindings determine one part a request of either proposes it, and where their guard sets differ they are two parts" (vGLP #20, Code_inbox.md, 2026-10-24 10:45 UTC; vGLP 110caf4, Section 5.4): the part is found by same_part, and not by the name of the first schema-binding that determines it, so that GB's release_c, one schema with deposit_c, is proposed as release_c.
procedure approval_parts(PartsOf?, Info?, Classes?, Classes).
approval_parts(any_part, _, Ps, Ps?).
approval_parts(by_name(C), I, Ps, Ps1?) :- ground(C?), ground(I?) |
    parts_named(Ps?, I?, C?, Ps1).
procedure parts_named(Classes?, Info?, Class?, Classes).
parts_named([], _, _, []).
parts_named([P|Ps], I, C, R?) :- ground(P?), ground(I?), ground(C?) |
    same_part(I?, C?, P?, B),
    named_part(B?, Ps?, I?, C?, R).
procedure named_part(YesNo?, Classes?, Info?, Class?, Classes).
named_part(yes, _, _, C, [C?]).
named_part(no, Ps, I, C, R?) :- parts_named(Ps?, I?, C?, R).
procedure guard_parts_cands(YesNo?, Classes?, Info?, Peer?, GAtoms?, Cands).
guard_parts_cands(no, _, _, _, _, []).
guard_parts_cands(yes, Ps, I, Id, S, Cs?) :- ground(Ps?), ground(I?), ground(S?) |
    ready_parts(Ps?, Id?, S?, Rs),
    guard_ready(Rs?, Ps?, I?, Cs).
procedure guard_ready(Classes?, Classes?, Info?, Cands).
guard_ready([], [], _, []).
guard_ready([], [P|_], I, [cand(op(P?), prop(I?, P?, none))]) :- ground(P?) | true.
guard_ready([R|Rs], _, I, Cs?) :- part_pcands([R?|Rs?], I?, Cs).
procedure part_pcands(Classes?, Info?, Cands).
part_pcands([], _, []).
part_pcands([P|Ps], I, [cand(op(P?), prop(I?, P?, none))|Cs?]) :- ground(P?), ground(I?) | part_pcands(Ps?, I?, Cs).

%% Propose on a request the agent holds, held(Q, rho(N), K): the guarded part named N at its state (name_class), where the agent is its opener and Q its guard and Propose's condition holds on the agent, naming the request request(rho(N), K); propose_effect proposes it where the part's domain holds the agent's state, the parts named N whose opener lists the people of its listed roles exactly being that part, and refuses it at once otherwise (Section 5.4, "The compilation").  The requests in the order they arrived.
procedure held_cands(St?, Cands, St).
held_cands(St, Cs?, St1?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_held(St?, Hd),
    st_view(St?, V),
    held_cands1(Hd?, V?, St?, Cs, St1).
procedure held_cands1(Helds?, V?, St?, Cands, St).
held_cands1([], _, St, [], St?).
held_cands1([held(F, rho(N), K)|Hs], V, St, Cs?, St2?) :- ground(N?), ground(V?) |
    v_ms(V?, S),
    name_class(N?, S?, C),
    held_cand0(C?, F?, N?, K?, V?, St?, Cs1, St1),
    held_cands1(Hs?, V?, St1?, Cs2, St2),
    app(Cs1?, Cs2?, Cs).
held_cands1([held(_, one(_), _)|Hs], V, St, Cs?, St1?) :- held_cands1(Hs?, V?, St?, Cs, St1).
procedure held_cand0(Class?, Peer?, Proposal?, Integer?, V?, St?, Cands, St).
held_cand0(C, F, N, K, V, St, Cs?, St1?) :- ground(C?), ground(N?) |
    st_class(C?, St?, Cr, St1),
    held_cand(Cr?, F?, C?, request(rho(N?), K?), V?, Cs).
procedure held_cand(ClassRes?, Peer?, Class?, Names?, V?, Cands).
held_cand(nocls, _, _, _, _, []).
held_cand(cls(I), F, C, Nm, V, Cs?) :- ground(I?), ground(C?), ground(V?) |
    term_part_of(I?, C?, Pr),
    v_id(V?, Id),
    opens_for(Pr?, Id?, F?, Op),
    may_propose(I?, V?, B1),
    and(Op?, B1?, B),
    keep_pcand(B?, I?, C?, Nm?, [], Cs).
%% Whether the part has the agent as its opener and Q as a guard.
procedure opens_for(PartRes?, Peer?, Peer?, YesNo).
opens_for(part(pt(_, G, opener(O))), Id, F, B?) :- ground(G?) |
    same(O?, Id?, B1),
    mem(F?, G?, B2),
    and(B1?, B2?, B).
opens_for(part(pt(_, _, guarded_part)), _, _, no).
opens_for(nopart, _, _, no).

%% Vote on an attempt: a question pending at the agent, its answer y recorded,
%% its initiator, to whom Vote sends, known, and y no or the question not
%% waiting.  The record is newest first, so the instances are gathered oldest
%% answer first.
procedure vote_cands0(Recs?, V?, St?, Cands, St).
vote_cands0(R, V, St, Cs?, St1?) :- ground(R?) | vote_cands(R?, R?, V?, St?, [], Cs, St1).
procedure vote_cands(Recs?, Recs?, V?, St?, Cands?, Cands, St).
vote_cands([], _, _, St, Cs, Cs?, St?).
vote_cands([answered(At, Y)|Rs], R, V, St, Acc, Cs?, St2?) :-
    ground(At?), ground(R?), ground(V?) |
    pending_rec(At?, R?, P),
    vote_go(P?, At?, Y?, V?, St?, Acc?, Acc1, St1),
    vote_cands(Rs?, R?, V?, St1?, Acc1?, Cs, St2).
vote_cands([_|Rs], R, V, St, Acc, Cs?, St1?) :- otherwise |
    vote_cands(Rs?, R?, V?, St?, Acc?, Cs, St1).
%% The Vote on a question pending: its initiator known and its answer no or the question not waiting, and only then its class.
procedure vote_go(YesNo?, Attempt?, YesNo?, V?, St?, Cands?, Cands, St).
vote_go(no, _, _, _, St, Acc, Acc?, St?).
vote_go(yes, At, Y, V, St, Acc, Acc1?, St1?) :- ground(At?), ground(V?) |
    attempt_id(At?, Q),
    v_kn(V?, Kv),
    known_kn(Q?, Kv?, Kn),
    question_waits(At?, V?, Wt),
    vote_free(Y?, Wt?, Fr),
    and(Kn?, Fr?, B),
    vote_go1(B?, At?, St?, Acc?, Acc1, St1).
procedure vote_go1(YesNo?, Attempt?, St?, Cands?, Cands, St).
vote_go1(no, _, St, Acc, Acc?, St?).
vote_go1(yes, At, St, Acc, Acc1?, St1?) :- ground(At?) |
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    st_class(C?, St?, Cr, St1),
    vote_cand(yes, Cr?, vt(At?), Acc?, Acc1).
procedure vote_free(YesNo?, YesNo?, YesNo).
vote_free(no, _, yes).
vote_free(yes, W, F?) :- neg(W?, F).
procedure vote_cand(YesNo?, ClassRes?, WKey?, Cands?, Cands).
vote_cand(yes, cls(I), K, Acc, [cand(K?, sub(I?))|Acc?]).
vote_cand(yes, nocls, _, Acc, Acc?).
vote_cand(no, _, _, Acc, Acc?).

%% Commit of an attempt the agent initiated, not closed, with a yes of every
%% other participant recorded.
procedure commit_cands_st(St?, Cands, St).
commit_cands_st(St, Cs?, St1?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    app_recs(Ap?, R),
    st_id(St?, Id),
    commit_cands0(R?, Id?, St?, Cs, St1).
procedure commit_cands0(Recs?, Peer?, St?, Cands, St).
commit_cands0(R, Id, St, Cs?, St1?) :- ground(R?) | commit_cands(R?, R?, Id?, St?, [], Cs, St1).
procedure commit_cands(Recs?, Recs?, Peer?, St?, Cands?, Cands, St).
commit_cands([], _, _, St, Cs, Cs?, St?).
commit_cands([voted(At, yes)|Rs], R, Id, St, Acc, Cs?, St2?) :-
    ground(At?), ground(R?), ground(Id?) |
    attempt_id(At?, P),
    same(P?, Id?, Own),
    mem(closed(At?), R?, Cl),
    neg(Cl?, Open),
    and(Own?, Open?, Go),
    commit_go(Go?, At?, R?, Id?, St?, Acc?, Acc1, St1),
    commit_cands(Rs?, R?, Id?, St1?, Acc1?, Cs, St2).
commit_cands([_|Rs], R, Id, St, Acc, Cs?, St1?) :- otherwise |
    commit_cands(Rs?, R?, Id?, St?, Acc?, Cs, St1).
%% The Commit of an attempt the agent initiated and has not closed, and only then its class.
procedure commit_go(YesNo?, Attempt?, Recs?, Peer?, St?, Cands?, Cands, St).
commit_go(no, _, _, _, St, Acc, Acc?, St?).
commit_go(yes, At, R, Id, St, Acc, Acc1?, St1?) :- ground(At?) |
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    st_class(C?, St?, Cr, St1),
    commit_cand(yes, Cr?, At?, Id?, R?, Acc?, Acc1).
procedure commit_cand(YesNo?, ClassRes?, Attempt?, Peer?, Recs?, Cands?, Cands).
commit_cand(yes, cls(I), At, Id, R, Acc, Cs?) :- ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(R?) |
    mem(closed(At?), R?, Cl),
    neg(Cl?, Open),
    all_yes(I?, At?, Id?, R?, All),
    and(Open?, All?, B),
    vote_cand(B?, cls(I?), cm(At?), Acc?, Cs).
commit_cand(_, _, _, _, _, Acc, Acc?) :- otherwise | true.

%% Wound: a start the agent holds waiting, or a question pending at it and
%% answered yes, of an attempt A blocked by an attempt B over which A has
%% priority, yielded(B) not recorded and, where the agent initiated B, a yes
%% of every other participant of B not recorded.  The instance is wd(A, B),
%% with the entry of B's class.
procedure wound_cands0(St?, Cands, St).
wound_cands0(St, Cs?, St3?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_pends(St?, Pd),
    st_view(St?, V),
    st_trie(St?, Tr),
    wound_starts(Pd?, V?, Tr?, St?, [], Cs1, St1),
    st_view(St?, V1),
    wound_cands1(Cs1?, V1?, St1?, Cs, St3).
procedure wound_cands1(Cands?, V?, St?, Cands, St).
wound_cands1(Acc, V, St, Cs?, St1?) :- ground(V?) |
    v_recs(V?, R),
    wound_questions0(R?, V?, St?, Acc?, Cs, St1).
procedure wound_starts(Pends?, V?, Trie?, St?, Cands?, Cands, St).
wound_starts([], _, _, St, Acc, Acc?, St?).
wound_starts([deferred(msg(_, cargo(_, start(A))))|Ps], V, Tr, St, Acc, Cs?, St3?) :-
    ground(A?), ground(V?) |
    v_recs(V?, R),
    trie_closed(A?, R?, Tr?, Cl, Tr1),
    wound_open(Cl?, A?, V?, St?, Acc?, Acc1, St2),
    wound_starts(Ps?, V?, Tr1?, St2?, Acc1?, Cs, St3).
wound_starts([_|Ps], V, Tr, St, Acc, Cs?, St1?) :- otherwise |
    wound_starts(Ps?, V?, Tr?, St?, Acc?, Cs, St1).
%% A start held of an attempt not closed at the agent, and only then its class.
procedure wound_open(YesNo?, Attempt?, V?, St?, Cands?, Cands, St).
wound_open(yes, _, _, St, Acc, Acc?, St?).
wound_open(no, A, V, St, Acc, Cs?, St2?) :- ground(A?) |
    attempt_class(A?, C),
    st_class(C?, St?, Cr, St1),
    wound_start(Cr?, A?, V?, St1?, Acc?, Cs, St2).
procedure wound_start(ClassRes?, Attempt?, V?, St?, Cands?, Cands, St).
wound_start(nocls, _, _, St, Acc, Acc?, St?).
wound_start(cls(I), A, V, St, Acc, Cs?, St1?) :- ground(I?), ground(A?), ground(V?) |
    start_waits_v(I?, A?, V?, W),
    start_blocker(W?, I?, V?, Bk),
    wound_by(Bk?, A?, V?, St?, Acc?, Cs, St1).
procedure wound_questions0(Recs?, V?, St?, Cands?, Cands, St).
wound_questions0(R, V, St, Acc, Cs?, St1?) :- ground(R?) |
    wound_questions(R?, R?, V?, St?, Acc?, Cs, St1).
procedure wound_questions(Recs?, Recs?, V?, St?, Cands?, Cands, St).
wound_questions([], _, _, St, Acc, Acc?, St?).
wound_questions([answered(A, yes)|Rs], R, V, St, Acc, Cs?, St2?) :-
    ground(A?), ground(R?), ground(V?) |
    pending_rec(A?, R?, P),
    question_blocker(P?, V?, Bk),
    wound_by(Bk?, A?, V?, St?, Acc?, Acc1, St1),
    wound_questions(Rs?, R?, V?, St1?, Acc1?, Cs, St2).
wound_questions([_|Rs], R, V, St, Acc, Cs?, St1?) :- otherwise |
    wound_questions(Rs?, R?, V?, St?, Acc?, Cs, St1).
%% wound_by(Blocker?, A?, V?, St?, Cands?, Cands, St1): the instance wd(A, B) where A
%% has priority over its blocker B and the rest of Wound's condition holds; the class of B, which the state keeps since the agent voted on B, proposed it or was asked by it, read from the state, which is given back.
procedure wound_by(Blocker?, Attempt?, V?, St?, Cands?, Cands, St).
wound_by(noblk, _, _, St, Acc, Acc?, St?).
wound_by(blk(B), A, V, St, Acc, Cs?, St1?) :- ground(B?), ground(A?), ground(V?) |
    prio(A?, B?, Pr),
    v_recs(V?, R),
    mem(yielded(B?), R?, Yd),
    neg(Yd?, NYd),
    and(Pr?, NYd?, Go),
    wound_by1(Go?, A?, B?, V?, St?, Acc?, Cs, St1).
%% Only an attempt over which A has priority, and which the agent has not yielded, asks its class.
procedure wound_by1(YesNo?, Attempt?, Attempt?, V?, St?, Cands?, Cands, St).
wound_by1(no, _, _, _, St, Acc, Acc?, St?).
wound_by1(yes, A, B, V, St, Acc, Cs?, St1?) :- ground(B?) |
    attempt_class(B?, C),
    st_class(C?, St?, Cr, St1),
    wound_by_c(Cr?, A?, B?, V?, Acc?, Cs).
procedure wound_by_c(ClassRes?, Attempt?, Attempt?, V?, Cands?, Cands).
wound_by_c(nocls, _, _, _, Acc, Acc?).
wound_by_c(cls(I), A, B, V, Acc, Cs?) :- ground(I?), ground(A?), ground(B?), ground(V?) |
    v_id(V?, Id),
    v_recs(V?, R),
    wound_rec(I?, A?, B?, Id?, R?, Ok),
    vote_cand(Ok?, cls(I?), wd(A?, B?), Acc?, Cs).
%% A over B, yielded(B) not recorded, and, where the agent initiated B, a yes
%% of every other participant of B not recorded.
procedure wound_rec(Info?, Attempt?, Attempt?, Peer?, Recs?, YesNo).
wound_rec(I, A, B, Id, R, Ok?) :- ground(I?), ground(B?), ground(Id?), ground(R?) |
    prio(A?, B?, Pr),
    mem(yielded(B?), R?, Yd),
    neg(Yd?, NYd),
    attempt_id(B?, P),
    same(P?, Id?, Own),
    all_yes(I?, B?, Id?, R?, All),
    wound_by2(Own?, All?, Ok1),
    and(Pr?, NYd?, B1),
    and(B1?, Ok1?, Ok).
procedure wound_by2(YesNo?, YesNo?, YesNo).
wound_by2(no, _, yes).
wound_by2(yes, All, Ok?) :- neg(All?, Ok).

%% Introduce peers {Q, R}, Q preceding R: the introduction rule gives the pair
%% at the agent's machine state, the introduction predicates of the contract
%% naming each of them there, both other than the agent; both known; and
%% introduced(Q, R) not recorded.  The pairs not recorded introduced are kept in the index, computed anew where the machine state has changed and its persons named with it (IC); on each own trigger those of them both known are put up.
procedure intro_cands(St?, Cands, St).
intro_cands(St, Cs?, St1?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    st_ms(St?, S),
    st_kn(St?, Kn),
    st_ix(St?, Ix),
    intro_pend(Ix?, Id?, S?, Ix1),
    intro_known(Ix1?, Kn?, Cs, Ix2),
    set_ix(St?, Ix2?, St1).
procedure intro_pend(Ix?, Peer?, GAtoms?, Ix).
intro_pend(ix(Tr, Wl, In, ic(S0, Ns0, Pe)), Id, S, ix(Tr?, Wl?, In1?, Ic?)) :- ground(S?), ground(S0?) |
    same(S?, S0?, Sm),
    intro_pend1(Sm?, S?, Ns0?, Pe?, Id?, In?, Ic, In1).
procedure intro_pend1(YesNo?, GAtoms?, Peers?, Pairs?, Peer?, Recs?, IC, Recs).
intro_pend1(yes, S, Ns0, Pe, _, In, ic(S?, Ns0?, Pe?), In?).
intro_pend1(no, S, Ns0, Pe, Id, In, Ic?, In1?) :- ground(S?) |
    introduction_preds(E),
    named_by(E?, S?, Id?, Ns1),
    dedup(Ns1?, Ns2),
    sort_peers(Ns2?, Ns),
    intro_pend2(Ns?, Ns0?, Pe?, S?, In?, Ic, In1).
procedure intro_pend2(Peers?, Peers?, Pairs?, GAtoms?, Recs?, IC, Recs).
intro_pend2(Ns, Ns0, Pe, S, In, Ic?, In1?) :- ground(Ns?), ground(Ns0?) |
    same(Ns?, Ns0?, Sm),
    intro_pend3(Sm?, Ns?, Pe?, S?, In?, Ic, In1).
procedure intro_pend3(YesNo?, Peers?, Pairs?, GAtoms?, Recs?, IC, Recs).
intro_pend3(yes, Ns, Pe, S, In, ic(S?, Ns?, Pe?), In?).
intro_pend3(no, Ns, _, S, In, ic(S?, Ns?, Pe?), In?) :- ground(Ns?), ground(In?) |
    pairs_of(Ns?, Ps),
    not_introduced(Ps?, In?, Pe).
procedure not_introduced(Pairs?, Recs?, Pairs).
not_introduced([], _, []).
not_introduced([pr(Q, R)|Ps], In, Pe?) :- ground(Q?), ground(R?), ground(In?) |
    mem(introduced(Q?, R?), In?, D),
    not_introduced(Ps?, In?, Pe1),
    keep_pair(D?, pr(Q?, R?), Pe1?, Pe).
procedure keep_pair(YesNo?, Pair?, Pairs?, Pairs).
keep_pair(yes, _, Pe, Pe?).
keep_pair(no, P, Pe, [P?|Pe?]).
%% The pairs pending both known, put up, the pairs given back.
procedure intro_known(Ix?, Kn?, Cands, Ix).
intro_known(ix(Tr, Wl, In, ic(S, Ns, Pe)), Kn, Cs?, ix(Tr?, Wl?, In?, ic(S?, Ns?, Pe1?))) :-
    intro_keep(Pe?, Kn?, Cs, Pe1).
procedure named_by(Preds?, GAtoms?, Peer?, Peers).
named_by(_, [], _, []).
named_by(E, [g(P, [p(Q)])|Gs], Id, Ns?) :- ground(E?), ground(Q?), ground(Id?) |
    mem(P?, E?, In),
    same(Q?, Id?, Me),
    neg(Me?, NMe),
    and(In?, NMe?, B),
    named_by(E?, Gs?, Id?, N1),
    keep_peer(B?, Q?, N1?, Ns).
named_by(E, [_|Gs], Id, Ns?) :- otherwise | named_by(E?, Gs?, Id?, Ns).
procedure pairs_of(Peers?, Pairs).
pairs_of([], []).
pairs_of([Q|Qs], Ps?) :- ground(Q?), ground(Qs?) |
    pairs_with(Q?, Qs?, P1),
    pairs_of(Qs?, P2),
    app(P1?, P2?, Ps).
procedure pairs_with(Peer?, Peers?, Pairs).
pairs_with(_, [], []).
pairs_with(Q, [R|Rs], [pr(Q?, R?)|Ps?]) :- ground(Q?) | pairs_with(Q?, Rs?, Ps).
procedure intro_keep(Pairs?, Kn?, Cands, Pairs).
intro_keep([], _, [], []).
intro_keep([pr(Q, R)|Ps], Kn, Cs?, [pr(Q?, R?)|Ps1?]) :- ground(Q?), ground(R?), ground(Kn?) |
    known_kn(Q?, Kn?, K1),
    known_kn(R?, Kn?, K2),
    and(K1?, K2?, B),
    intro_keep(Ps?, Kn?, C1, Ps1),
    keep_icand(B?, Q?, R?, C1?, Cs).
procedure keep_icand(YesNo?, Peer?, Peer?, Cands?, Cands).
keep_icand(yes, Q, R, Cs, [cand(ip(Q?, R?), pair)|Cs?]).
keep_icand(no, _, _, Cs, Cs?).

%% The waits whose instances never hold again are forgotten: a Vote once its
%% attempt is voted on or closed, a Commit once its attempt is closed, a Wound
%% once the attempt it would wound is closed or yielded, an Introduce peers
%% once its pair is recorded introduced.
procedure prune_waits(Waits?, Recs?, Ix?, Waits).
prune_waits([], _, _, []).
prune_waits([w(K, T)|Ws], R, Ix, Ws1?) :- ground(K?), ground(R?), ground(Ix?) |
    dead_key(K?, R?, Ix?, Dd),
    prune_waits(Ws?, R?, Ix?, Rest),
    prune_wait(Dd?, w(K?, T?), Rest?, Ws1).
procedure prune_wait(YesNo?, Wait?, Waits?, Waits).
prune_wait(no, X, Ws, [X?|Ws?]).
prune_wait(yes, _, Ws, Ws?).
procedure dead_key(WKey?, Recs?, Ix?, YesNo).
dead_key(op(_), _, _, no).
dead_key(vt(A), R, ix(Tr, _, _, _), D?) :- ground(A?), ground(R?) |
    has_vote(A?, R?, V),
    rec_closed(A?, R?, Tr?, Cl),
    or(V?, Cl?, D).
dead_key(cm(A), R, ix(Tr, _, _, _), D?) :- rec_closed(A?, R?, Tr?, D).
dead_key(wd(_, B), R, ix(Tr, _, _, _), D?) :- ground(B?), ground(R?) |
    rec_closed(B?, R?, Tr?, Cl),
    mem(yielded(B?), R?, Yd),
    or(Cl?, Yd?, D).
dead_key(ip(Q, R1), R, ix(_, _, In, _), D?) :- ground(Q?), ground(R1?) |
    mem(introduced(Q?, R1?), R?, D1),
    mem(introduced(Q?, R1?), In?, D2),
    or(D1?, D2?, D).

%% The own transaction chosen, taken, and an own trigger written (write_own); none, and no own trigger written (no_own).
procedure dispatch_own(Choice?, App?, Stream(Trigger)?, Stream(Trigger)?,
    Stream(Trigger), Stream(Output), Stream(Net), Stream(Trigger), OpenApprovals?, Recs?, St?).
dispatch_own(none, Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    next(no_own, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).
dispatch_own(take(op(_), prop(I, P, Nm)), Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    dispatch_propose(pgo(I?, P?, Nm?), write_own, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).
dispatch_own(take(vt(At), sub(I)), Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(At?), ground(I?) |
    vote_effect(I?, At?, St?, Ss, Ns, St1),
    send_all(Ss?, St1?, Ms, St2),
    put_all(Ms?, Out, Out1?),
    next_n(write_own, no, Ap0?, Ns?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out1, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St2?).
dispatch_own(take(cm(At), sub(I)), Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(At?), ground(I?) |
    commit_effect(I?, At?, St?, Ss, Is, St1),
    send_all(Ss?, St1?, Ms, St2),
    put_all(Ms?, Out, Out1?),
    put_all(Is?, Out1, Out2?),
    next(write_own, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out2, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St2?).
dispatch_own(take(wd(_, B), sub(I)), Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(B?), ground(I?) |
    wound_effect(I?, B?, St?, Ss, St1),
    send_all(Ss?, St1?, Ms, St2),
    put_all(Ms?, Out, Out1?),
    next(write_own, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out1, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St2?).
dispatch_own(take(ip(Q, R), pair), Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?,
        [msg(Q?, intro(Id?, R?)), msg(R?, intro(Id?, Q?))|Out?], Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :-
    ground(Q?), ground(R?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    introduce_effect(Q?, R?, St?, St1),
    next(write_own, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St1?).
dispatch_own(take(_, _), Ap0, Ls, In, Ans?, Thr?, Out?, Ow?, Approvals, H, St) :- otherwise |
    next(no_own, no, Ap0?, Ls?, In?, Ans, Thr, Out, Ow, Approvals?, H?, St?).

%% The classes of the unguarded parts the agent opens at its state: each unguarded schema at the bindings that send its first role to the agent and meet that role's requirements, its other variables named by the agent; each class of them joins the classes met, and op_cands puts up the Propose of each of its unguarded parts the agent opens.  Every unguarded part the agent opens and is ready for is found so: the agent is in the first role of one of the part's schema-bindings, whose first role's requirements its state then holds, and the contract being effective, they name every other role and every variable of the schema-binding's deleted and added atoms (vGLP 099f876, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications").
procedure opening(St?, Infos, St).
opening(St, Is?, St1?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    app_state(Ap?, S),
    contract_schemas(Ss),
    reflexive_preds(Rf),
    opening1(Ss?, Rf?, Id?, S?, St?, Is, St1).
procedure opening1(Schemas?, Preds?, Peer?, GAtoms?, St?, Infos, St).
opening1(Ss, Rf, Id, S, St, Is?, St1?) :- ground(Id?), ground(S?) |
    hat(Rf?, Id?, S?, Sh),
    opened(Ss?, Id?, Sh?, Cs),
    meet_all(Cs?, St?, [], Is0, St1),
    dedup(Is0?, Is).
procedure opened(Schemas?, Peer?, GAtoms?, Stream(Class)).
opened([], _, _, []).
opened([schema(Nm, _, Rs)|Ss], Id, Sh, Cs?) :- ground(Nm?), ground(Rs?), ground(Id?), ground(Sh?) |
    guard_roles(Rs?, 1, Gs),
    opened1(Gs?, Nm?, Rs?, Id?, Sh?, C1),
    opened(Ss?, Id?, Sh?, C2),
    app(C1?, C2?, Cs).
%% An unguarded schema with listed roles has their one base as its first role (local.glp), so its opener lists the people of each (opened3).
opened([lschema(Nm, _, Rs, _)|Ss], Id, Sh, Cs?) :- ground(Nm?), ground(Rs?), ground(Id?), ground(Sh?) |
    guard_roles(Rs?, 1, Gs),
    opened1(Gs?, Nm?, Rs?, Id?, Sh?, C1),
    opened(Ss?, Id?, Sh?, C2),
    app(C1?, C2?, Cs).
procedure opened1(Ints?, Constant?, RoleSpecs?, Peer?, GAtoms?, Stream(Class)).
opened1([_|_], _, _, _, _, []).
opened1([], _, [], _, _, []).
opened1([], Nm, [R|Rs], Id, Sh, Cs?) :- ground(Nm?), ground(R?), ground(Id?), ground(Sh?) |
    rs_req(R?, Q),
    match_all(Q?, Sh?, [b(role(1), p(Id?))], Bs0),
    schema_numeric(Nm?, N),
    num_extend(N?, Bs0?, Bs),
    opened2(Bs?, Nm?, [R?|Rs?], Id?, Sh?, Cs).
%% A variable of a deleted or added atom that the atoms the first role requires do not name is given its values by the constraint once those are bound (vGLP 613ee8d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications": "or the constraint gives the variable finitely many values once those are bound"; con_extend); the schema-binding is taken where each of its numeric variables is bound to a number (nums_bound), its first role's required atoms are in the state and its forbidden ones not, and the constraint, where it is local to the first role or to every role, holds.
procedure num_extend(Numeric?, Bindings?, Bindings).
num_extend(numeric(C, _, _), Bs, R?) :- ground(C?) | extend_each(Bs?, C?, R).
procedure extend_each(Bindings?, Constraint?, Bindings).
extend_each([], _, []).
extend_each([B|Bs], C, R?) :- ground(C?) |
    con_extend(C?, B?, R1),
    extend_each(Bs?, C?, R2),
    app(R1?, R2?, R).
procedure opened2(Bindings?, Constant?, RoleSpecs?, Peer?, GAtoms?, Stream(Class)).
opened2([], _, _, _, _, []).
opened2([B|Bs], Nm, Rs, Id, Sh, Cs?) :- ground(B?), ground(Nm?), ground(Rs?), ground(Id?), ground(Sh?) |
    first_spec(Rs?, R1),
    cand_ok([R1?], B?, Sh?, Ok1),
    con_at(Nm?, B?, Id?, Con),
    con_holds(Con?, B?, Ok2),
    nums_bound(Nm?, B?, Ok3),
    and(Ok1?, Ok2?, Ok12),
    and(Ok12?, Ok3?, Ok),
    opened3(Ok?, Nm?, B?, Id?, Sh?, C1),
    opened2(Bs?, Nm?, Rs?, Id?, Sh?, C2),
    app(C1?, C2?, Cs).
procedure opened3(YesNo?, Constant?, Binding?, Peer?, GAtoms?, Stream(Class)).
opened3(no, _, _, _, _, []).
opened3(yes, Nm, B, Id, Sh, [C?]) :- ground(Nm?), ground(B?) |
    listed_people(Nm?, B?, Sh?, Ls),
    listed_binding(Nm?, B?, Ls?, B1),
    class_of(Nm?, B1?, Id?, C).
procedure first_spec(RoleSpecs?, RoleSpec).
first_spec([R|_], R?).
first_spec([], rs(unguarded, [], [], [], [])).

procedure meet_all(Stream(Class)?, St?, Infos?, Infos, St).
meet_all([], St, Is, Is?, St?).
meet_all([C|Cs], St, Is, Is2?, St2?) :- ground(C?) |
    st_class(C?, St?, R, St1),
    add_cls(R?, Is?, Is1),
    meet_all(Cs?, St1?, Is1?, Is2, St2).
procedure add_cls(ClassRes?, Infos?, Infos).
add_cls(nocls, Is, Is?).
add_cls(cls(I), Is, Is1?) :- app(Is?, [I?], Is1).

%% --- Choosing the instance of the class that has waited longest -----------
procedure choose(Cands?, Waits?, Integer?, Choice, Waits).
choose(Cs, W, D, Ch?, W2?) :- ground(Cs?), ground(W?), integer(D?) |
    ensure_waits(Cs?, W?, D?, W1),
    choose1(Cs?, W1?, D?, Ch, W2).
procedure choose1(Cands?, Waits?, Integer?, Choice, Waits).
choose1(Cs, W1, D, Ch?, W2?) :- ground(W1?), integer(D?) |
    pick(Cs?, W1?, Ch, Ky),
    D1 := D? + 1,
    retake(Ky?, W1?, D1?, W2).
procedure ensure_waits(Cands?, Waits?, Integer?, Waits).
ensure_waits([], W, _, W?).
ensure_waits([cand(K, _)|Cs], W, D, W2?) :- ground(K?), ground(W?), integer(D?) |
    wait_of(K?, W?, F),
    ensure1(F?, K?, W?, D?, W1),
    ensure_waits(Cs?, W1?, D?, W2).
procedure ensure1(WFound?, WKey?, Waits?, Integer?, Waits).
ensure1(at(_), _, W, _, W?).
ensure1(unseen, K, W, D, [w(K?, D?)|W?]).
procedure wait_of(WKey?, Waits?, WFound).
wait_of(_, [], unseen).
wait_of(K, [w(K1, T)|_], at(T?)) :- K? =?= K1? | true.
wait_of(K, [_|Ws], F?) :- otherwise | wait_of(K?, Ws?, F).
procedure pick(Cands?, Waits?, Choice, PKey).
pick([], _, none, nokey).
pick([cand(K, I)|Cs], W, Ch?, Ky?) :- ground(K?), ground(W?) |
    began_at(K?, W?, T),
    best(Cs?, W?, T?, K?, I?, Ch, Ky).
procedure best(Cands?, Waits?, Integer?, WKey?, Subj?, Choice, PKey).
best([], _, _, K, I, take(K?, I?), key(K?)) :- ground(K?) | true.
best([cand(K2, I2)|Cs], W, T, K, I, Ch?, Ky?) :- ground(K2?), ground(W?) |
    began_at(K2?, W?, T2),
    best1(T2?, T?, K2?, I2?, K?, I?, Cs?, W?, Ch, Ky).
procedure best1(Integer?, Integer?, WKey?, Subj?, WKey?, Subj?, Cands?, Waits?,
    Choice, PKey).
best1(T2, T, K2, I2, _, _, Cs, W, Ch?, Ky?) :- T2? < T? |
    best(Cs?, W?, T2?, K2?, I2?, Ch, Ky).
best1(T2, T, _, _, K, I, Cs, W, Ch?, Ky?) :- T2? >= T? |
    best(Cs?, W?, T?, K?, I?, Ch, Ky).
procedure began_at(WKey?, Waits?, Integer).
began_at(K, W, T?) :- wait_of(K?, W?, F), began_of(F?, T).
procedure began_of(WFound?, Integer).
began_of(at(T), T?).
began_of(unseen, 0).
procedure retake(PKey?, Waits?, Integer?, Waits).
retake(nokey, W, _, W?).
retake(key(K), W, D, W1?) :- set_wait(K?, D?, W?, W1).
procedure set_wait(WKey?, Integer?, Waits?, Waits).
set_wait(K, D, [], [w(K?, D?)]).
set_wait(K, D, [w(K1, _)|Ws], [w(K1?, D?)|Ws?]) :- K? =?= K1? | true.
set_wait(K, D, [X|Ws], [X?|Ws1?]) :- otherwise | set_wait(K?, D?, Ws?, Ws1).

%% ===========================================================================
%% The app transactions' effects (Definition "Canonical CVA Platform")
%% ===========================================================================

%% Propose (Definition "Proposing", Propose): the attempt's number one more than the agent's, its rank that of the agent's last attempt of the part where it recorded that one wounded, and its number otherwise, and the request it names, Nm.  Where the agent's state is in the domain of its effect in the part, the attempt is recorded voted yes, and is applied and closed at once where the agent is the class's only participant, ending every approval of the class pending at it, as Commit does (Definition "Decided, Committed, Aborted, Settled State": an attempt of one participant is decided once proposed), and is otherwise held prepared and its start told to every other participant.  Where it is not, the agent refuses it at once: it records voted no and closed, tells outcome(At, abort(Id, D)), D unable, with the atoms the schema requires at the agent that its state lacks and those it forbids that its state has, and, the attempt naming a request, deletes the request it holds, or, naming none, ends every approval of the class pending at it, and writes the notice where one ends.
procedure propose_effect(Info?, Class?, Names?, St?, Sends, Outputs, St).
propose_effect(I, P, Nm, St, Ss?, Ns?, St1?) :- ground(I?), ground(P?), ground(Nm?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    app_count(Ap?, K),
    K1 := K? + 1,
    st_ix(St?, Ix),
    rank_of(I?, P?, Ix?, K1?, Pi, Ix1),
    set_ix(St?, Ix1?, St0),
    st_ms(St?, S),
    part_dom(P?, Id?, S?, Dm),
    propose_app(Dm?, I?, attempt(Id?, K1?, Pi?, P?, Nm?), St0?, Ss, Ns, St1).
%% The rank of the attempt: that of the agent's last attempt of the part P where it recorded that one wounded, and its number K1 otherwise (Definition "Proposing", Propose).  The index holds the agent's own attempts recorded wounded that are the last it proposed of their parts (spend); the one of the part P, if any, is the last of P, and leaves the index, the attempt proposed now being the last of P.
procedure rank_of(Info?, Class?, Ix?, Integer?, Integer, Ix).
rank_of(I, P, ix(Tr, Wl, In, Ic), K1, Pi?, ix(Tr?, Wl1?, In?, Ic?)) :- integer(K1?) |
    wl_take(Wl?, I?, P?, Wl1, L),
    rank_of1(L?, K1?, Pi).
procedure rank_of1(Last?, Integer?, Integer).
rank_of1(nolast, K1, K1?).
rank_of1(last(A), _, P?) :- attempt_rank(A?, P).
%% wl_take(Wl, I, P, Wl1, L): the attempt of Wl whose term names the part P of the class I, last(A), taken out of Wl, or nolast.
procedure wl_take(Attempts?, Info?, Class?, Attempts, Last).
wl_take([], _, _, [], nolast).
wl_take([A|As], I, P, As1?, L?) :- ground(A?), ground(I?), ground(P?) |
    attempt_class(A?, C),
    term_part(C?, I?, P?, Pt),
    wl_take1(Pt?, A?, As?, I?, P?, As1, L).
procedure wl_take1(YesNo?, Attempt?, Attempts?, Info?, Class?, Attempts, Last).
wl_take1(yes, A, As, _, _, As?, last(A?)).
wl_take1(no, A, As, I, P, [A?|As1?], L?) :- wl_take(As?, I?, P?, As1, L).
procedure propose_app(YesNo?, Info?, Attempt?, St?, Sends, Outputs, St).
propose_app(yes, I, At, St, Ss?, [], St1?) :- ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    info_q(I?, Q),
    only_me(Q?, Id?, One),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    propose_go(One?, I?, At?, Id?, Ap?, Ss, Ap1),
    set_app(St?, Ap1?, St1).
propose_app(no, I, At, St, Ss?, Ns?, St1?) :- ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    st_ms(St?, S),
    attempt_class(At?, P),
    unable_reason(P?, Id?, S?, D),
    refuse_at_once(I?, At?, D?, St?, Ss, Ns, St1).
procedure propose_go(YesNo?, Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, App?, Sends, App).
propose_go(yes, I, At, Id, app(S, _, L, R), [], app(S1?, K?, L?, R2?)) :-
    ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(R?) |
    attempt_k(At?, K),
    attempt_class(At?, P),
    apply_part(P?, Id?, S?, S1),
    end_approvals(I?, Id?, [closed(At?), voted(At?, yes)|R?], R2, _).
propose_go(no, I, At, Id, app(S, _, _, R), Ss?, app(S?, K?, held(At?), [voted(At?, yes)|R?])) :-
    ground(At?), ground(I?) |
    attempt_k(At?, K),
    info_q(I?, Q),
    tell(Q?, Id?, start(At?), Ss).
procedure refuse_at_once(Info?, Attempt?, Reason?, St?, Sends, Outputs, St).
refuse_at_once(I, At, D, St, Ss?, Ns?, St2?) :- ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(D?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    info_q(I?, Q),
    tell(Q?, Id?, outcome(At?, abort(Id?, D?)), Ss),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    attempt_names(At?, Nm1),
    refuse_app(Nm1?, I?, At?, Id?, Ap?, En, Ap1),
    attempt_class(At?, P),
    ended_notice(En?, P?, Id?, D?, Ns),
    set_app(St?, Ap1?, St1),
    st_held(St?, Hd),
    attempt_names(At?, Nm2),
    drop_named(Nm2?, Hd?, Hd1),
    set_held(St1?, Hd1?, St2).
%% The record of a refusal at once: voted no and closed, and, the attempt naming none, the agent a guard of its part, every approval of the class pending at it ended.
procedure refuse_app(Names?, Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, App?, YesNo, App).
refuse_app(request(_, _), _, At, _, app(S, _, _, R), no, app(S?, K1?, unlocked, [closed(At?), voted(At?, no)|R?])) :-
    ground(At?) |
    attempt_k(At?, K1).
refuse_app(none, I, At, Id, app(S, _, _, R), En?, app(S?, K1?, unlocked, R1?)) :- ground(At?) |
    attempt_k(At?, K1),
    end_approvals(I?, Id?, [closed(At?), voted(At?, no)|R?], R1, En).
procedure only_me(Peers?, Peer?, YesNo).
only_me([P], Id, yes) :- P? =?= Id? | true.
only_me(_, _, no) :- otherwise | true.

%% Tell: the cargo to every participant other than the agent.
procedure tell(Peers?, Peer?, Cargo?, Sends).
tell([], _, _, []).
tell([Q|Qs], Id, X, Ss?) :- ground(Q?), ground(Id?), ground(X?) |
    same(Q?, Id?, Me),
    tell1(Me?, Q?, X?, Ss1?, Ss),
    tell(Qs?, Id?, X?, Ss1).
procedure tell1(YesNo?, Peer?, Cargo?, Sends?, Sends).
tell1(yes, _, _, Ss, Ss?).
tell1(no, Q, X, Ss, [to(Q?, X?)|Ss?]).

%% Vote yes: recorded, sent to the initiator, and the attempt held prepared.
procedure vote_yes_app(Attempt?, App?, Sends, App).
vote_yes_app(At, app(S, K, _, R), [to(I?, vote(At?, yes))],
        app(S?, K?, held(At?), [voted(At?, yes)|R?])) :-
    ground(At?) |
    attempt_id(At?, I).
%% Vote no, of reason D (Section 3.2, before Definition "Proposing": "vote y records voted(alpha, y), adds message(p, i, vote(alpha, y)) to o_p, ... and, if y = no and p is a guard of [t]_j, ends every approval of [t] pending at p; the reason of a vote no is declined where p has recorded answered(alpha, no) and unable otherwise"): recorded, sent to the initiator with its reason, and, the agent a guard of the attempt's part, every approval of the class pending at it ended, with the notice, the agent its refuser (vGLP f0acbc1, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "or from the vote where the agent's own vote no refused it").
procedure vote_no(Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, Reason?, App?, Sends, Outputs, App).
vote_no(I, At, Id, D, app(S, K, L, R), [to(P?, vote(At?, no(D?)))], Ns?, app(S?, K?, L?, R2?)) :-
    ground(At?), ground(D?), ground(R?) |
    attempt_id(At?, P),
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    guards_part(C?, Id?, Gd),
    guard_ends(Gd?, I?, Id?, [voted(At?, no)|R?], R2, En),
    attempt_class(At?, C2),
    ended_notice(En?, C2?, Id?, D?, Ns).
%% guard_ends(Guard?, I?, Id?, R?, R1, En): where the agent is a guard of the part, every approval of the class I pending at it ended.
procedure guard_ends(YesNo?, Info?, Peer?, Recs?, Recs, YesNo).
guard_ends(no, _, _, R, R?, no).
guard_ends(yes, I, Id, R, R1?, En?) :- end_approvals(I?, Id?, R?, R1, En).
%% Whether the agent is a guard of the part the term names, a person in the marked roles of its schema-binding.
procedure guards_part(Class?, Peer?, YesNo).
guards_part(C, Id, B?) :- ground(C?) |
    binding_of(C?, Nm, Bn),
    marked_people(Nm?, Bn?, G),
    mem(Id?, G?, B).

%% Start (Definition "Starting and Wounding", Start): its number the larger of the agent's and the attempt's; nothing more where the attempt is closed; otherwise, where the agent's state is not in the domain of its effect in the attempt's part, a vote no, unable; and where it is, where the attempt names a request of the agent, yes if the request is pending and no if not; where the agent is asked by the attempt, which names none, and no approval of the class is pending at it, the question recorded and the approval question raised; and else yes, a guard whose approval stands voting on its own precondition without asking its person.
procedure start_effect(Info?, Attempt?, St?, Sends, ApprovalRes, Outputs, St).
start_effect(I, At, St, Ss?, Cr?, Ns?, St1?) :- ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    st_closed(At?, St?, Cl),
    st_req(At?, St?, Mi, En),
    start_app(I?, At?, Id?, Cl?, Mi?, En?, Ap?, Ss, Cr, Ns, Ap1),
    set_app(St?, Ap1?, St1).
procedure start_app(Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, YesNo?, YesNo?, YesNo?, App?, Sends, ApprovalRes, Outputs, App).
start_app(I, At, Id, Cl, Mi, En, app(S, K, L, R), Ss?, Cr?, Ns?, Ap1?) :- ground(At?), integer(K?) |
    attempt_k(At?, KA),
    max_int(K?, KA?, K1),
    start_app1(Cl?, I?, At?, Id?, Mi?, En?, app(S?, K1?, L?, R?), Ss, Cr, Ns, Ap1).
procedure max_int(Integer?, Integer?, Integer).
max_int(A, B, A?) :- A? >= B? | true.
max_int(A, B, B?) :- A? < B? | true.
procedure start_app1(YesNo?, Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, YesNo?, YesNo?, App?, Sends, ApprovalRes, Outputs, App).
start_app1(yes, _, _, _, _, _, Ap, [], noapproval, [], Ap?).
start_app1(no, I, At, Id, Mi, En, Ap, Ss?, Cr?, Ns?, Ap1?) :-
    ground(At?), ground(Ap?) |
    app_state(Ap?, S),
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    part_dom(C?, Id?, S?, Rd),
    start_app2(Rd?, I?, At?, Id?, Mi?, En?, Ap?, Ss, Cr, Ns, Ap1).
procedure start_app2(YesNo?, Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, YesNo?, YesNo?, App?, Sends, ApprovalRes, Outputs, App).
start_app2(no, I, At, Id, _, _, Ap, Ss?, noapproval, Ns?, Ap1?) :- ground(At?), ground(Ap?) |
    app_state(Ap?, S),
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    unable_reason(C?, Id?, S?, D),
    vote_no(I?, At?, Id?, D?, Ap?, Ss, Ns, Ap1).
start_app2(yes, I, At, Id, Mi, En, Ap, Ss?, Cr?, Ns?, Ap1?) :- ground(At?) |
    names_mine(At?, Mi?, Mn),
    start_app3(Mn?, En?, I?, At?, Id?, Ap?, Ss, Cr, Ns, Ap1).
procedure start_app3(Mine?, YesNo?, Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, App?, Sends, ApprovalRes, Outputs, App).
start_app3(mine(_, _), En, I, At, Id, Ap, Ss?, noapproval, Ns?, Ap1?) :-
    start_named(En?, I?, At?, Id?, Ap?, Ss, Ns, Ap1).
start_app3(notmine, _, I, At, Id, Ap, Ss?, Cr?, Ns?, Ap1?) :- ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(Ap?) |
    asked_by(At?, Id?, Ak),
    app_recs(Ap?, R),
    approval_of(I?, Id?, R?, Apv),
    start_asked(Ak?, Apv?, At?, Ap?, Ss, Cr, Ns, Ap1).
procedure start_named(YesNo?, Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, App?, Sends, Outputs, App).
start_named(no, _, At, _, Ap, Ss?, [], Ap1?) :- vote_yes_app(At?, Ap?, Ss, Ap1).
start_named(yes, I, At, Id, Ap, Ss?, Ns?, Ap1?) :- vote_no(I?, At?, Id?, unable([], []), Ap?, Ss, Ns, Ap1).
procedure start_asked(YesNo?, YesNo?, Attempt?, App?, Sends, ApprovalRes, Outputs, App).
start_asked(yes, no, At, app(S, K, L, R), [], approval_for(At?), [], app(S?, K?, L?, [asked(At?)|R?])) :-
    ground(At?) | true.
start_asked(yes, yes, At, Ap, Ss?, noapproval, [], Ap1?) :- vote_yes_app(At?, Ap?, Ss, Ap1).
start_asked(no, _, At, Ap, Ss?, noapproval, [], Ap1?) :- vote_yes_app(At?, Ap?, Ss, Ap1).
%% Whether the attempt names a request the agent made, requested(Rho, K) in its record (st_req).
procedure names_mine(Attempt?, YesNo?, Mine).
names_mine(attempt(_, _, _, _, none), _, notmine).
names_mine(attempt(_, _, _, _, request(Rr, K)), B, Mn?) :- mine_of(B?, Rr?, K?, Mn).
procedure mine_of(YesNo?, Rho?, Integer?, Mine).
mine_of(yes, Rr, K, mine(Rr?, K?)).
mine_of(no, _, _, notmine).

%% The agent is asked by an attempt where it is in the attempt's guard set, its part's, the people in the marked roles of the schema-binding its term names, and is not the initiator (vGLP f0acbc1, Definition "Attempt": its guard set G_alpha is G([t]_j), and the members of G_alpha other than its initiator are asked by it); an attempt of an unguarded part asks nobody.  Start asks it where no approval of the class is pending at it (Definition "Starting and Wounding").
procedure asked_by(Attempt?, Peer?, YesNo).
asked_by(At, Id, B?) :- ground(At?), ground(Id?) |
    attempt_id(At?, P),
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    binding_of(C?, Nm, Bn),
    marked_people(Nm?, Bn?, G),
    mem(Id?, G?, In),
    same(Id?, P?, Me),
    neg(Me?, NotMe),
    and(In?, NotMe?, B).

%% Answer: the person's answer recorded, answered(At, yes) by its then-branch
%% and answered(At, no) by its else-branch; it sends nothing and votes nothing.
procedure answer_effect(YesNo?, Attempt?, St?, St).
answer_effect(YN, At, St, St1?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    answer_app(YN?, At?, Ap?, Ap1),
    set_app(St?, Ap1?, St1).
procedure answer_app(YesNo?, Attempt?, App?, App).
answer_app(YN, At, app(S, K, L, R), app(S?, K?, L?, [answered(At?, YN?)|R?])).

%% Vote, an own transaction (Definition "Answering and Voting", Vote): yes where the answer is yes and the agent's state is in the domain of its effect in the attempt's part; no otherwise, declined where the person answered no and unable otherwise; a yes is taken only where the question does not wait, so with nothing prepared.
procedure vote_effect(Info?, Attempt?, St?, Sends, Outputs, St).
vote_effect(I, At, St, Ss?, Ns?, St1?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    vote_app0(I?, At?, Id?, Ap?, Ss, Ns, Ap1),
    set_app(St?, Ap1?, St1).
procedure vote_app0(Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, App?, Sends, Outputs, App).
vote_app0(I, At, Id, Ap, Ss?, Ns?, Ap1?) :- ground(At?), ground(Ap?) |
    app_recs(Ap?, R),
    answer_of(At?, R?, YN),
    app_state(Ap?, S),
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    part_dom(C?, Id?, S?, Dm),
    vote_on(YN?, Dm?, I?, At?, Id?, Ap?, Ss, Ns, Ap1).
procedure vote_on(YesNo?, YesNo?, Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, App?, Sends, Outputs, App).
vote_on(yes, yes, _, At, _, Ap, Ss?, [], Ap1?) :- vote_yes_app(At?, Ap?, Ss, Ap1).
vote_on(yes, no, I, At, Id, Ap, Ss?, Ns?, Ap1?) :- ground(At?), ground(Ap?) |
    app_state(Ap?, S),
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    unable_reason(C?, Id?, S?, D),
    vote_no(I?, At?, Id?, D?, Ap?, Ss, Ns, Ap1).
vote_on(no, _, I, At, Id, Ap, Ss?, Ns?, Ap1?) :- vote_no(I?, At?, Id?, declined, Ap?, Ss, Ns, Ap1).

%% Tally (Definition "Deciding", Tally): nothing more where the attempt is closed; otherwise the vote recorded, and on a no the lock released, the attempt closed, the outcome abort told to every other participant with the voter as refuser and its vote's reason, every approval of the class pending at the agent ended where it is a guard of the part, with the notice, and the request the attempt names, if any, deleted from the requests it holds.
procedure tally_effect(Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, Vote?, St?, Sends, Outputs, St).
tally_effect(I, At, F, V, St, Ss?, Ns?, St1?) :- ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    st_closed(At?, St?, Cl),
    tally1(Cl?, I?, At?, F?, V?, St?, Ss, Ns, St1).
procedure tally1(YesNo?, Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, Vote?, St?, Sends, Outputs, St).
tally1(yes, _, _, _, _, St, [], [], St?).
tally1(no, _, At, F, yes, St, [], [], St1?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    add_rec(got(At?, F?, yes), Ap?, Ap1),
    set_app(St?, Ap1?, St1).
tally1(no, I, At, F, no(D), St, Ss?, Ns?, St3?) :- ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(D?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    info_q(I?, Q),
    tell(Q?, Id?, outcome(At?, abort(F?, D?)), Ss),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    app_recs(Ap?, R),
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    guards_part(C?, Id?, Gd),
    guard_ends(Gd?, I?, Id?, [closed(At?), got(At?, F?, no)|R?], R1, En),
    attempt_class(At?, C2),
    ended_notice(En?, C2?, F?, D?, Ns),
    st_app(St?, Ap2),
    unlock_recs(Ap2?, R1?, Ap3),
    set_app(St?, Ap3?, St2),
    st_held(St?, Hd),
    attempt_names(At?, Nm),
    drop_named(Nm?, Hd?, Hd1),
    set_held(St2?, Hd1?, St3).
procedure add_rec(Rec?, App?, App).
add_rec(X, app(S, K, L, R), app(S?, K?, L?, [X?|R?])).
procedure unlock_recs(App?, Recs?, App).
unlock_recs(app(S, K, _, _), R, app(S?, K?, unlocked, R?)).

%% Commit, an own transaction, of an attempt the agent initiated with a yes of every
%% other participant recorded (vGLP f0acbc1, Definition "Deciding", Commit): the effect applied, the lock released, the
%% attempt closed and commit told; every approval of the class pending at the agent ended and every request of the class it holds deleted; and the other participants of the attempt introduced to each other, once per pair (vGLP e2bc4f4, Definition "Deciding", Commit: "for every two participants q != r of alpha other than p for which p has not recorded introduced(q, r), p adds message(p, q, intro(r)) and message(p, r, intro(q)) to o_p and records introduced(q, r)"): for each pair {Q, R}, Q preceding R, introduced(Q, R) not recorded, intro(R) sent to Q and intro(Q) to R, each carrying its sender, msg(Q, intro(P, R)), after the outcome, and introduced(Q, R) recorded, the record Introduce peers keeps (commit_pairs, commit_intros).  The participants of a binary transaction other than its initiator are one, so its Commit introduces no one among them.  And the introduction rule's pairs of the part (vGLP 613ee8d, Definition "Introduction Rule, Introduce Peers": "Commit, and Outcome on a commit, of an attempt of [t]_j at p add the same messages and record for every {q, r} in iota_p([t]_j) with q, r in known_p for which p has not recorded introduced(q, r)"), iota_known: for act schemas, "a schema-binding in which p's role requires an atom naming an agent c bound to a variable and the person q in another role gains an atom naming c" gives p the pair {q, c} (Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications"; iota_pairs).
procedure commit_effect(Info?, Attempt?, St?, Sends, Nets, St).
commit_effect(I, At, St, Ss?, Ms?, St2?) :- ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    commit_app(I?, At?, Id?, Ap?, Ss, Ap1),
    commit_pairs(I?, Id?, Ps1),
    attempt_class(At?, P),
    iota_known(P?, Id?, St?, Ps2),
    app(Ps1?, Ps2?, Ps0),
    dedup(Ps0?, Ps),
    st_ix(St?, Ix),
    ix_intros(Ix?, In),
    commit_intros(Ps?, Id?, In?, Ap1?, Ms, Ap2),
    set_app(St?, Ap2?, St1),
    st_held(St?, Hd),
    drop_held_class(Hd?, I?, Id?, Hd1),
    set_held(St1?, Hd1?, St2).
%% The pairs of the participants of the attempt other than the agent, those of its class (Definition "Attempt"), each pr(Q, R), Q preceding R in the order of identifiers, as Introduce peers forms its pairs (intro_cands).
procedure commit_pairs(Info?, Peer?, Pairs).
commit_pairs(I, Id, Ps?) :- ground(I?) |
    info_q(I?, Q),
    remove_all(Id?, Q?, Q1),
    dedup(Q1?, Q2),
    sort_peers(Q2?, Q3),
    pairs_of(Q3?, Ps).
%% Each pair not recorded introduced: intro(R) to Q and intro(Q) to R, and introduced(Q, R) recorded (introduce_app).
procedure commit_intros(Pairs?, Peer?, Recs?, App?, Nets, App).
commit_intros([], _, _, Ap, [], Ap?).
commit_intros([pr(Q, R)|Ps], Id, In, Ap, Ms?, Ap2?) :- ground(Q?), ground(R?), ground(In?), ground(Ap?) |
    app_recs(Ap?, Rc),
    mem(introduced(Q?, R?), Rc?, D1),
    mem(introduced(Q?, R?), In?, D2),
    or(D1?, D2?, Done),
    commit_intro(Done?, Q?, R?, Id?, Ap?, Ms, Ms1?, Ap1),
    commit_intros(Ps?, Id?, In?, Ap1?, Ms1, Ap2).
procedure commit_intro(YesNo?, Peer?, Peer?, Peer?, App?, Nets, Nets?, App).
commit_intro(yes, _, _, _, Ap, Ms?, Ms, Ap?).
commit_intro(no, Q, R, Id, Ap, [msg(Q?, intro(Id?, R?)), msg(R?, intro(Id?, Q?))|Ms?], Ms, Ap1?) :-
    ground(Q?), ground(R?), ground(Id?) |
    introduce_app(Q?, R?, Ap?, Ap1).
%% iota_p([t]_j), the pairs the introduction rule gives the agent p for the part of the term P (vGLP 613ee8d, Definition "Introduction Rule, Introduce Peers"): "a schema-binding in which p's role requires an atom naming an agent c bound to a variable, not a role, and the person q in another role gains an atom naming c gives p the pair {q, c}" (Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications"): for each role of the schema-binding sent to p, each person c an agent variable of an atom the role requires, kept or deleted, is bound to, and each other role, sent to q, that adds an atom naming c, the pair {q, c}, where q, c and p are three; each pr(Q, R), Q preceding R in the order of identifiers.  iota_known keeps the pairs both of whose persons the agent knows.
procedure iota_known(Class?, Peer?, St?, Pairs).
iota_known(P, Id, St, Ps?) :- ground(St?) |
    iota_pairs(P?, Id?, Ps0),
    known_pairs(Ps0?, St?, Ps).
procedure known_pairs(Pairs?, St?, Pairs).
known_pairs([], _, []).
known_pairs([pr(Q, R)|Ps], St, Ks?) :- ground(Q?), ground(R?), ground(St?) |
    known_st(Q?, St?, K1),
    known_st(R?, St?, K2),
    and(K1?, K2?, K),
    known_pairs(Ps?, St?, Ks1),
    keep_known_pair(K?, pr(Q?, R?), Ks1?, Ks).
procedure keep_known_pair(YesNo?, Pair?, Pairs?, Pairs).
keep_known_pair(yes, P, Ps, [P?|Ps?]).
keep_known_pair(no, _, Ps, Ps?).
procedure iota_pairs(Class?, Peer?, Pairs).
iota_pairs(P, Id, Ps?) :- ground(P?), ground(Id?) |
    term_spec(P?, _, Rs, Bn),
    iota_rs(Rs?, Bn?, Id?, Ps0),
    dedup(Ps0?, Ps).
procedure iota_rs(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peer?, Pairs).
iota_rs(Rs, Bn, Id, Ps?) :- ground(Rs?), ground(Bn?) |
    rs_len(Rs?, K),
    iota_from(1, K?, Rs?, Bn?, Id?, Ps).
procedure iota_from(Integer?, Integer?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peer?, Pairs).
iota_from(I, K, _, _, _, []) :- I? > K? | true.
iota_from(I, K, Rs, Bn, Id, Ps?) :- I? =< K?, ground(Rs?), ground(Bn?), ground(Id?) |
    role_person(I?, Bn?, P),
    same(P?, Id?, Mine),
    iota_role(Mine?, I?, K?, Rs?, Bn?, Id?, Ps1),
    I1 := I? + 1,
    iota_from(I1?, K?, Rs?, Bn?, Id?, Ps2),
    app(Ps1?, Ps2?, Ps).
procedure iota_role(YesNo?, Integer?, Integer?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peer?, Pairs).
iota_role(no, _, _, _, _, _, []).
iota_role(yes, I, K, Rs, Bn, Id, Ps?) :- integer(I?), ground(Rs?), ground(Bn?) |
    nth_spec(Rs?, I?, R),
    rs_req(R?, Q),
    atoms_vars(Q?, Vs),
    var_agents(Vs?, Bn?, Cs),
    iota_gainers(1, K?, I?, Rs?, Bn?, Id?, Cs?, Ps).
%% The persons the agent variables among Vs are bound to.
procedure var_agents(Vars?, Binding?, Peers).
var_agents([], _, []).
var_agents([pvar(X)|Vs], B, [C?|Cs?]) :- ground(B?) |
    val_peer(pvar(X?), B?, unbound, C),
    var_agents(Vs?, B?, Cs).
var_agents([_|Vs], B, Cs?) :- otherwise | var_agents(Vs?, B?, Cs).
procedure iota_gainers(Integer?, Integer?, Integer?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peer?, Peers?, Pairs).
iota_gainers(J, K, _, _, _, _, _, []) :- J? > K? | true.
iota_gainers(J, K, I, Rs, Bn, Id, Cs, Ps?) :- J? =< K?, integer(I?), ground(Rs?), ground(Bn?), ground(Id?), ground(Cs?) |
    same_int(J?, I?, Self),
    iota_gainer(Self?, J?, Rs?, Bn?, Id?, Cs?, Ps1),
    J1 := J? + 1,
    iota_gainers(J1?, K?, I?, Rs?, Bn?, Id?, Cs?, Ps2),
    app(Ps1?, Ps2?, Ps).
procedure iota_gainer(YesNo?, Integer?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peer?, Peers?, Pairs).
iota_gainer(yes, _, _, _, _, _, []).
iota_gainer(no, J, Rs, Bn, Id, Cs, Ps?) :- integer(J?), ground(Rs?), ground(Bn?) |
    role_person(J?, Bn?, Q),
    nth_spec(Rs?, J?, R),
    rs_add(R?, A),
    img_atoms(A?, Bn?, G),
    iota_named(Cs?, G?, Q?, Id?, Ps).
procedure iota_named(Peers?, GAtoms?, Peer?, Peer?, Pairs).
iota_named([], _, _, _, []).
iota_named([C|Cs], G, Q, Id, Ps?) :- ground(G?), ground(C?), ground(Q?), ground(Id?) |
    names_peer(G?, C?, N),
    same(Q?, C?, E1),
    same(Q?, Id?, E2),
    same(C?, Id?, E3),
    or(E1?, E2?, E12),
    or(E12?, E3?, E),
    neg(E?, NE),
    and(N?, NE?, B),
    iota_named(Cs?, G?, Q?, Id?, Ps1),
    keep_ipair(B?, Q?, C?, Ps1?, Ps).
procedure keep_ipair(YesNo?, Peer?, Peer?, Pairs?, Pairs).
keep_ipair(no, _, _, Ps, Ps?).
keep_ipair(yes, Q, C, Ps, [Pr?|Ps?]) :- ordered_pair(Q?, C?, Pr).
procedure ordered_pair(Peer?, Peer?, Pair).
ordered_pair(Q, C, pr(Q?, C?)) :- Q? @< C? | true.
ordered_pair(Q, C, pr(C?, Q?)) :- otherwise | true.
%% An atom names what is among its arguments or is the signer of one (GSC, Section 3): a person, a speech act signed by the person, or a community name built on the person.
procedure names_peer(GAtoms?, Peer?, YesNo).
names_peer([], _, no).
names_peer([g(_, Vs)|Gs], C, B?) :- ground(Vs?), ground(C?) |
    vals_name(Vs?, C?, B1),
    names_peer1(B1?, Gs?, C?, B).
procedure names_peer1(YesNo?, GAtoms?, Peer?, YesNo).
names_peer1(yes, _, _, yes).
names_peer1(no, Gs, C, B?) :- names_peer(Gs?, C?, B).
procedure vals_name(Vals?, Peer?, YesNo).
vals_name([], _, no).
vals_name([X|Xs], C, B?) :- ground(X?), ground(C?) |
    val_names(X?, C?, B1),
    vals_name1(B1?, Xs?, C?, B).
procedure vals_name1(YesNo?, Vals?, Peer?, YesNo).
vals_name1(yes, _, _, yes).
vals_name1(no, Xs, C, B?) :- vals_name(Xs?, C?, B).
procedure val_names(Val?, Peer?, YesNo).
val_names(p(Q), C, B?) :- same(Q?, C?, B).
val_names(s(speech(_, Q)), C, B?) :- same(Q?, C?, B).
val_names(c(N), C, B?) :- cname_base(N?, Q), same(Q?, C?, B).
val_names(n(_), _, no).
val_names(lv(_, _), _, no).
val_names(any, _, no).
procedure cname_base(CName?, Peer).
cname_base(community(Q), Q?).
cname_base(dot(N, _), Q?) :- cname_base(N?, Q).
cname_base(dot_any(N), Q?) :- cname_base(N?, Q).
procedure commit_app(Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, App?, Sends, App).
commit_app(I, At, Id, app(S, K, _, R), Ss?, app(S1?, K?, unlocked, R1?)) :-
    ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(Id?) |
    attempt_class(At?, P),
    apply_part(P?, Id?, S?, S1),
    info_q(I?, Q),
    tell(Q?, Id?, outcome(At?, commit), Ss),
    end_approvals(I?, Id?, [closed(At?)|R?], R1, _).

%% Yield, at the initiator, on yield(At): nothing more where the attempt is
%% closed or a yes of every other participant is recorded; otherwise the lock
%% released, the attempt closed and recorded wounded, and the outcome yield
%% told (Definition "Deciding", Yield).  An attempt that yields ends no
%% approval, and its initiator proposes it again, keeping its rank.
procedure yield_effect(Info?, Attempt?, St?, Sends, St).
yield_effect(I, At, St, Ss?, St1?) :- ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    st_closed(At?, St?, Cl),
    yield_app(I?, At?, Id?, Cl?, Ap?, Ss, Ap1),
    set_app(St?, Ap1?, St1).
procedure yield_app(Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, YesNo?, App?, Sends, App).
yield_app(I, At, Id, Cl, Ap, Ss?, Ap1?) :- ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(Id?), ground(Ap?) |
    app_recs(Ap?, R),
    closed_or_all(I?, At?, Id?, Cl?, R?, Done),
    yield_app1(Done?, I?, At?, Id?, Ap?, Ss, Ap1).
procedure closed_or_all(Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, YesNo?, Recs?, YesNo).
closed_or_all(I, At, Id, Cl, R, Done?) :-
    all_yes(I?, At?, Id?, R?, All),
    or(Cl?, All?, Done).
procedure yield_app1(YesNo?, Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, App?, Sends, App).
yield_app1(yes, _, _, _, Ap, [], Ap?).
yield_app1(no, I, At, Id, Ap, Ss?, Ap1?) :- abort_own(I?, At?, Id?, Ap?, Ss, Ap1).
%% The agent's own attempt aborted, wounded: the lock released, the attempt
%% closed and recorded wounded, and the outcome yield told to every other
%% participant (Definition "Starting and Wounding", Wound; Definition
%% "Deciding", Yield).
procedure abort_own(Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, App?, Sends, App).
abort_own(I, At, Id, app(S, K, _, R), Ss?,
        app(S?, K?, unlocked, [wounded(At?), closed(At?)|R?])) :-
    ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(Id?) |
    info_q(I?, Q),
    tell(Q?, Id?, outcome(At?, yield), Ss).

%% Wound of A against B, an own transaction: where the agent initiated B, B aborted,
%% wounded; otherwise yield(B) sent to B's initiator and yielded(B) recorded.
procedure wound_effect(Info?, Attempt?, St?, Sends, St).
wound_effect(I, B, St, Ss?, St1?) :- ground(I?), ground(B?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    attempt_id(B?, P),
    same(P?, Id?, Own),
    wound_app(Own?, I?, B?, Id?, Ap?, Ss, Ap1),
    set_app(St?, Ap1?, St1).
procedure wound_app(YesNo?, Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, App?, Sends, App).
wound_app(yes, I, B, Id, Ap, Ss?, Ap1?) :- abort_own(I?, B?, Id?, Ap?, Ss, Ap1).
wound_app(no, _, B, _, app(S, K, L, R), [to(J?, yield(B?))],
        app(S?, K?, L?, [yielded(B?)|R?])) :-
    ground(B?) |
    attempt_id(B?, J).

%% Introduce peers {Q, R}: intro(R) sent to Q and intro(Q) to R, each carrying
%% its sender, msg(Q, intro(P, R)), by the dispatch, and introduced(Q, R)
%% recorded.
procedure introduce_effect(Peer?, Peer?, St?, St).
introduce_effect(Q, R, St, St1?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    introduce_app(Q?, R?, Ap?, Ap1),
    set_app(St?, Ap1?, St1).
procedure introduce_app(Peer?, Peer?, App?, App).
introduce_app(Q, R, app(S, K, L, Rc), app(S?, K?, L?, [introduced(Q?, R?)|Rc?])).

procedure all_yes(Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, Recs?, YesNo).
all_yes(I, At, Id, R, B?) :- ground(At?), ground(Id?), ground(R?) |
    info_q(I?, Q),
    all_yes1(Q?, At?, Id?, R?, B).
procedure all_yes1(Peers?, Attempt?, Peer?, Recs?, YesNo).
all_yes1([], _, _, _, yes).
all_yes1([P|Ps], At, Id, R, B?) :- ground(P?), ground(At?), ground(Id?), ground(R?) |
    same(P?, Id?, Me),
    mem(got(At?, P?, yes), R?, G),
    or(Me?, G?, Ok),
    all_yes2(Ok?, Ps?, At?, Id?, R?, B).
procedure all_yes2(YesNo?, Peers?, Attempt?, Peer?, Recs?, YesNo).
all_yes2(no, _, _, _, _, no).
all_yes2(yes, Ps, At, Id, R, B?) :- all_yes1(Ps?, At?, Id?, R?, B).

%% Outcome (Definition "Deciding", Outcome): the effect applied on commit, the lock released where it holds the attempt, and the attempt closed.  On commit, every approval of the class pending at the agent ended and every request of the class it holds deleted.  On abort, the request the attempt names ended where it is the agent's, and, where the attempt names none, every approval of the class pending at the agent ended where it is a guard of the part that recorded voted yes or answered yes on the attempt; and the notice written where an approval ends, its refuser and reason the outcome's.  On yield, nothing more.
procedure outcome_effect(Info?, Attempt?, Decision?, St?, Outputs, Nets, St).
outcome_effect(I, At, Z, St, Ns?, Ms?, St2?) :- ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(Z?), ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    st_req(At?, St?, Mi, En),
    outcome_app(I?, At?, Z?, Id?, Mi?, En?, Ap?, Ns, Ap1),
    outcome_intros(Z?, At?, Id?, St?, Ap1?, Ms, Ap2),
    set_app(St?, Ap2?, St1),
    st_held(St?, Hd),
    outcome_held(Z?, I?, Id?, Hd?, Hd1),
    set_held(St1?, Hd1?, St2).
%% On a commit, the introduction rule's pairs of the attempt's part at the agent, both known and not recorded introduced, introduced as Commit introduces them (vGLP 613ee8d, Definition "Introduction Rule, Introduce Peers": "Commit, and Outcome on a commit, of an attempt of [t]_j at p add the same messages and record"); on an abort or a yield, none.
procedure outcome_intros(Decision?, Attempt?, Peer?, St?, App?, Nets, App).
outcome_intros(commit, At, Id, St, Ap, Ms?, Ap1?) :- ground(At?), ground(St?) |
    attempt_class(At?, P),
    iota_known(P?, Id?, St?, Ps),
    st_ix(St?, Ix),
    ix_intros(Ix?, In),
    commit_intros(Ps?, Id?, In?, Ap?, Ms, Ap1).
outcome_intros(abort(_, _), _, _, _, Ap, [], Ap?).
outcome_intros(yield, _, _, _, Ap, [], Ap?).
procedure outcome_app(Info?, Attempt?, Decision?, Peer?, YesNo?, YesNo?, App?, Outputs, App).
outcome_app(I, At, commit, Id, _, _, app(S, K, L, R), [], app(S1?, K?, L1?, R1?)) :-
    ground(I?), ground(At?) |
    attempt_class(At?, P),
    apply_part(P?, Id?, S?, S1),
    release(L?, At?, L1),
    end_approvals(I?, Id?, [closed(At?)|R?], R1, _).
outcome_app(I, At, abort(Q, D), Id, Mi, Ed, app(S, K, L, R), Ns?, app(S?, K?, L1?, R1?)) :-
    ground(At?), ground(D?) |
    release(L?, At?, L1),
    attempt_names(At?, Nm),
    abort_ends(Nm?, Mi?, Ed?, I?, At?, Id?, [closed(At?)|R?], R1, En),
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    ended_notice(En?, C?, Q?, D?, Ns).
outcome_app(_, At, yield, _, _, _, app(S, K, L, R), [], app(S?, K?, L1?, [closed(At?)|R?])) :-
    ground(At?) |
    release(L?, At?, L1).
procedure outcome_held(Decision?, Info?, Peer?, Helds?, Helds).
outcome_held(commit, I, Id, Hd, Hd1?) :- drop_held_class(Hd?, I?, Id?, Hd1).
outcome_held(abort(_, _), _, _, Hd, Hd?).
outcome_held(yield, _, _, Hd, Hd?).
%% The approvals an abort ends at a participant: the request the attempt names, where the agent made it; and, where it names none, every approval of the class pending at the agent, where it is a guard of the part that voted yes or answered yes on the attempt.
procedure abort_ends(Names?, YesNo?, YesNo?, Info?, Attempt?, Peer?, Recs?, Recs, YesNo).
abort_ends(request(Rr, K), Mi, Ed, _, _, _, R, R1?, En?) :- end_request(Rr?, K?, Mi?, Ed?, R?, R1, En).
abort_ends(none, _, _, I, At, Id, R, R1?, En?) :- ground(At?), ground(R?) |
    attempt_class(At?, C),
    guards_part(C?, Id?, Gd),
    mem(voted(At?, yes), R?, Vy),
    mem(answered(At?, yes), R?, Ay),
    or(Vy?, Ay?, Said),
    and(Gd?, Said?, B),
    guard_ends(B?, I?, Id?, R?, R1, En).
%% The request the attempt names ended, where the agent made it, Mine, and has not ended it, Done (st_req).
procedure end_request(Rho?, Integer?, YesNo?, YesNo?, Recs?, Recs, YesNo).
end_request(Rr, K, Mine, Done, R, R1?, En?) :-
    neg(Done?, Open),
    and(Mine?, Open?, B),
    end_request1(B?, Rr?, K?, R?, R1, En).
procedure end_request1(YesNo?, Rho?, Integer?, Recs?, Recs, YesNo).
end_request1(yes, Rr, K, R, [ended(Rr?, K?)|R?], yes).
end_request1(no, _, _, R, R?, no).

%% --- Approvals ------------------------------------------------------------------
%% The approvals of the agent (vGLP f0acbc1, Definition "Cargo, App State, Question, Approval, Free, Ready"): "the requests requested(rho, k) it has recorded, approvals of each class of rho, and its answers answered(alpha, yes), approvals of the class of alpha; an approval is pending at p until p ends it, recording ended(rho, k) or ended(alpha)".  end_approvals ends every approval of the class I pending at the agent, En yes where it ended any; approval_of says whether one is pending.
procedure end_approvals(Info?, Peer?, Recs?, Recs, YesNo).
end_approvals(I, Id, R, R1?, En?) :- ground(R?) |
    pending_approvals(R?, I?, Id?, R?, Es),
    end_all(Es?, R?, R1, En).
procedure approval_of(Info?, Peer?, Recs?, YesNo).
approval_of(I, Id, R, B?) :- ground(R?) |
    pending_approvals(R?, I?, Id?, R?, Es),
    some_rec(Es?, B).
%% pending_approvals(Rs, I, Id, R, Es): for each approval of the class I in Rs pending in the record R, the record of its end, ended(Rho, K) or ended(At).
procedure pending_approvals(Recs?, Info?, Peer?, Recs?, Recs).
pending_approvals([], _, _, _, []).
pending_approvals([requested(Rr, K)|Rs], I, Id, R, Es?) :- ground(Rr?), ground(I?), ground(R?), integer(K?) |
    mem(ended(Rr?, K?), R?, Done),
    neg(Done?, Open),
    rho_of_class(Rr?, I?, Id?, Of),
    and(Open?, Of?, B),
    pending_approvals(Rs?, I?, Id?, R?, Es1),
    keep_rec(B?, ended(Rr?, K?), Es1?, Es).
pending_approvals([answered(At, yes)|Rs], I, Id, R, Es?) :- ground(At?), ground(I?), ground(R?) |
    mem(ended(At?), R?, Done),
    neg(Done?, Open),
    of_class(At?, I?, Of),
    and(Open?, Of?, B),
    pending_approvals(Rs?, I?, Id?, R?, Es1),
    keep_rec(B?, ended(At?), Es1?, Es).
pending_approvals([_|Rs], I, Id, R, Es?) :- otherwise | pending_approvals(Rs?, I?, Id?, R?, Es).
procedure keep_rec(YesNo?, Rec?, Recs?, Recs).
keep_rec(yes, X, Es, [X?|Es?]).
keep_rec(no, _, Es, Es?).
procedure end_all(Recs?, Recs?, Recs, YesNo).
end_all([], R, R?, no).
end_all([E|Es], R, R1?, yes) :- app([E?|Es?], R?, R1).
procedure some_rec(Recs?, YesNo).
some_rec([], no).
some_rec([_|_], yes).
%% Whether the class I is a class of the request: one(C), the class of the term C; rho(N), a class of rho_N (in_rho).
procedure rho_of_class(Rho?, Info?, Peer?, YesNo).
rho_of_class(one(C), I, _, B?) :- term_of_class(C?, I?, B).
rho_of_class(rho(N), I, Id, B?) :- in_rho(I?, N?, Id?, B).
%% The requests the agent holds of a class of which the class I is one, deleted; the one an attempt names, request(Rho, K), deleted; and none for an attempt naming none.
procedure drop_held_class(Helds?, Info?, Peer?, Helds).
drop_held_class([], _, _, []).
drop_held_class([held(F, Rr, K)|Hs], I, Id, Hs1?) :- ground(Rr?), ground(I?) |
    rho_of_class(Rr?, I?, Id?, Of),
    drop_held_class(Hs?, I?, Id?, Hs0),
    keep_held(Of?, held(F?, Rr?, K?), Hs0?, Hs1).
procedure keep_held(YesNo?, Held?, Helds?, Helds).
keep_held(yes, _, Hs, Hs?).
keep_held(no, H, Hs, [H?|Hs?]).
procedure drop_named(Names?, Helds?, Helds).
drop_named(none, Hd, Hd?).
drop_named(request(Rr, K), Hd, Hd1?) :- drop_req(Hd?, Rr?, K?, Hd1).
procedure drop_req(Helds?, Rho?, Integer?, Helds).
drop_req([], _, _, []).
drop_req([held(F, Rr1, K1)|Hs], Rr, K, Hs1?) :- ground(Rr1?), ground(Rr?), integer(K1?), integer(K?) |
    same(Rr1?, Rr?, E1),
    same_int(K1?, K?, E2),
    and(E1?, E2?, E),
    drop_req(Hs?, Rr?, K?, Hs0),
    keep_held(E?, held(F?, Rr1?, K1?), Hs0?, Hs1).
procedure release(Lock?, Attempt?, Lock).
release(unlocked, _, unlocked).
release(held(A), At, unlocked) :- A? =?= At? | true.
release(held(A), _, held(A?)) :- otherwise | true.

%% The messages a transaction sends, each carrying its sender; an agent sends
%% a cargo to a recipient at most once, so a message needs no number.
