procedure send_all(Sends?, St?, Nets, St).
send_all(Ss, St, Ms?, St?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_id(St?, Id),
    cargo_msgs(Ss?, Id?, Ms).
procedure cargo_msgs(Sends?, Peer?, Nets).
cargo_msgs([], _, []).
cargo_msgs([to(T, X)|Ss], Id, [msg(T?, cargo(Id?, X?))|Ms?]) :- ground(Id?) |
    cargo_msgs(Ss?, Id?, Ms).

procedure put_all(Nets?, Stream(Net), Stream(Net)?).
put_all([], Out?, Out).
put_all([M|Ms], [M?|Out?], Cont) :- put_all(Ms?, Out, Cont?).

%% ===========================================================================
%% The record, indexed by attempt (Code #12's change 2, vGLP #18 Cowork, Code_inbox.md 2026-10-20 12:03 UTC; the types St and Ix above)
%% ===========================================================================

%% spend(Changed?, St?, H?, St1, H1): where a dispatch changed the app state, the entries of each attempt it closed, closed(A) in the live record, and of each request it ended, ended(Rho, K), leave the live record for the record of the closed attempts H, which the agent goal holds and no trigger and no condition reads; an answer yes whose approval is pending stays until the approval ends, and then leaves with its end; each introduction recorded, introduced(Q, R), goes to the index; and the index notes the attempts closed, the requests ended and the agent's own attempts closed wounded.  No entry is dropped: the record is the live record, the record of the closed attempts and the introductions of the index together.
procedure spend(YesNo?, St?, Recs?, St, Recs).
spend(no, St, H, St?, H?).
spend(yes, St, H, St2?, H1?) :- ground(St?) |
    st_app(St?, Ap),
    st_ix(St?, Ix),
    st_id(St?, Id),
    spend_app(Ap?, Ix?, Id?, Ap1, Ix1, Ms),
    set_app(St?, Ap1?, St1),
    set_ix(St1?, Ix1?, St2),
    app(Ms?, H?, H1).
procedure spend_app(App?, Ix?, Peer?, App, Ix, Recs).
spend_app(app(S, K, L, R), Ix, Id, app(S?, K?, L?, R1?), Ix2?, Ms?) :- ground(R?) |
    closed_of(R?, Cl),
    ends_of(R?, Ea),
    spend_ix(R?, R?, Id?, Ix?, Ix1),
    spend_app1(R?, Cl?, Ea?, Ix1?, R1, Ms, Ix2).
procedure spend_app1(Recs?, Attempts?, Recs?, Ix?, Recs, Recs, Ix).
spend_app1(R, Cl, Ea, ix(Tr, Wl, In, ic(S0, Ns0, Pe)), R1?, Ms?, ix(Tr1?, Wl?, In1?, ic(S0?, Ns0?, Pe1?))) :-
    spend_split(R?, Cl?, Ea?, Tr?, R1, Ms, Is, Tr1),
    intros_out(Is?, Pe?, Pe1, Is1),
    app(Is1?, In?, In1).
%% The pairs recorded introduced leave the pairs pending; the introductions given back.
procedure intros_out(Recs?, Pairs?, Pairs, Recs).
intros_out([], Pe, Pe?, []).
intros_out([introduced(Q, R)|Is], Pe, Pe1?, [introduced(Q?, R?)|Is1?]) :- ground(Q?), ground(R?) |
    remove_all(pr(Q?, R?), Pe?, Pe0),
    intros_out(Is?, Pe0?, Pe1, Is1).
intros_out([X|Is], Pe, Pe1?, [X?|Is1?]) :- otherwise | intros_out(Is?, Pe?, Pe1, Is1).
%% The attempts the live record records closed, and the ends it records, of approvals and of requests.
procedure closed_of(Recs?, Attempts).
closed_of([], []).
closed_of([closed(A)|Rs], [A?|Cl?]) :- closed_of(Rs?, Cl).
closed_of([_|Rs], Cl?) :- otherwise | closed_of(Rs?, Cl).
procedure ends_of(Recs?, Recs).
ends_of([], []).
ends_of([ended(A)|Rs], [ended(A?)|Es?]) :- ends_of(Rs?, Es).
ends_of([ended(Rr, K)|Rs], [ended(Rr?, K?)|Es?]) :- ends_of(Rs?, Es).
ends_of([_|Rs], Es?) :- otherwise | ends_of(Rs?, Es).
%% The index of the attempts closed and the requests ended, and of the agent's own attempts closed wounded.
procedure spend_ix(Recs?, Recs?, Peer?, Ix?, Ix).
spend_ix([], _, _, Ix, Ix?).
spend_ix([closed(A)|Rs], R, Id, ix(Tr, Wl, In, Ic), Ix1?) :- ground(A?), ground(R?), ground(Id?) |
    attempt_id(A?, I),
    attempt_k(A?, K),
    trie_put(K?, a(I?), Tr?, Tr1),
    attempt_id(A?, P),
    same(P?, Id?, Own),
    mem(wounded(A?), R?, Wd),
    and(Own?, Wd?, W),
    wl_add(W?, A?, Wl?, Wl1),
    spend_ix(Rs?, R?, Id?, ix(Tr1?, Wl1?, In?, Ic?), Ix1).
spend_ix([ended(Rr, K)|Rs], R, Id, ix(Tr, Wl, In, Ic), Ix1?) :- ground(Rr?), integer(K?) |
    trie_put(K?, r(Rr?), Tr?, Tr1),
    spend_ix(Rs?, R?, Id?, ix(Tr1?, Wl?, In?, Ic?), Ix1).
spend_ix([_|Rs], R, Id, Ix, Ix1?) :- otherwise | spend_ix(Rs?, R?, Id?, Ix?, Ix1).
procedure wl_add(YesNo?, Attempt?, Attempts?, Attempts).
wl_add(yes, A, Wl, [A?|Wl?]).
wl_add(no, _, Wl, Wl?).
%% spend_split(R, Cl, Ea, Tr, Keep, Moved, Intros, Tr1): the entries of R kept in the live record, those moved to the record of the closed attempts and the introductions, in the order of R; the trie Tr read and given back, Tr1.
procedure spend_split(Recs?, Attempts?, Recs?, Trie?, Recs, Recs, Recs, Trie).
spend_split([], _, _, Tr, [], [], [], Tr?).
spend_split([E|Es], Cl, Ea, Tr, Ks?, Ms?, Is?, Tr2?) :- ground(E?), ground(Cl?), ground(Ea?) |
    spent_rec(E?, Cl?, Ea?, Tr?, F, Tr1),
    spend_split(Es?, Cl?, Ea?, Tr1?, Ks1, Ms1, Is1, Tr2),
    spend_one(F?, E?, Ks1?, Ms1?, Is1?, Ks, Ms, Is).
procedure spend_one(Fate?, Rec?, Recs?, Recs?, Recs?, Recs, Recs, Recs).
spend_one(keep, E, Ks, Ms, Is, [E?|Ks?], Ms?, Is?).
spend_one(move, E, Ks, Ms, Is, Ks?, [E?|Ms?], Is?).
spend_one(intro, E, Ks, Ms, Is, Ks?, Ms?, [E?|Is?]).
%% The fate of an entry: an entry of an attempt closed leaves the live record, but an answer yes whose approval has not ended; an answer yes and the end of its approval leave it once the attempt is closed; a request and its end leave it once it is ended; an introduction goes to the index.
procedure spent_rec(Rec?, Attempts?, Recs?, Trie?, Fate, Trie).
spent_rec(asked(A), Cl, _, Tr, F?, Tr?) :- in_closed(A?, Cl?, F).
spent_rec(answered(A, no), Cl, _, Tr, F?, Tr?) :- in_closed(A?, Cl?, F).
spent_rec(answered(A, yes), _, Ea, Tr, F?, Tr1?) :- ground(A?) |
    mem(ended(A?), Ea?, En),
    attempt_id(A?, I),
    attempt_k(A?, K),
    trie_look(K?, a(I?), Tr?, Cd, Tr1),
    and(En?, Cd?, B),
    fate_of(B?, F).
spent_rec(voted(A, _), Cl, _, Tr, F?, Tr?) :- in_closed(A?, Cl?, F).
spent_rec(got(A, _, _), Cl, _, Tr, F?, Tr?) :- in_closed(A?, Cl?, F).
spent_rec(closed(A), Cl, _, Tr, F?, Tr?) :- in_closed(A?, Cl?, F).
spent_rec(wounded(A), Cl, _, Tr, F?, Tr?) :- in_closed(A?, Cl?, F).
spent_rec(yielded(A), Cl, _, Tr, F?, Tr?) :- in_closed(A?, Cl?, F).
spent_rec(ended(A), _, _, Tr, F?, Tr1?) :- ground(A?) |
    attempt_id(A?, I),
    attempt_k(A?, K),
    trie_look(K?, a(I?), Tr?, Cd, Tr1),
    fate_of(Cd?, F).
spent_rec(requested(Rr, K), _, Ea, Tr, F?, Tr?) :- mem(ended(Rr?, K?), Ea?, B), fate_of(B?, F).
spent_rec(ended(_, _), _, _, Tr, move, Tr?).
spent_rec(introduced(_, _), _, _, Tr, intro, Tr?).
procedure in_closed(Attempt?, Attempts?, Fate).
in_closed(A, Cl, F?) :- mem(A?, Cl?, B), fate_of(B?, F).
procedure fate_of(YesNo?, Fate).
fate_of(yes, move).
fate_of(no, keep).

%% The trie of the attempts closed and the requests ended, keyed by a number K >= 1: at the root for K = 1, and otherwise under the root's first subtrie for K even and its second for K odd, at K // 2.
procedure trie_put(Integer?, Tag?, Trie?, Trie).
trie_put(K, G, nil, T?) :- trie_put(K?, G?, t([], nil, nil), T).
trie_put(K, G, t(Gs, Z, O), t([G?|Gs?], Z?, O?)) :- K? =< 1 | true.
trie_put(K, G, t(Gs, Z, O), T?) :- K? > 1 |
    M := K? mod 2,
    K1 := K? // 2,
    trie_put1(M?, K1?, G?, Gs?, Z?, O?, T).
procedure trie_put1(Integer?, Integer?, Tag?, Tags?, Trie?, Trie?, Trie).
trie_put1(M, K1, G, Gs, Z, O, t(Gs?, Z1?, O?)) :- M? =:= 0 | trie_put(K1?, G?, Z?, Z1).
trie_put1(M, K1, G, Gs, Z, O, t(Gs?, Z?, O1?)) :- M? =\= 0 | trie_put(K1?, G?, O?, O1).
procedure trie_has(Integer?, Tag?, Trie?, YesNo).
trie_has(_, _, nil, no).
trie_has(K, G, t(Gs, _, _), B?) :- K? =< 1 | mem(G?, Gs?, B).
trie_has(K, G, t(_, Z, O), B?) :- K? > 1 |
    M := K? mod 2,
    K1 := K? // 2,
    trie_has1(M?, K1?, G?, Z?, O?, B).
procedure trie_has1(Integer?, Integer?, Tag?, Trie?, Trie?, YesNo).
trie_has1(M, K1, G, Z, _, B?) :- M? =:= 0 | trie_has(K1?, G?, Z?, B).
trie_has1(M, K1, G, _, O, B?) :- M? =\= 0 | trie_has(K1?, G?, O?, B).
%% The same, the trie given back.
procedure trie_look(Integer?, Tag?, Trie?, YesNo, Trie).
trie_look(_, _, nil, no, nil).
trie_look(K, G, t(Gs, Z, O), B?, t(Gs?, Z?, O?)) :- K? =< 1, ground(Gs?) | mem(G?, Gs?, B).
trie_look(K, G, t(Gs, Z, O), B?, T?) :- K? > 1 |
    M := K? mod 2,
    K1 := K? // 2,
    trie_look1(M?, K1?, G?, Gs?, Z?, O?, B, T).
procedure trie_look1(Integer?, Integer?, Tag?, Tags?, Trie?, Trie?, YesNo, Trie).
trie_look1(M, K1, G, Gs, Z, O, B?, t(Gs?, Z1?, O?)) :- M? =:= 0 | trie_look(K1?, G?, Z?, B, Z1).
trie_look1(M, K1, G, Gs, Z, O, B?, t(Gs?, Z?, O1?)) :- M? =\= 0 | trie_look(K1?, G?, O?, B, O1).

%% Whether the attempt is closed at the agent: closed(A) in the live record, or noted in the trie once its entries have left it.
procedure rec_closed(Attempt?, Recs?, Trie?, YesNo).
rec_closed(A, R, Tr, B?) :- ground(A?) |
    mem(closed(A?), R?, B1),
    attempt_id(A?, I),
    attempt_k(A?, K),
    trie_has(K?, a(I?), Tr?, B2),
    or(B1?, B2?, B).
procedure st_closed(Attempt?, St?, YesNo).
st_closed(A, st(_, app(_, _, _, R), _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, ix(Tr, _, _, _), _), B?) :-
    rec_closed(A?, R?, Tr?, B).
%% The same, the trie given back.
procedure trie_closed(Attempt?, Recs?, Trie?, YesNo, Trie).
trie_closed(A, R, Tr, B?, Tr1?) :- ground(A?) |
    mem(closed(A?), R?, B1),
    attempt_id(A?, I),
    attempt_k(A?, K),
    trie_look(K?, a(I?), Tr?, B2, Tr1),
    or(B1?, B2?, B).
%% Of the request an attempt names: whether the agent made it, requested(Rho, K) recorded, and whether it has ended it, ended(Rho, K) recorded; no and no where it names none.
procedure st_req(Attempt?, St?, YesNo, YesNo).
st_req(attempt(_, _, _, _, none), _, no, no).
st_req(attempt(_, _, _, _, request(Rr, K)), st(_, app(_, _, _, R), _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, ix(Tr, _, _, _), _), B?, E?) :-
    ground(Rr?), integer(K?) |
    req_scan(R?, Rr?, K?, no, no, B1, E1),
    trie_has(K?, r(Rr?), Tr?, T),
    req_or(B1?, E1?, T?, B, E).
procedure req_or(YesNo?, YesNo?, YesNo?, YesNo, YesNo).
req_or(_, _, yes, yes, yes).
req_or(B1, E1, no, B1?, E1?).
procedure req_scan(Recs?, Rho?, Integer?, YesNo?, YesNo?, YesNo, YesNo).
req_scan([], _, _, B, E, B?, E?).
req_scan([requested(R1, K1)|Rs], Rr, K, _, E, B1?, E1?) :- R1? =?= Rr?, K1? =:= K? |
    req_scan(Rs?, Rr?, K?, yes, E?, B1, E1).
req_scan([ended(R1, K1)|Rs], Rr, K, B, _, B1?, E1?) :- R1? =?= Rr?, K1? =:= K? |
    req_scan(Rs?, Rr?, K?, B?, yes, B1, E1).
req_scan([_|Rs], Rr, K, B, E, B1?, E1?) :- otherwise | req_scan(Rs?, Rr?, K?, B?, E?, B1, E1).
%% Whether introduced(Q, R) is recorded: in the live record, or in the index.
procedure st_introduced(Peer?, Peer?, St?, YesNo).
st_introduced(Q, R, st(_, app(_, _, _, Rc), _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, ix(_, _, In, _), _), B?) :- ground(Q?), ground(R?) |
    mem(introduced(Q?, R?), Rc?, B1),
    mem(introduced(Q?, R?), In?, B2),
    or(B1?, B2?, B).
procedure ix_intros(Ix?, Recs).
ix_intros(ix(_, _, In, _), In?).

%% ===========================================================================
%% Conditions, over the app state (Definitions "Cargo, App State, Question,
%% Free, Ready" and "Priority, Waiting, Blocked, Clear")
%% ===========================================================================

%% Ready for a part [t]_j of [t] (Definition "Cargo, App State, Question,
%% Free, Ready"): free for [t], the lock unlocked and no question of [t]
%% pending (free_i), and the state in the domain of the agent's effect in the
%% part (ready_parts).
procedure unlocked(Lock?, YesNo).
unlocked(unlocked, yes).
unlocked(held(_), no).

%% No question of the class pending: no attempt of it recorded asked, with no
%% vote on it and not closed.
procedure no_question(Info?, Recs?, Recs?, YesNo).
no_question(_, [], _, yes).
no_question(I, [asked(At)|Rs], R, B?) :- ground(I?), ground(At?), ground(R?) |
    pending_rec(At?, R?, P),
    of_class(At?, I?, Cl),
    and(P?, Cl?, Q),
    no_question1(Q?, I?, Rs?, R?, B).
no_question(I, [_|Rs], R, B?) :- otherwise | no_question(I?, Rs?, R?, B).
procedure no_question1(YesNo?, Info?, Recs?, Recs?, YesNo).
no_question1(yes, _, _, _, no).
no_question1(no, I, Rs, R, B?) :- no_question(I?, Rs?, R?, B).

%% A question pending: recorded asked, with no vote and not closed.
procedure pending_rec(Attempt?, Recs?, YesNo).
pending_rec(At, R, B?) :- ground(At?), ground(R?) |
    mem(asked(At?), R?, B1),
    has_vote(At?, R?, B2),
    mem(closed(At?), R?, B3),
    or(B2?, B3?, B23),
    neg(B23?, B4),
    and(B1?, B4?, B).
procedure has_vote(Attempt?, Recs?, YesNo).
has_vote(_, [], no).
has_vote(At, [voted(A, _)|_], yes) :- At? =?= A? | true.
has_vote(At, [_|Rs], B?) :- otherwise | has_vote(At?, Rs?, B).

%% An answer recorded to an attempt, and which.
procedure has_answer(Attempt?, Recs?, YesNo).
has_answer(_, [], no).
has_answer(At, [answered(A, _)|_], yes) :- At? =?= A? | true.
has_answer(At, [_|Rs], B?) :- otherwise | has_answer(At?, Rs?, B).
procedure answer_of(Attempt?, Recs?, YesNo).
answer_of(_, [], no).
answer_of(At, [answered(A, Y)|_], Y?) :- At? =?= A? | true.
answer_of(At, [_|Rs], Y?) :- otherwise | answer_of(At?, Rs?, Y).

%% Whether an attempt's class is the class of an entry: the schema-binding of its part has the entry's participants and the same atoms deleted and added at each, and is linked to one of the entry's schema-bindings (in_class).  Its term met st_class when the agent first read it, or is a schema-binding of an entry's class, so the schema-binding determines a transaction.
procedure of_class(Attempt?, Info?, YesNo).
of_class(attempt(_, _, _, C, _), I, B?) :- term_of_class(C?, I?, B).
procedure term_of_class(Class?, Info?, YesNo).
term_of_class(C, ci(_, Ps, Q, _, Ms), B?) :- ground(C?) |
    term_spec(C?, _, Rs, Bn),
    of_class1(Rs?, Bn?, Ps?, Q?, Ms?, B).
procedure of_class1(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Deltas?, Peers?, Mates?, YesNo).
of_class1(Rs, Bn, Ps, Q, Ms, B?) :- ground(Rs?), ground(Bn?) |
    sig_of(Rs?, Bn?, Ps1),
    in_class(Rs?, Bn?, Ps1?, Ps?, Q?, Ms?, B).

%% The participants other than the agent known, or the first that is not.
procedure others_known(Info?, V?, Known).
others_known(I, v(Id, _, _, _, _, Kn), K?) :-
    info_q(I?, Q),
    first_unknown(Q?, Id?, Kn?, K).
procedure first_unknown(Peers?, Peer?, Kn?, Known).
first_unknown([], _, _, allknown).
first_unknown([P|Ps], Id, Kn, K?) :- ground(P?), ground(Id?), ground(Kn?) |
    same(P?, Id?, Me),
    known_kn(P?, Kn?, Kp),
    or(Me?, Kp?, Ok),
    first_unknown1(Ok?, P?, Ps?, Id?, Kn?, K).
procedure first_unknown1(YesNo?, Peer?, Peers?, Peer?, Kn?, Known).
first_unknown1(yes, _, Ps, Id, Kn, K?) :- first_unknown(Ps?, Id?, Kn?, K).
first_unknown1(no, P, _, _, _, unknown(P?)).
%% A peer is known when hello, or ihello, has been sent to it and received
%% from it (Section 5.4); a condition's test that a peer is known is of these.
procedure known_st(Peer?, St?, YesNo).
known_st(P, st(_, _, _, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, _, _, _, _, _, _, _), B?) :- known_kn(P?, kn(Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?), B).
procedure known_kn(Peer?, Kn?, YesNo).
known_kn(P, kn(Se, Rc, ISe, IRc), B?) :- ground(P?) |
    known_peer(P?, Se?, Rc?, B1),
    known_peer(P?, ISe?, IRc?, B2),
    or(B1?, B2?, B).
procedure known_peer(Peer?, Peers?, Peers?, YesNo).
known_peer(P, Se, Rc, B?) :- ground(P?) |
    mem(P?, Se?, B1),
    mem(P?, Rc?, B2),
    and(B1?, B2?, B).
procedure known_ok(Known?, YesNo).
known_ok(allknown, yes).
known_ok(unknown(_), no).
procedure go_or_drop(YesNo?, Info?, Cond).
go_or_drop(yes, I, go(I?)).
go_or_drop(no, _, drop).

%% Clear: no start held waiting and no question answered yes pending
%% (Definition "Priority, Waiting, Blocked, Clear").  Propose requires it.
procedure no_prior_start(V?, YesNo).
no_prior_start(v(_, _, _, R, Pd, _), B?) :-
    any_answered_yes(R?, Q),
    empty_pends(Pd?, E),
    neg(Q?, NQ),
    and(E?, NQ?, B).
procedure empty_pends(Pends?, YesNo).
empty_pends([], yes).
empty_pends([_|_], no).
procedure any_answered_yes(Recs?, YesNo).
any_answered_yes(R, B?) :- ground(R?) | any_answered_yes1(R?, R?, B).
procedure any_answered_yes1(Recs?, Recs?, YesNo).
any_answered_yes1([], _, no).
any_answered_yes1([answered(G, yes)|Rs], R, B?) :- ground(G?), ground(R?) |
    pending_rec(G?, R?, P),
    any_answered_yes2(P?, Rs?, R?, B).
any_answered_yes1([_|Rs], R, B?) :- otherwise | any_answered_yes1(Rs?, R?, B).
procedure any_answered_yes2(YesNo?, Recs?, Recs?, YesNo).
any_answered_yes2(yes, _, _, yes).
any_answered_yes2(no, Rs, R, B?) :- any_answered_yes1(Rs?, R?, B).
procedure precedes(Peer?, Peer?, YesNo).
precedes(P, Q, yes) :- P? @< Q? | true.
precedes(_, _, no) :- otherwise | true.

%% The guarded parts of a class with no opener whose guard set holds the agent, each named by its term; and the unguarded parts whose opener is the agent (vGLP f0acbc1, Definition "Attempt": "The initiator is the opener o([t]_j) of [t]_j if [t]_j has one, and a guard of [t]_j if not"; Section 3.2, "The protocol": "A part with an opener is proposed by its opener, an unguarded one whenever the opener can carry out its effect, and a guarded one on a request of its guard, which the attempt names ... A guarded part with no opener is proposed by one of its guards whose approval stands").  A guarded part with an opener its opener proposes on a request it holds (held_cands).
procedure guarding_parts(Parts?, Peer?, Classes).
guarding_parts([], _, []).
guarding_parts([pt(T, G, Op)|Ps], Id, R?) :- ground(Id?) |
    mem(Id?, G?, B1),
    no_opener(Op?, B2),
    and(B1?, B2?, B),
    guarding_parts(Ps?, Id?, R1),
    keep_class(B?, T?, R1?, R).
procedure no_opener(Opener?, YesNo).
no_opener(opener(_), no).
no_opener(guarded_part, yes).
procedure opening_parts(Parts?, Peer?, Classes).
opening_parts([], _, []).
opening_parts([pt(T, G, Op)|Ps], Id, R?) :- ground(Id?) |
    is_opener(Op?, Id?, B1),
    some_peer(G?, B2),
    neg(B2?, B3),
    and(B1?, B3?, B),
    opening_parts(Ps?, Id?, R1),
    keep_class(B?, T?, R1?, R).
procedure is_opener(Opener?, Peer?, YesNo).
is_opener(opener(P), Id, B?) :- same(P?, Id?, B).
is_opener(guarded_part, _, no).
procedure all_in(Peers?, Peers?, YesNo).
all_in([], _, yes).
all_in([P|Ps], Q, B?) :- ground(Q?) | mem(P?, Q?, B1), all_in1(B1?, Ps?, Q?, B).
procedure all_in1(YesNo?, Peers?, Peers?, YesNo).
all_in1(no, _, _, no).
all_in1(yes, Ps, Q, B?) :- all_in(Ps?, Q?, B).
%% For the part [t]_j of a schema-binding, f^[t]_j_p is defined at d_p iff
%% the schema-binding has the atoms it requires at p in d_p, with the atoms of
%% the reflexive predicates naming p and the variables local to p's role bound
%% by them in one way, those it forbids there not, and a constraint local to the
%% role holding under that binding, and yields d_p less the deleted atoms plus
%% the added ones, as multisets, under that binding, a multiplicity k deleting
%% or adding k copies (vGLP 613ee8d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local
%% specifications"; dom_bindings, apply_part).  The part
%% named by the term P: whether the state S is in the domain of its effect at
%% the agent.
procedure part_dom(Class?, Peer?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
part_dom(P, Id, S, B?) :- ground(P?), ground(Id?), ground(S?) |
    term_spec(P?, Nm, Rs, Bn),
    part_dom1(Nm?, Rs?, Bn?, Id?, S?, B).
procedure part_dom1(Constant?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peer?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
part_dom1(Nm, Rs, Bn, Id, S, B?) :- ground(Nm?), ground(Bn?), ground(Id?), ground(S?) |
    reflexive_preds(Rf),
    hat(Rf?, Id?, S?, Sh),
    mate_dom(Nm?, Rs?, Bn?, Id?, Sh?, B1),
    listing_ok(Nm?, Bn?, Id?, S?, B2),
    and(B1?, B2?, B).
procedure hat(Preds?, Peer?, GAtoms?, GAtoms).
hat([], _, S, S?).
hat([P|Ps], Id, S, [g(P?, [p(Id?)])|R?]) :- ground(Id?) | hat(Ps?, Id?, S?, R).
%% The reason of a vote unable of the compiled program, unable(Lacks, Has): "the atoms the schema requires at the voter that its state lacks and those it forbids that its state has" (vGLP f0acbc1, Section 5.4, "Act schemas"), as the contract writes them, the atoms of the reflexive predicates naming the voter holding there; and, for the person in the base of a listed role, who "lists in d_p exactly the people of that role in L" (Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications"), the listing atoms of the people of the role its state lacks, and those of others it has.
procedure unable_reason(Class?, Peer?, GAtoms?, Reason).
unable_reason(P, Id, S, unable(L?, H?)) :- ground(P?), ground(S?) |
    term_spec(P?, Nm, Rs, Bn),
    unable_atoms(Nm?, Rs?, Bn?, Id?, S?, L0, H0),
    atoms_of(L0?, L),
    atoms_of(H0?, H).
procedure unable_atoms(Constant?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peer?, GAtoms?, GAtoms, GAtoms).
unable_atoms(Nm, Rs, Bn, Id, S, L?, H?) :- ground(Nm?), ground(Rs?), ground(Bn?), ground(S?) |
    reflexive_preds(Rf),
    hat(Rf?, Id?, S?, Sh),
    specs_at(Rs?, 1, Bn?, Id?, RsP),
    unlocal(Bn?, B0),
    unable_at(RsP?, B0?, Sh?, L1, H1),
    listing_gaps(Nm?, Bn?, Id?, S?, L2, H2),
    app(L1?, L2?, L),
    app(H1?, H2?, H).
%% The variables local to the voter's roles bound by the first way the required atoms bind them, where they bind them at all, and left standing for themselves otherwise, an atom of one shown by no Atom (atom_of).
procedure unable_at(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, GAtoms?, GAtoms, GAtoms).
unable_at(RsP, B0, Sh, L?, H?) :- ground(RsP?), ground(B0?), ground(Sh?) |
    reqs_of(RsP?, Q0),
    match_all(Q0?, Sh?, B0?, Cs),
    first_or(Cs?, B0?, Bn),
    unable_at1(RsP?, Bn?, Sh?, L, H).
procedure first_or(Bindings?, Binding?, Binding).
first_or([B|_], _, B?).
first_or([], B, B?).
procedure unable_at1(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, GAtoms?, GAtoms, GAtoms).
unable_at1(RsP, Bn, Sh, L?, H?) :- ground(RsP?), ground(Bn?), ground(Sh?) |
    reqs_of(RsP?, Q),
    img_atoms(Q?, Bn?, G),
    ms_diff(G?, Sh?, L),
    forbs_of(RsP?, F),
    img_atoms(F?, Bn?, Fg),
    held_in(Fg?, Sh?, H0),
    dedup(H0?, H).
procedure held_in(GAtoms?, GAtoms?, GAtoms).
held_in([], _, []).
held_in([G|Gs], Sh, H?) :- ground(G?), ground(Sh?) |
    mem(G?, Sh?, In),
    held_in(Gs?, Sh?, H1),
    keep_g(In?, G?, H1?, H).
procedure keep_g(YesNo?, GAtom?, GAtoms?, GAtoms).
keep_g(yes, G, H, [G?|H?]).
keep_g(no, _, H, H?).
procedure listing_gaps(Constant?, Binding?, Peer?, GAtoms?, GAtoms, GAtoms).
listing_gaps(Nm, Bn, Id, S, L?, H?) :- schema_entry(Nm?, E), listing_gaps1(E?, Bn?, Id?, S?, L, H).
procedure listing_gaps1(Schema?, Binding?, Peer?, GAtoms?, GAtoms, GAtoms).
listing_gaps1(schema(_, _, _), _, _, _, [], []).
listing_gaps1(lschema(_, _, _, Lsts), Bn, Id, S, L?, H?) :- gaps_of(Lsts?, Bn?, Id?, S?, L, H).
procedure gaps_of(Listings?, Binding?, Peer?, GAtoms?, GAtoms, GAtoms).
gaps_of([], _, _, _, [], []).
gaps_of([listing(I, Bi, Rho, As)|Lsts], Bn, Id, S, L?, H?) :- ground(Bn?), ground(S?) |
    role_person(Bi?, Bn?, P),
    same(P?, Id?, Base),
    gaps_one(Base?, I?, Rho?, As?, Bn?, S?, L1, H1),
    gaps_of(Lsts?, Bn?, Id?, S?, L2, H2),
    app(L1?, L2?, L),
    app(H1?, H2?, H).
procedure gaps_one(YesNo?, Integer?, Constant?, Vars?, Binding?, GAtoms?, GAtoms, GAtoms).
gaps_one(no, _, _, _, _, _, [], []).
gaps_one(yes, I, Rho, As, Bn, S, L?, H?) :- ground(Rho?), ground(As?), ground(Bn?), ground(S?) |
    copies_of(Bn?, I?, Want),
    list_at(Rho?, As?, Bn?, S?, Have),
    img_args(As?, Bn?, Vs),
    gaps_two(Want?, Have?, Rho?, Vs?, L, H).
procedure gaps_two(Peers?, Peers?, Constant?, Vals?, GAtoms, GAtoms).
gaps_two(Want, Have, Rho, Vs, L?, H?) :- ground(Want?), ground(Have?), ground(Rho?), ground(Vs?) |
    peers_minus(Want?, Have?, Lp),
    peers_minus(Have?, Want?, Hp),
    listing_atoms(Lp?, Rho?, Vs?, L),
    listing_atoms(Hp?, Rho?, Vs?, H).
procedure peers_minus(Peers?, Peers?, Peers).
peers_minus([], _, []).
peers_minus([P|Ps], Qs, R?) :- ground(Qs?) |
    mem(P?, Qs?, In),
    peers_minus(Ps?, Qs?, R1),
    keep_out(In?, P?, R1?, R).
procedure keep_out(YesNo?, Peer?, Peers?, Peers).
keep_out(yes, _, R, R?).
keep_out(no, P, R, [P?|R?]).
procedure listing_atoms(Peers?, Constant?, Vals?, GAtoms).
listing_atoms([], _, _, []).
listing_atoms([Q|Qs], Rho, Vs, [g(Rho?, [p(Q?)|Vs?])|Gs?]) :- ground(Rho?), ground(Vs?) |
    listing_atoms(Qs?, Rho?, Vs?, Gs).
%% The parts whose domain at the agent holds its state.
procedure ready_parts(Classes?, Peer?, GAtoms?, Classes).
ready_parts([], _, _, []).
ready_parts([P|Ps], Id, S, R?) :- ground(P?), ground(Id?), ground(S?) |
    part_dom(P?, Id?, S?, B),
    ready_parts(Ps?, Id?, S?, R1),
    keep_class(B?, P?, R1?, R).
procedure keep_class(YesNo?, Class?, Classes?, Classes).
keep_class(yes, P, R, [P?|R?]).
keep_class(no, _, R, R?).
%% Whether the schema-bindings two terms name, of the class of the entry I, determine one part: the same people marked, and the same atoms required, as multisets, and the same atoms forbidden, at every participant, the deleted and added atoms being the class's (vGLP #15, Code_inbox.md, 2026-10-19 10:50 UTC, item 1).
procedure same_part(Info?, Class?, Class?, YesNo).
same_part(I, C1, C2, B?) :- ground(I?), ground(C1?), ground(C2?) |
    info_q(I?, Q),
    binding_of(C1?, N1, B1),
    binding_of(C2?, N2, B2),
    same_part1(Q?, N1?, B1?, N2?, B2?, B).
procedure same_part1(Peers?, Constant?, Binding?, Constant?, Binding?, YesNo).
same_part1(Q, N1, B1, N2, B2, B?) :- ground(N1?), ground(B1?), ground(N2?), ground(B2?) |
    marked_people(N1?, B1?, G1),
    marked_people(N2?, B2?, G2),
    same_bpart(Q?, N1?, B1?, G1?, N2?, B2?, G2?, B).
%% The same, of two schema-bindings with the people they mark.
procedure same_bpart(Peers?, Constant?, Binding?, Peers?, Constant?, Binding?, Peers?, YesNo).
same_bpart(Q, N1, B1, G1, N2, B2, G2, B?) :- ground(B1?), ground(B2?) |
    same(G1?, G2?, E1),
    bound_spec(N1?, B1?, Rs1),
    bound_spec(N2?, B2?, Rs2),
    reflexive_preds(Rf),
    same_doms(Q?, Rs1?, B1?, Rs2?, B2?, Rf?, E2),
    and(E1?, E2?, B).
%% The people in the marked roles of a schema-binding, a set, in the order of identifiers.
procedure marked_people(Constant?, Binding?, Peers).
marked_people(Nm, B, G?) :- ground(B?) |
    bound_spec(Nm?, B?, Rs),
    marked_of(Rs?, B?, G).
procedure marked_of(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peers).
marked_of(Rs, B, G?) :- ground(Rs?) |
    guard_roles(Rs?, 1, Gi),
    persons_of(Gi?, B?, Gp),
    sort_peers(Gp?, Gs),
    dedup(Gs?, G).
procedure same_doms(Peers?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Preds?, YesNo).
same_doms([], _, _, _, _, _, yes).
same_doms([P|Ps], Rs1, B1, Rs2, B2, Rf, B?) :-
    ground(P?), ground(Rs1?), ground(B1?), ground(Rs2?), ground(B2?), ground(Rf?) |
    reqs_at(Rs1?, B1?, P?, Rf?, R1),
    reqs_at(Rs2?, B2?, P?, Rf?, R2),
    forbs_at(Rs1?, B1?, P?, F1),
    forbs_at(Rs2?, B2?, P?, F2),
    dedup(F1?, F1s),
    dedup(F2?, F2s),
    ms_eq(R1?, R2?, E1),
    ms_eq(F1s?, F2s?, E2),
    and(E1?, E2?, E),
    same_doms1(E?, Ps?, Rs1?, B1?, Rs2?, B2?, Rf?, B).
procedure same_doms1(YesNo?, Peers?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Preds?, YesNo).
same_doms1(no, _, _, _, _, _, _, no).
same_doms1(yes, Ps, Rs1, B1, Rs2, B2, Rf, B?) :- same_doms(Ps?, Rs1?, B1?, Rs2?, B2?, Rf?, B).
%% Whether the term E names a part of the class of the entry I, the part P.
procedure term_part(Class?, Info?, Class?, YesNo).
term_part(E, I, P, B?) :- ground(E?), ground(I?), ground(P?) |
    term_of_class(E?, I?, In),
    term_part1(In?, E?, I?, P?, B).
procedure term_part1(YesNo?, Class?, Info?, Class?, YesNo).
term_part1(no, _, _, _, no).
term_part1(yes, E, I, P, B?) :- same_part(I?, E?, P?, B).
procedure mate_dom(Constant?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peer?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
mate_dom(Nm, Rs, B, Id, Sh, R?) :- ground(Rs?), ground(B?), ground(Id?), ground(Sh?) |
    dom_bindings(Nm?, Rs?, B?, Id?, Sh?, Bs),
    some_binding(Bs?, R).
%% The bindings under which the precondition at Id of the schema-binding B holds in the state Sh: "the binding's precondition at that role holds in a state if the required atoms are in it with the local variables bound by them in one way, the forbidden ones are not, and a constraint local to the role holds under that binding; its effect there is with that binding" (vGLP 613ee8d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications"; vGLP #18 Cowork to Code, Code_inbox.md, 2026-10-20 21:11 UTC, item 1): the atoms the roles sent to Id require, as a multiset, in Sh, the variables local to those roles, which B leaves standing for themselves (lv), bound by them; those they forbid not in Sh; and the constraint, where it is local to a role sent to Id (con_at), holding under that binding.  Each binding of the local variables by the required atoms is one way, the first of them giving the effect (apply_part).
procedure dom_bindings(Constant?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peer?, GAtoms?, Bindings).
dom_bindings(Nm, Rs, B, Id, Sh, Bs?) :- ground(Nm?), ground(Rs?), ground(B?), ground(Id?), ground(Sh?) |
    specs_at(Rs?, 1, B?, Id?, RsP),
    unlocal(B?, B0),
    con_at(Nm?, B?, Id?, Con),
    dom_bindings1(RsP?, B0?, Sh?, Con?, Bs).
procedure dom_bindings1(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, GAtoms?, Constraint?, Bindings).
dom_bindings1(RsP, B0, Sh, Con, Bs?) :- ground(RsP?), ground(Sh?), ground(Con?) |
    reqs_of(RsP?, Q),
    match_all(Q?, Sh?, B0?, Cs),
    dom_keep(Cs?, RsP?, Sh?, Con?, Bs).
procedure dom_keep(Bindings?, RoleSpecs?, GAtoms?, Constraint?, Bindings).
dom_keep([], _, _, _, []).
dom_keep([B|Bs], RsP, Sh, Con, R?) :- ground(B?), ground(RsP?), ground(Sh?), ground(Con?) |
    cand_ok(RsP?, B?, Sh?, O1),
    con_holds(Con?, B?, O2),
    and(O1?, O2?, Ok),
    dom_keep(Bs?, RsP?, Sh?, Con?, R1),
    keep_binding(Ok?, B?, R1?, R).
procedure reqs_of(RoleSpecs?, SAtoms).
reqs_of([], []).
reqs_of([R|Rs], Q?) :- ground(R?) | rs_req(R?, Q1), reqs_of(Rs?, Q2), app(Q1?, Q2?, Q).
%% Each role's required atoms, as a multiset, in the state, and no forbidden
%% atom whose variables are all bound in it; one with a variable free is met
%% by a binding sending it to a person or speech act the state does not name.
procedure cand_ok(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
cand_ok([], _, _, yes).
cand_ok([R|Rs], B, Sh, Out?) :- ground(R?), ground(B?), ground(Sh?) |
    rs_req(R?, Q),
    img_atoms(Q?, B?, G),
    ms_sub(G?, Sh?, B1),
    rs_forb(R?, F),
    forb_ok(F?, B?, Sh?, B2),
    and(B1?, B2?, B3),
    cand_ok1(B3?, Rs?, B?, Sh?, Out).
procedure cand_ok1(YesNo?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
cand_ok1(no, _, _, _, no).
cand_ok1(yes, Rs, B, Sh, Out?) :- cand_ok(Rs?, B?, Sh?, Out).
procedure forb_ok(SAtoms?, Binding?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
forb_ok([], _, _, yes).
forb_ok([A|As], B, Sh, R?) :- ground(A?), ground(B?), ground(Sh?) |
    atom_bound(A?, B?, Bd),
    forb_one(Bd?, A?, B?, Sh?, R1),
    forb_ok1(R1?, As?, B?, Sh?, R).
procedure forb_one(YesNo?, SAtom?, Binding?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
forb_one(no, _, _, _, yes).
forb_one(yes, A, B, Sh, R?) :- ground(Sh?) |
    img_atom(A?, B?, G),
    mem(G?, Sh?, In),
    neg(In?, R).
procedure forb_ok1(YesNo?, SAtoms?, Binding?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
forb_ok1(no, _, _, _, no).
forb_ok1(yes, As, B, Sh, R?) :- forb_ok(As?, B?, Sh?, R).

%% The effect at the agent Id of the part the term P names: its state less the atoms the schema-binding deletes there, plus those it adds, the join of those of the roles sent to Id, as multisets (GSC, Definition "Compilation"), a multiplicity k deleting or adding k copies, under the binding under which its precondition there holds, its variables local to Id's roles bound by the state: "its effect there is with that binding" (vGLP 613ee8d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications"; dom_bindings), the first of them.  The effect is applied only where the precondition holds, by the Propose of an attempt of one participant, which tests it, and by the Commit and the Outcome of an attempt the agent voted yes on, holding it prepared since, so that its state has not changed; the second clause covers the type.
procedure apply_part(Class?, Peer?, GAtoms?, GAtoms).
apply_part(P, Id, S, S1?) :- ground(P?), ground(Id?), ground(S?) |
    term_spec(P?, Nm, Rs, Bn),
    reflexive_preds(Rf),
    hat(Rf?, Id?, S?, Sh),
    dom_bindings(Nm?, Rs?, Bn?, Id?, Sh?, Bs),
    term_spec(P?, _, Rs2, Bn2),
    apply_with(Bs?, Rs2?, Bn2?, Id?, S?, S1).
procedure apply_with(Bindings?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peer?, GAtoms?, GAtoms).
apply_with([B|_], Rs, _, Id, S, S1?) :- ground(Rs?), ground(B?), ground(Id?) |
    specs_at(Rs?, 1, B?, Id?, RsP),
    joins(RsP?, B?, D, A),
    clear_split(D?, Dp, Ks),
    ms_diff(S?, Dp?, S0a),
    clear_out(S0a?, Ks?, S0),
    app(A?, S0?, S1).
apply_with([], Rs, Bn, Id, S, S1?) :- ground(Rs?), ground(Bn?), ground(Id?) |
    specs_at(Rs?, 1, Bn?, Id?, RsP),
    joins(RsP?, Bn?, D, A),
    clear_split(D?, Dp, Ks),
    ms_diff(S?, Dp?, S0a),
    clear_out(S0a?, Ks?, S0),
    app(A?, S0?, S1).
%% The atoms a schema-binding deletes at an agent, the join of those of its roles there, split into those it deletes as they are, Dp, and the images of its cleared atoms, which carry the wildcard, Ks: the effect deletes the first, and then every atom of the state that an image of a cleared atom matches, whatever its multiplicity: "yielding d_p less the deleted atoms, less every atom of d_p that a cleared atom matches, plus the added ones" (vGLP f8127b1, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications"; GSC 327e035, Definition "Compilation", K_p every atom of d_p, with its multiplicity, that matches a cleared atom).
procedure clear_split(GAtoms?, GAtoms, GAtoms).
clear_split([], [], []).
clear_split([G|Gs], D?, K?) :- ground(G?) |
    g_wild(G?, W),
    clear_split(Gs?, D1, K1),
    clear_put(W?, G?, D1?, K1?, D, K).
procedure clear_put(YesNo?, GAtom?, GAtoms?, GAtoms?, GAtoms, GAtoms).
clear_put(yes, G, D, K, D?, [G?|K?]).
clear_put(no, G, D, K, [G?|D?], K?).
%% Whether a ground atom is the image of a cleared atom: the wildcard among its arguments, or in a community name among them.
procedure g_wild(GAtom?, YesNo).
g_wild(g(_, Xs), W?) :- vals_wild(Xs?, W).
procedure vals_wild(Vals?, YesNo).
vals_wild([], no).
vals_wild([any|_], yes).
vals_wild([c(C)|Xs], W?) :- cn_wild(C?, W1), vals_wild1(W1?, Xs?, W).
vals_wild([X|Xs], W?) :- otherwise, ground(X?) | vals_wild(Xs?, W).
procedure vals_wild1(YesNo?, Vals?, YesNo).
vals_wild1(yes, _, yes).
vals_wild1(no, Xs, W?) :- vals_wild(Xs?, W).
procedure cn_wild(CName?, YesNo).
cn_wild(community(_), no).
cn_wild(dot(C, _), W?) :- cn_wild(C?, W).
cn_wild(dot_any(_), yes).
%% The state less every atom that an image of a cleared atom matches.
procedure clear_out(GAtoms?, GAtoms?, GAtoms).
clear_out(S, [], S?).
clear_out([], [_|_], []).
clear_out([G|Gs], [K|Ks], R?) :- ground(G?), ground(K?), ground(Ks?) |
    g_cleared(G?, [K?|Ks?], M),
    neg(M?, Keep),
    clear_out(Gs?, [K?|Ks?], R1),
    keep_g(Keep?, G?, R1?, R).
procedure g_cleared(GAtom?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
g_cleared(_, [], no).
g_cleared(G, [K|Ks], M?) :- ground(G?), ground(K?) |
    g_matches(K?, G?, M1),
    g_cleared1(M1?, G?, Ks?, M).
procedure g_cleared1(YesNo?, GAtom?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
g_cleared1(yes, _, _, yes).
g_cleared1(no, G, Ks, M?) :- g_cleared(G?, Ks?, M).
%% Whether the ground atom G matches the image K of a cleared atom: G is obtained from K by replacing each wildcard by an argument, a speech act where the wildcard is in a name term (GSC 327e035, Definition "Binding").
procedure g_matches(GAtom?, GAtom?, YesNo).
g_matches(g(P, Ks), g(Q, Xs), M?) :- P? =?= Q? | gm_vals(Ks?, Xs?, M).
g_matches(_, _, no) :- otherwise | true.
procedure gm_vals(Vals?, Vals?, YesNo).
gm_vals([], [], yes).
gm_vals([], [_|_], no).
gm_vals([_|_], [], no).
gm_vals([K|Ks], [X|Xs], M?) :- ground(K?), ground(X?) |
    gm_val(K?, X?, M1),
    gm_vals1(M1?, Ks?, Xs?, M).
procedure gm_vals1(YesNo?, Vals?, Vals?, YesNo).
gm_vals1(no, _, _, no).
gm_vals1(yes, Ks, Xs, M?) :- gm_vals(Ks?, Xs?, M).
procedure gm_val(Val?, Val?, YesNo).
gm_val(any, _, yes).
gm_val(c(K), c(C), M?) :- gm_cname(K?, C?, M).
gm_val(K, X, M?) :- otherwise | same(K?, X?, M).
procedure gm_cname(CName?, CName?, YesNo).
gm_cname(dot_any(K), dot(C, _), M?) :- gm_cname(K?, C?, M).
gm_cname(dot(K, S), dot(C, T), M?) :- S? =?= T? | gm_cname(K?, C?, M).
gm_cname(community(P), community(Q), yes) :- P? =?= Q? | true.
gm_cname(_, _, no) :- otherwise | true.
procedure delta_at(Deltas?, Peer?, GAtoms, GAtoms).
delta_at([], _, [], []).
delta_at([delta(P, D, A)|_], Id, D?, A?) :- P? =?= Id? | true.
delta_at([_|Ps], Id, D?, A?) :- otherwise | delta_at(Ps?, Id?, D, A).

%% ===========================================================================
%% Classes: from a term of the request type to the class it names
%% ===========================================================================

%% The class a term names, the agent's entry for it, met or new; nocls where the binding is not one (Definition "Binding": two roles share a person only if neither adds or deletes an atom naming the other; admissible), where it determines no transaction, its deleted and added atoms meeting at a participant (deltas_valid) or an atom required and forbidden there (live_at), or where the agent is no participant.  A schema-binding that determines no transaction relates no two transactions, so it is of no class (Section 5.4, the paragraph on act schemas).
procedure st_class(Class?, St?, ClassRes, St).
st_class(C, st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, Pd, Pr, Hd, Ix, Rq), R?,
        st(Id?, Ap?, D?, Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?, W?, Ca1?, Pd?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)) :-
    ground(Id?) |
    class_info(C?, Id?, Ca?, R, Ca1).
procedure class_info(Class?, Peer?, Infos?, ClassRes, Infos).
class_info(C, Id, Ca, R?, Ca1?) :- ground(C?) |
    binding_of(C?, Nm, B),
    class_info1(Nm?, B?, C?, Id?, Ca?, R, Ca1).
procedure class_info1(Constant?, Binding?, Class?, Peer?, Infos?, ClassRes, Infos).
class_info1(Nm, B, C, Id, Ca, R?, Ca1?) :- ground(Nm?), ground(B?) |
    bound_spec(Nm?, B?, Rs),
    rule_spec_ok(Nm?, B?, V0),
    con_live(Nm?, B?, Vc),
    and(V0?, Vc?, V1),
    class_info2(V1?, Rs?, B?, C?, Id?, Ca?, R, Ca1).
procedure class_info2(YesNo?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Class?, Peer?, Infos?, ClassRes, Infos).
class_info2(V1, Rs, B, C, Id, Ca, R?, Ca1?) :- ground(Rs?), ground(B?) |
    admissible(Rs?, B?, V2),
    and(V1?, V2?, V),
    class_info3(V?, Rs?, B?, C?, Id?, Ca?, R, Ca1).
procedure class_info3(YesNo?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Class?, Peer?, Infos?, ClassRes, Infos).
class_info3(no, _, _, _, _, Ca, nocls, Ca?).
class_info3(yes, Rs, B, C, Id, Ca, R?, Ca1?) :- ground(Rs?), ground(B?) |
    sig_of(Rs?, B?, Ps),
    class_info4(Ps?, Rs?, B?, C?, Id?, Ca?, R, Ca1).
procedure class_info4(Deltas?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Class?, Peer?, Infos?, ClassRes, Infos).
class_info4(Ps, Rs, B, C, Id, Ca, R?, Ca1?) :- ground(Ps?), ground(Id?), ground(Rs?), ground(B?) |
    deltas_valid(Ps?, V1),
    deltas_peers(Ps?, Q),
    mem(Id?, Q?, V2),
    deltas_peers(Ps?, Q1),
    reflexive_preds(Rf),
    live_at(Q1?, Rs?, B?, Rf?, V3),
    and(V1?, V2?, V12),
    and(V12?, V3?, V),
    class_info5(V?, Ps?, Rs?, B?, C?, Id?, Ca?, R, Ca1).
procedure class_info5(YesNo?, Deltas?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Class?, Peer?, Infos?, ClassRes, Infos).
class_info5(no, _, _, _, _, _, Ca, nocls, Ca?).
class_info5(yes, Ps, Rs, B, C, Id, Ca, R?, Ca1?) :- ground(Ps?), ground(Ca?) |
    cache_find(Rs?, B?, Ps?, Ca?, F),
    class_info6(F?, Ps?, C?, Id?, Ca?, R, Ca1).
procedure class_info6(ClassRes?, Deltas?, Class?, Peer?, Infos?, ClassRes, Infos).
class_info6(cls(I), _, _, _, Ca, cls(I?), Ca?).
class_info6(nocls, Ps, C, Id, Ca, R?, Ca1?) :-
    new_info(C?, Ps?, Id?, I),
    add_info(I?, Ca?, R, Ca1).
procedure add_info(Info?, Infos?, ClassRes, Infos).
add_info(I, Ca, cls(I?), Ca1?) :- ground(I?) | app(Ca?, [I?], Ca1).

%% The agent's entry for the class of a schema-binding of the participants and atoms Ps: the entry one of whose schema-bindings it is linked to (in_class), and nocls where none is.
procedure cache_find(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Deltas?, Infos?, ClassRes).
cache_find(_, _, _, [], nocls).
cache_find(Rs, B, Ps, [ci(C, Ps1, Q, Pts, Ms)|Is], R?) :-
    ground(Rs?), ground(B?), ground(Ps?), ground(Ps1?), ground(Q?), ground(Ms?) |
    in_class(Rs?, B?, Ps?, Ps1?, Q?, Ms?, E),
    cache_find1(E?, ci(C?, Ps1?, Q?, Pts?, Ms?), Rs?, B?, Ps?, Is?, R).
procedure cache_find1(YesNo?, Info?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Deltas?, Infos?, ClassRes).
cache_find1(yes, I, _, _, _, _, cls(I?)).
cache_find1(no, _, Rs, B, Ps, Is, R?) :- cache_find(Rs?, B?, Ps?, Is?, R).

%% A new entry, for the class of the term C at the agent Id: the schema-bindings of the participants and atoms Ps that determine a transaction (mates_of, live_mates), and among them the class of C's schema-binding, those a chain of links joins to it (class_mates), with the parts they determine (info_parts_of).
procedure new_info(Class?, Deltas?, Peer?, Info).
new_info(C, Ps, Id, I?) :- ground(Ps?) |
    contract_schemas(Ss),
    reflexive_preds(Rf),
    mates_of(Ss?, Ps?, Ms0),
    dedup_mates(Ms0?, Ms1),
    deltas_peers(Ps?, Q),
    new_info0(C?, Ps?, Ms1?, Q?, Rf?, Id?, I).
procedure new_info0(Class?, Deltas?, Mates?, Peers?, Preds?, Peer?, Info).
new_info0(C, Ps, Ms1, Q, Rf, Id, I?) :- ground(C?), ground(Q?), ground(Rf?) |
    live_mates(Ms1?, Q?, Rf?, Ms2),
    binding_of(C?, Nm, B),
    class_mates(Nm?, B?, Ms2?, Q?, Rf?, Ms),
    new_info1(C?, Ps?, Ms?, Id?, I).
procedure new_info1(Class?, Deltas?, Mates?, Peer?, Info).
new_info1(C, Ps, Ms, Id, ci(C?, Ps?, Q?, Pts?, Ms?)) :- ground(Ps?), ground(Ms?) |
    deltas_peers(Ps?, Q),
    deltas_peers(Ps?, Q1),
    info_parts_of(Ms?, Q1?, Id?, Pts).

procedure info_q(Info?, Peers).
info_q(ci(_, _, Q, _, _), Q?).
procedure info_parts(Info?, Parts).
info_parts(ci(_, _, _, Pts, _), Pts?).

%% The participants of a class and the atoms each deletes and adds: the join
%% of those of the roles sent to it (GSC, Definition "Compilation").
procedure sig_of(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Deltas).
sig_of(Rs, B, Ps?) :- ground(Rs?), ground(B?) |
    role_persons(Rs?, 1, B?, Ws),
    dedup(Ws?, Q),
    deltas_for(Q?, Rs?, B?, Ps).
procedure role_persons(RoleSpecs?, Integer?, Binding?, Peers).
role_persons([], _, _, []).
role_persons([_|Rs], I, B, [P?|Ps?]) :- integer(I?), ground(B?) |
    role_person(I?, B?, P),
    I1 := I? + 1,
    role_persons(Rs?, I1?, B?, Ps).
procedure deltas_for(Peers?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Deltas).
deltas_for([], _, _, []).
deltas_for([P|Ps], Rs, B, [delta(P?, D?, A?)|Xs?]) :- ground(P?), ground(Rs?), ground(B?) |
    specs_at(Rs?, 1, B?, P?, RsP),
    joins(RsP?, B?, D, A),
    deltas_for(Ps?, Rs?, B?, Xs).
procedure joins(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, GAtoms, GAtoms).
joins(RsP, B, D?, A?) :- ground(RsP?), ground(B?) |
    dels_join(RsP?, B?, [], D),
    adds_join(RsP?, B?, [], A).
procedure dels_join(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, GAtoms?, GAtoms).
dels_join([], _, Acc, Acc?).
dels_join([R|Rs], B, Acc, Out?) :- ground(B?) |
    rs_del(R?, D),
    img_atoms(D?, B?, G),
    ms_join(Acc?, G?, Acc1),
    dels_join(Rs?, B?, Acc1?, Out).
procedure adds_join(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, GAtoms?, GAtoms).
adds_join([], _, Acc, Acc?).
adds_join([R|Rs], B, Acc, Out?) :- ground(B?) |
    rs_add(R?, A),
    img_atoms(A?, B?, G),
    ms_join(Acc?, G?, Acc1),
    adds_join(Rs?, B?, Acc1?, Out).
procedure specs_at(RoleSpecs?, Integer?, Binding?, Peer?, RoleSpecs).
specs_at([], _, _, _, []).
specs_at([R|Rs], I, B, P, Out?) :- integer(I?), ground(B?), ground(P?) |
    role_person(I?, B?, Q),
    I1 := I? + 1,
    specs_at(Rs?, I1?, B?, P?, Rest),
    keep_spec(Q?, P?, R?, Rest?, Out).
procedure keep_spec(Peer?, Peer?, RoleSpec?, RoleSpecs?, RoleSpecs).
keep_spec(Q, P, R, Rest, [R?|Rest?]) :- Q? =?= P? | true.
keep_spec(_, _, _, Rest, Rest?) :- otherwise | true.
procedure deltas_valid(Deltas?, YesNo).
deltas_valid([], yes).
deltas_valid([delta(_, D, A)|Ps], B?) :- ground(A?) |
    ms_meets(D?, A?, M),
    neg(M?, B1),
    deltas_valid1(B1?, Ps?, B).
procedure deltas_valid1(YesNo?, Deltas?, YesNo).
deltas_valid1(no, _, no).
deltas_valid1(yes, Ps, B?) :- deltas_valid(Ps?, B).
procedure deltas_peers(Deltas?, Peers).
deltas_peers([], []).
deltas_peers([delta(P, _, _)|Ps], [P?|Qs?]) :- deltas_peers(Ps?, Qs).
procedure deltas_eq(Deltas?, Deltas?, YesNo).
deltas_eq(A, B, E?) :- ground(A?), ground(B?) |
    len_deltas(A?, La),
    len_deltas(B?, Lb),
    same_int(La?, Lb?, E1),
    deltas_in(A?, B?, E2),
    and(E1?, E2?, E).
procedure len_deltas(Deltas?, Integer).
len_deltas([], 0).
len_deltas([_|Ps], N?) :- len_deltas(Ps?, M), N := M? + 1.
procedure deltas_in(Deltas?, Deltas?, YesNo).
deltas_in([], _, yes).
deltas_in([X|Xs], B, E?) :- ground(B?) |
    delta_in(X?, B?, E1),
    deltas_in1(E1?, Xs?, B?, E).
procedure deltas_in1(YesNo?, Deltas?, Deltas?, YesNo).
deltas_in1(no, _, _, no).
deltas_in1(yes, Xs, B, E?) :- deltas_in(Xs?, B?, E).
procedure delta_in(Delta?, Deltas?, YesNo).
delta_in(_, [], no).
delta_in(delta(P, D, A), [delta(Q, D1, A1)|Ps], E?) :- P? =?= Q?, ground(D?), ground(A?) |
    ms_eq(D?, D1?, E1),
    ms_eq(A?, A1?, E2),
    and(E1?, E2?, E3),
    delta_in1(E3?, delta(P?, D?, A?), Ps?, E).
delta_in(X, [_|Ps], E?) :- otherwise | delta_in(X?, Ps?, E).
procedure delta_in1(YesNo?, Delta?, Deltas?, YesNo).
delta_in1(yes, _, _, yes).
delta_in1(no, X, Ps, E?) :- delta_in(X?, Ps?, E).

%% Definition "Binding": two roles sent to one person only if neither adds or
%% deletes an atom naming the other.
procedure rule_ok(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, YesNo).
rule_ok(Rs, B, R?) :- ground(Rs?) |
    rs_len(Rs?, K),
    pairs_ok(1, K?, Rs?, B?, R).
procedure pairs_ok(Integer?, Integer?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, YesNo).
pairs_ok(I, K, _, _, yes) :- I? > K? | true.
pairs_ok(I, K, Rs, B, R?) :- I? =< K?, ground(Rs?), ground(B?) |
    J := I? + 1,
    pair_row(I?, J?, K?, Rs?, B?, R1),
    I1 := I? + 1,
    pairs_ok1(R1?, I1?, K?, Rs?, B?, R).
procedure pairs_ok1(YesNo?, Integer?, Integer?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, YesNo).
pairs_ok1(no, _, _, _, _, no).
pairs_ok1(yes, I, K, Rs, B, R?) :- pairs_ok(I?, K?, Rs?, B?, R).
procedure pair_row(Integer?, Integer?, Integer?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, YesNo).
pair_row(_, J, K, _, _, yes) :- J? > K? | true.
pair_row(I, J, K, Rs, B, R?) :- J? =< K?, ground(Rs?), ground(B?) |
    role_person(I?, B?, P),
    role_person(J?, B?, Q),
    nth_spec(Rs?, I?, RI),
    nth_spec(Rs?, J?, RJ),
    pair_ok(P?, Q?, RI?, RJ?, I?, J?, R1),
    J1 := J? + 1,
    pair_row1(R1?, I?, J1?, K?, Rs?, B?, R).
procedure pair_row1(YesNo?, Integer?, Integer?, Integer?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, YesNo).
pair_row1(no, _, _, _, _, _, no).
pair_row1(yes, I, J, K, Rs, B, R?) :- pair_row(I?, J?, K?, Rs?, B?, R).
procedure pair_ok(Peer?, Peer?, RoleSpec?, RoleSpec?, Integer?, Integer?, YesNo).
pair_ok(P, Q, RI, RJ, I, J, R?) :- P? =?= Q? |
    role_names(RI?, J?, A1),
    role_names(RJ?, I?, A2),
    or(A1?, A2?, A),
    neg(A?, R).
pair_ok(_, _, _, _, _, _, yes) :- otherwise | true.
procedure role_names(RoleSpec?, Integer?, YesNo).
role_names(rs(_, A, D, _, _), J, R?) :- integer(J?) |
    names_role(A?, J?, R1),
    names_role(D?, J?, R2),
    or(R1?, R2?, R).
%% An atom names a role among its arguments, the base of a name term among them, or the role of a signed term
%% among them (GSC, Section 3: "An atom names what is among its arguments or
%% is the signer of one: ... in a schema a role or a variable, the role of a
%% signed term included").
procedure names_role(SAtoms?, Integer?, YesNo).
names_role([], _, no).
names_role([times(_, A)|As], J, R?) :- names_role([A?|As?], J?, R).
names_role([atom(_, Vs)|As], J, R?) :- integer(J?), ground(Vs?) |
    flat_names(Vs?, Fs),
    mem(role(J?), Fs?, R1),
    sgn_names(Vs?, J?, R2),
    or(R1?, R2?, R12),
    names_role1(R12?, As?, J?, R).
procedure names_role1(YesNo?, SAtoms?, Integer?, YesNo).
names_role1(yes, _, _, yes).
names_role1(no, As, J, R?) :- names_role(As?, J?, R).
procedure sgn_names(Vars?, Integer?, YesNo).
sgn_names([], _, no).
sgn_names([sgn(_, I)|_], J, yes) :- I? =:= J? | true.
sgn_names([_|Vs], J, R?) :- otherwise | sgn_names(Vs?, J?, R).

%% Definition "Binding", admissible: a speech-act variable in an atom added at
%% a role and in no atom required at a role is sent to a speech act signed by
%% the person in a guarding role.
procedure admissible(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, YesNo).
admissible(Rs, B, R?) :- ground(Rs?), ground(B?) |
    adds_of(Rs?, Ad),
    reqs_of(Rs?, Rq),
    guard_roles(Rs?, 1, Gi),
    persons_of(Gi?, B?, Gp),
    atoms_vars(Ad?, Av),
    adm_each(Av?, Rq?, B?, Gp?, R).
procedure adm_each(Vars?, SAtoms?, Binding?, Peers?, YesNo).
adm_each([], _, _, _, yes).
adm_each([V|Vs], Rq, B, Gp, R?) :- ground(V?), ground(Rq?), ground(B?), ground(Gp?) |
    adm_var(V?, Rq?, B?, Gp?, R1),
    adm_each1(R1?, Vs?, Rq?, B?, Gp?, R).
procedure adm_each1(YesNo?, Vars?, SAtoms?, Binding?, Peers?, YesNo).
adm_each1(no, _, _, _, _, no).
adm_each1(yes, Vs, Rq, B, Gp, R?) :- adm_each(Vs?, Rq?, B?, Gp?, R).
procedure adm_var(Var?, SAtoms?, Binding?, Peers?, YesNo).
adm_var(svar(X), Rq, B, Gp, R?) :- ground(X?), ground(B?) |
    atoms_vars(Rq?, Qv),
    mem(svar(X?), Qv?, InReq),
    lookup(svar(X?), B?, F),
    adm_var1(InReq?, F?, Gp?, R).
adm_var(role(_), _, _, _, yes).
adm_var(pvar(_), _, _, _, yes).
%% The variables of a name term are taken apart (atoms_vars); the clause covers the type.
adm_var(nterm(_), _, _, _, yes).
%% A signed term's speech-act variable occurs in an atom some role requires
%% (GSC, Definition "Act schema"), so it asks nothing of the binding.
adm_var(sgn(_, _), _, _, _, yes).
%% A number names no agent, so admissibility does not concern it (GSC, Section 3.2).
adm_var(num(_), _, _, _, yes).
%% The wildcard is in no added atom (GSC 327e035, Definition "Speech-act schema"); the clause covers the type.
adm_var(any, _, _, _, yes).
procedure adm_var1(YesNo?, Found?, Peers?, YesNo).
adm_var1(yes, _, _, yes).
adm_var1(no, found(s(speech(_, P))), Gp, R?) :- mem(P?, Gp?, R).
adm_var1(no, found(p(_)), _, no).
adm_var1(no, found(c(_)), _, no).
adm_var1(no, found(n(_)), _, no).
adm_var1(no, found(lv(_, _)), _, no).
adm_var1(no, free, _, no).
adm_var1(no, found(any), _, no).
procedure adds_of(RoleSpecs?, SAtoms).
adds_of([], []).
adds_of([R|Rs], A?) :- rs_add(R?, A1), adds_of(Rs?, A2), app(A1?, A2?, A).
procedure atoms_vars(SAtoms?, Vars).
atoms_vars([], []).
atoms_vars([atom(_, Vs)|As], R?) :- flat_names(Vs?, Ws), atoms_vars(As?, R1), app(Ws?, R1?, R).
atoms_vars([times(V, A)|As], [V?|R?]) :- atoms_vars([A?|As?], R).
procedure guard_roles(RoleSpecs?, Integer?, Ints).
guard_roles([], _, []).
guard_roles([rs(guarded, _, _, _, _)|Rs], I, [I?|Is?]) :- integer(I?) |
    I1 := I? + 1,
    guard_roles(Rs?, I1?, Is).
guard_roles([rs(unguarded, _, _, _, _)|Rs], I, Is?) :- integer(I?) |
    I1 := I? + 1,
    guard_roles(Rs?, I1?, Is).
procedure persons_of(Ints?, Binding?, Peers).
persons_of([], _, []).
persons_of([I|Is], B, [P?|Ps?]) :- ground(B?) |
    role_person(I?, B?, P),
    persons_of(Is?, B?, Ps).

%% --- The schema-bindings of a class's participants and atoms: those of every
%% --- schema whose roles, sent onto the participants, delete and add exactly
%% --- the class's atoms; the class is those a chain of links joins (below) ---
procedure mates_of(Schemas?, Deltas?, Mates).
mates_of([], _, []).
mates_of([schema(Nm, _, Rs)|Ss], Ps, M?) :- ground(Nm?), ground(Rs?), ground(Ps?) |
    deltas_peers(Ps?, Q),
    rs_len(Rs?, K),
    fit_assigns(K?, Q?, Rs?, Ps?, As),
    mates_assigns(As?, Nm?, Rs?, Ps?, M1),
    mates_of(Ss?, Ps?, M2),
    app(M1?, M2?, M).
%% A schema with listed roles: each assignment of its roles to the participants, each listed role's place sent to its base person, extended by each choice, for each listed role, of a list of participants as its people, a set, in the order of identifiers, its roles of that list (bound_spec, tuple_binds).
mates_of([lschema(Nm, _, Rs, Lsts)|Ss], Ps, M?) :- ground(Nm?), ground(Rs?), ground(Lsts?), ground(Ps?) |
    deltas_peers(Ps?, Q),
    rs_len(Rs?, K),
    blank_listed(Lsts?, Rs?, Rs0),
    fit_assigns(K?, Q?, Rs0?, Ps?, As0),
    on_base(As0?, Lsts?, As),
    deltas_peers(Ps?, Q1),
    sort_peers(Q1?, Q2),
    subsets(Q2?, Ls),
    tuples(Lsts?, Ls?, Ts),
    listed_mates(Ts?, As?, Nm?, Rs?, Lsts?, Ps?, M1),
    mates_of(Ss?, Ps?, M2),
    app(M1?, M2?, M).
procedure on_base(Bindings?, Listings?, Bindings).
on_base([], _, []).
on_base([B|Bs], Lsts, R?) :- ground(B?), ground(Lsts?) |
    on_bases(Lsts?, B?, E),
    on_base(Bs?, Lsts?, R1),
    keep_binding(E?, B?, R1?, R).
%% Whether each listed role's place is sent to its base person.
procedure on_bases(Listings?, Binding?, YesNo).
on_bases([], _, yes).
on_bases([listing(I, Bi, _, _)|Lsts], B, E?) :- ground(B?) |
    role_person(I?, B?, P),
    role_person(Bi?, B?, Q),
    same(P?, Q?, E1),
    on_bases(Lsts?, B?, E2),
    and(E1?, E2?, E).
procedure keep_binding(YesNo?, Binding?, Bindings?, Bindings).
keep_binding(yes, B, R, [B?|R?]).
keep_binding(no, _, R, R?).
procedure subsets(Peers?, PeerLists).
subsets([], [[]]).
subsets([P|Ps], R?) :- ground(P?), ground(Ps?) |
    subsets(Ps?, S1),
    with_first(S1?, P?, S2),
    subsets(Ps?, S3),
    app(S2?, S3?, R).
procedure with_first(PeerLists?, Peer?, PeerLists).
with_first([], _, []).
with_first([L|Ls], P, [[P?|L?]|R?]) :- ground(P?) | with_first(Ls?, P?, R).
%% Each choice of one list of Ls for each listed role of Lsts, in the order of the roles.
procedure tuples(Listings?, PeerLists?, ListTuples).
tuples([], _, [[]]).
tuples([_|Lsts], Ls, R?) :- ground(Ls?) |
    tuples(Lsts?, Ls?, R1),
    prepend_each(Ls?, R1?, R).
procedure prepend_each(PeerLists?, ListTuples?, ListTuples).
prepend_each([], _, []).
prepend_each([L|Ls], Ts, R?) :- ground(L?), ground(Ts?) |
    with_head(Ts?, L?, R1),
    prepend_each(Ls?, Ts?, R2),
    app(R1?, R2?, R).
procedure with_head(ListTuples?, Peers?, ListTuples).
with_head([], _, []).
with_head([T|Ts], L, [[L?|T?]|R?]) :- ground(L?) | with_head(Ts?, L?, R).
procedure listed_mates(ListTuples?, Bindings?, Constant?, RoleSpecs?, Listings?, Deltas?, Mates).
listed_mates([], _, _, _, _, _, []).
listed_mates([T|Ts], As, Nm, Rs, Lsts, Ps, M?) :-
    ground(T?), ground(As?), ground(Nm?), ground(Rs?), ground(Lsts?), ground(Ps?) |
    rs_len(Rs?, K),
    K1 := K? + 1,
    tuple_binds(Lsts?, T?, K1?, Cs),
    extend_all(As?, Cs?, Bs),
    spec_for(Rs?, Lsts?, T?, Rs1),
    mates_assigns(Bs?, Nm?, Rs1?, Ps?, M1),
    listed_mates(Ts?, As?, Nm?, Rs?, Lsts?, Ps?, M2),
    app(M1?, M2?, M).
procedure extend_all(Bindings?, Binding?, Bindings).
extend_all([], _, []).
extend_all([B|Bs], Cs, [B1?|R?]) :- ground(Cs?) | app(B?, Cs?, B1), extend_all(Bs?, Cs?, R).
%% fit_assigns(K, Q, Rs, Ps, As): the assignments of the roles 1..K, of the role specifications Rs, to the participants Q, each binding b(role(I), p(P)) put in front, in the order assigns gives them (role 1 the outermost), but only those whose every role's deleted and added atoms match, under the roles assigned before it and itself, into the atoms the class's changes Ps delete and add at its person: an assignment where some role's do not determines no schema-binding of the class, its match_deltas finding none, and it is not tried (Code #12's change 5, vGLP #18 Cowork, Code_inbox.md 2026-10-20 12:03 UTC: "found by matching each schema's deleted and added atoms against the class's changes at each participant, not by trying every assignment of participants to roles").  So the schema-bindings found, and their order, are those of every assignment.
procedure fit_assigns(Integer?, Peers?, RoleSpecs?, Deltas?, Bindings).
fit_assigns(K, Q, Rs, Ps, As?) :- fit_roles(1, K?, Q?, Rs?, Ps?, [], As).
procedure fit_roles(Integer?, Integer?, Peers?, RoleSpecs?, Deltas?, Binding?, Bindings).
fit_roles(I, K, _, _, _, B, [B?]) :- I? > K? | true.
fit_roles(I, K, Q, Rs, Ps, B, As?) :- I? =< K?, ground(Q?), ground(Rs?) |
    nth_spec(Rs?, I?, R),
    fit_one(Q?, I?, K?, Q?, R?, Rs?, Ps?, B?, As).
procedure fit_one(Peers?, Integer?, Integer?, Peers?, RoleSpec?, RoleSpecs?, Deltas?, Binding?, Bindings).
fit_one([], _, _, _, _, _, _, _, []).
fit_one([P|Qs], I, K, Q, R, Rs, Ps, B, As?) :-
    ground(P?), integer(I?), ground(Q?), ground(R?), ground(Rs?), ground(Ps?), ground(B?) |
    fits(R?, [b(role(I?), p(P?))|B?], P?, Ps?, Ok),
    I1 := I? + 1,
    fit_next(Ok?, I1?, K?, Q?, Rs?, Ps?, [b(role(I?), p(P?))|B?], As1),
    fit_one(Qs?, I?, K?, Q?, R?, Rs?, Ps?, B?, As2),
    app(As1?, As2?, As).
procedure fit_next(YesNo?, Integer?, Integer?, Peers?, RoleSpecs?, Deltas?, Binding?, Bindings).
fit_next(no, _, _, _, _, _, _, []).
fit_next(yes, I, K, Q, Rs, Ps, B, As?) :- fit_roles(I?, K?, Q?, Rs?, Ps?, B?, As).
%% Whether the deleted and added atoms of the role R, sent to the participant P, match under the binding B into the atoms P deletes and adds, as match_delta1 matches them.
procedure fits(RoleSpec?, Binding?, Peer?, Deltas?, YesNo).
fits(R, B, P, Ps, Ok?) :- ground(R?) |
    delta_at(Ps?, P?, D, A),
    rs_del(R?, Dr),
    rs_add(R?, Ar),
    match_all(Dr?, D?, B?, Bs),
    match_all_each(Bs?, Ar?, A?, Ms),
    some_binding(Ms?, Ok).
procedure some_binding(Bindings?, YesNo).
some_binding([], no).
some_binding([_|_], yes).
procedure assigns(Integer?, Peers?, Bindings).
assigns(K, Q, R?) :- assigns1(1, K?, Q?, [[]], R).
procedure assigns1(Integer?, Integer?, Peers?, Bindings?, Bindings).
assigns1(I, K, _, Acc, Acc?) :- I? > K? | true.
assigns1(I, K, Q, Acc, R?) :- I? =< K?, ground(Q?) |
    extend_role(Acc?, I?, Q?, Acc1),
    I1 := I? + 1,
    assigns1(I1?, K?, Q?, Acc1?, R).
procedure extend_role(Bindings?, Integer?, Peers?, Bindings).
extend_role([], _, _, []).
extend_role([B|Bs], I, Q, R?) :- ground(B?), integer(I?), ground(Q?) |
    extend_one(Q?, I?, B?, R1),
    extend_role(Bs?, I?, Q?, R2),
    app(R1?, R2?, R).
procedure extend_one(Peers?, Integer?, Binding?, Bindings).
extend_one([], _, _, []).
extend_one([P|Ps], I, B, [[b(role(I?), p(P?))|B?]|R?]) :- ground(B?), integer(I?) |
    extend_one(Ps?, I?, B?, R).
procedure mates_assigns(Bindings?, Constant?, RoleSpecs?, Deltas?, Mates).
mates_assigns([], _, _, _, []).
mates_assigns([B|Bs], Nm, Rs, Ps, M?) :- ground(B?), ground(Nm?), ground(Rs?), ground(Ps?) |
    deltas_peers(Ps?, Q),
    role_persons(Rs?, 1, B?, Ws),
    all_in(Q?, Ws?, Onto),
    rule_spec_ok(Nm?, B?, Ok),
    and(Onto?, Ok?, Go),
    mates_assign(Go?, B?, Nm?, Rs?, Ps?, M1),
    mates_assigns(Bs?, Nm?, Rs?, Ps?, M2),
    app(M1?, M2?, M).
procedure mates_assign(YesNo?, Binding?, Constant?, RoleSpecs?, Deltas?, Mates).
mates_assign(no, _, _, _, _, []).
mates_assign(yes, B, Nm, Rs, Ps, M?) :- ground(Rs?), ground(Ps?) |
    match_deltas(Ps?, Rs?, [B?], Bs),
    mates_check(Bs?, Nm?, Rs?, Ps?, M).
procedure match_deltas(Deltas?, RoleSpecs?, Bindings?, Bindings).
match_deltas([], _, Bs, Bs?).
match_deltas([delta(P, D, A)|Ps], Rs, Bs, R?) :- ground(P?), ground(D?), ground(A?), ground(Rs?) |
    match_delta(Bs?, P?, D?, A?, Rs?, Bs1),
    match_deltas(Ps?, Rs?, Bs1?, R).
procedure match_delta(Bindings?, Peer?, GAtoms?, GAtoms?, RoleSpecs?, Bindings).
match_delta([], _, _, _, _, []).
match_delta([B|Bs], P, D, A, Rs, R?) :- ground(B?), ground(P?), ground(D?), ground(A?), ground(Rs?) |
    specs_at(Rs?, 1, B?, P?, RsP),
    match_delta1(RsP?, B?, D?, A?, B2),
    match_delta(Bs?, P?, D?, A?, Rs?, R2),
    app(B2?, R2?, R).
procedure match_delta1(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, GAtoms?, GAtoms?, Bindings).
match_delta1(RsP, B, D, A, R?) :- ground(RsP?), ground(A?) |
    dels_of(RsP?, Dp),
    adds_of(RsP?, Ap),
    match_all(Dp?, D?, B?, B1),
    match_all_each(B1?, Ap?, A?, R).
procedure dels_of(RoleSpecs?, SAtoms).
dels_of([], []).
dels_of([R|Rs], A?) :- rs_del(R?, A1), dels_of(Rs?, A2), app(A1?, A2?, A).
procedure mates_check(Bindings?, Constant?, RoleSpecs?, Deltas?, Mates).
mates_check([], _, _, _, []).
mates_check([B|Bs], Nm, Rs, Ps, M?) :- ground(B?), ground(Nm?), ground(Rs?), ground(Ps?) |
    local_norm(Nm?, B?, Nb),
    mates_check1(Nb?, Nm?, Rs?, Ps?, M1),
    mates_check(Bs?, Nm?, Rs?, Ps?, M2),
    app(M1?, M2?, M).
procedure mates_check1(LNorm?, Constant?, RoleSpecs?, Deltas?, Mates).
mates_check1(badnorm, _, _, _, []).
mates_check1(norm(B), Nm, Rs, Ps, M?) :- ground(B?), ground(Nm?), ground(Rs?), ground(Ps?) |
    sig_of(Rs?, B?, Ps1),
    deltas_eq(Ps?, Ps1?, E1),
    admissible(Rs?, B?, E2),
    and(E1?, E2?, E),
    mate_of(E?, B?, Nm?, Rs?, M).
%% A schema-binding found by matching a schema's deleted and added atoms with a class's: the variables local to a role are not bound by it, and stand for themselves, lv(S, X) (the type Val), so a local variable matched with lv(S, X) of its own schema S, or with nothing, is left so, and a binding that sends a local variable to anything else, or a variable that is not local to lv, is no schema-binding of the class (vGLP 613ee8d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications": "A numeric variable that occurs only in atoms the schema requires or deletes at one role, and in the constraint, is local to that role: the schema-binding does not bind it").  A class whose schema-binding deletes or adds an atom with a local variable so holds the schema-bindings of its own schema of those atoms.
procedure local_norm(Constant?, Binding?, LNorm).
local_norm(Nm, B, R?) :- ground(Nm?), ground(B?) |
    schema_numeric(Nm?, N),
    local_norm1(N?, Nm?, B?, R).
procedure local_norm1(Numeric?, Constant?, Binding?, LNorm).
local_norm1(numeric(_, Ls, _), Nm, B, R?) :- ground(Ls?), ground(Nm?), ground(B?) |
    lv_wrong(B?, Ls?, Nm?, W),
    locals_put(Ls?, Nm?, B?, B1),
    norm_or_bad(W?, B1?, R).
procedure norm_or_bad(YesNo?, Binding?, LNorm).
norm_or_bad(no, B, norm(B?)).
norm_or_bad(yes, _, badnorm).
procedure lv_wrong(Binding?, Vars?, Constant?, YesNo).
lv_wrong([], _, _, no).
lv_wrong([b(V, X)|Bs], Ls, Nm, W?) :- ground(V?), ground(X?), ground(Ls?), ground(Nm?) |
    mem(V?, Ls?, IsL),
    entry_wrong(IsL?, V?, X?, Nm?, W1),
    lv_wrong(Bs?, Ls?, Nm?, W2),
    or(W1?, W2?, W).
procedure entry_wrong(YesNo?, Var?, Val?, Constant?, YesNo).
entry_wrong(yes, V, X, Nm, W?) :- local_wrong(V?, X?, Nm?, W).
entry_wrong(no, _, X, _, W?) :- is_lv(X?, W).
procedure local_wrong(Var?, Val?, Constant?, YesNo).
local_wrong(num(Xn), X, Nm, W?) :- ground(Xn?), ground(Nm?) | same(X?, lv(Nm?, Xn?), S), neg(S?, W).
local_wrong(_, _, _, yes) :- otherwise | true.
procedure is_lv(Val?, YesNo).
is_lv(lv(_, _), yes).
is_lv(p(_), no).
is_lv(s(_), no).
is_lv(c(_), no).
is_lv(n(_), no).
is_lv(any, no).
procedure locals_put(Vars?, Constant?, Binding?, Binding).
locals_put([], _, B, B?).
locals_put([V|Vs], Nm, B, B2?) :- ground(V?), ground(Nm?), ground(B?) |
    lookup(V?, B?, F),
    local_put(F?, V?, Nm?, B?, B1),
    locals_put(Vs?, Nm?, B1?, B2).
procedure local_put(Found?, Var?, Constant?, Binding?, Binding).
local_put(free, num(X), Nm, B, [b(num(X?), lv(Nm?, X?))|B?]) :- ground(X?), ground(Nm?) | true.
local_put(found(_), _, _, B, B?).
local_put(free, V, _, B, B?) :- otherwise, ground(V?) | true.
procedure mate_of(YesNo?, Binding?, Constant?, RoleSpecs?, Mates).
mate_of(no, _, _, _, []).
mate_of(yes, B, Nm, Rs, [mate(Nm?, B?, G?, F?)]) :- ground(B?), ground(Rs?) |
    guard_roles(Rs?, 1, Gi),
    persons_of(Gi?, B?, Gp),
    sort_peers(Gp?, Gs),
    dedup(Gs?, G),
    role_person(1, B?, F).
procedure dedup_mates(Mates?, Mates).
dedup_mates([], []).
dedup_mates([M|Ms], [M?|R?]) :- ground(M?) |
    drop_mate(M?, Ms?, Ms1),
    dedup_mates(Ms1?, R).
procedure drop_mate(Mate?, Mates?, Mates).
drop_mate(_, [], []).
drop_mate(mate(N, B, G, F), [mate(N1, B1, G1, F1)|Ms], R?) :-
    ground(N?), ground(B?), ground(G?), ground(F?), ground(N1?), ground(B1?) |
    same(N?, N1?, E1),
    ms_eq(B?, B1?, E2),
    and(E1?, E2?, E),
    drop_mate1(E?, mate(N?, B?, G?, F?), mate(N1?, B1?, G1?, F1?), Ms?, R).
procedure drop_mate1(YesNo?, Mate?, Mate?, Mates?, Mates).
drop_mate1(yes, M, _, Ms, R?) :- drop_mate(M?, Ms?, R).
drop_mate1(no, M, M1, Ms, [M1?|R?]) :- drop_mate(M?, Ms?, R).
%% The parts the schema-bindings Ms of a class determine, each pt(T, G, Op), in the order of Ms: named by the term T of the first of its schema-bindings, a schema-binding of the part of one before it naming no other part; its guard set G, the people in the marked roles of its schema-bindings; and, for an unguarded part, its opener, opener(P), P "the least, in the order of identifiers, of the people in the first role of the schema-bindings that determine it"; for a guarded part determined by a schema with a listed role whose base is not a guarding role, opener(P), P the least of the people in the first role of those schema-bindings that is not a guard of the part, "and so is the opener of a guarded part determined by a schema with a listed role whose base is not a guarding role, where that person is not a guard of the part" (vGLP a890465, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications"); and for every other guarded part guarded_part.  An opener per part is one the agent finds: an unguarded part has its opener in the first role of one of its schema-bindings, so the agent, which finds among its own transactions the classes of the unguarded schemas with it in their first role, finds every part it opens (vGLP #15, Code_inbox.md, 2026-10-19 10:50 UTC, item 3).
procedure info_parts_of(Mates?, Peers?, Peer?, Parts).
info_parts_of(Ms, Q, Id, Pts?) :- ground(Ms?) | parts_of(Ms?, Ms?, Q?, Id?, [], Pts).
%% parts_of(Ms, All, Q, Id, Seen, Pts): the parts of the schema-bindings Ms that are not the part of one of Seen, the openers taken over All.
procedure parts_of(Mates?, Mates?, Peers?, Peer?, Mates?, Parts).
parts_of([], _, _, _, _, []).
parts_of([M|Ms], All, Q, Id, Seen, Pts?) :- ground(M?), ground(Q?), ground(Seen?) |
    part_seen(Seen?, M?, Q?, Old),
    parts_of1(Old?, M?, Ms?, All?, Q?, Id?, Seen?, Pts).
procedure parts_of1(YesNo?, Mate?, Mates?, Mates?, Peers?, Peer?, Mates?, Parts).
parts_of1(yes, _, Ms, All, Q, Id, Seen, Pts?) :- parts_of(Ms?, All?, Q?, Id?, Seen?, Pts).
parts_of1(no, mate(N, B, G, F), Ms, All, Q, Id, Seen, [pt(T?, G?, Op?)|Pts?]) :-
    ground(N?), ground(B?), ground(G?), ground(F?), ground(All?), ground(Q?), ground(Id?) |
    class_of(N?, B?, Id?, T),
    part_firsts(All?, mate(N?, B?, G?, F?), Q?, Fs),
    part_gfirsts(All?, mate(N?, B?, G?, F?), Q?, G?, Fo),
    part_opener(G?, Fs?, Fo?, Op),
    parts_of(Ms?, All?, Q?, Id?, [mate(N?, B?, G?, F?)|Seen?], Pts).
procedure part_seen(Mates?, Mate?, Peers?, YesNo).
part_seen([], _, _, no).
part_seen([S|Ss], M, Q, B?) :- ground(M?), ground(Q?) |
    same_mpart(Q?, S?, M?, B1),
    part_seen1(B1?, Ss?, M?, Q?, B).
procedure part_seen1(YesNo?, Mates?, Mate?, Peers?, YesNo).
part_seen1(yes, _, _, _, yes).
part_seen1(no, Ss, M, Q, B?) :- part_seen(Ss?, M?, Q?, B).
%% The people in the first role of the schema-bindings of All that determine the part of M.
procedure part_firsts(Mates?, Mate?, Peers?, Peers).
part_firsts([], _, _, []).
part_firsts([mate(N, B, G, F)|Ms], M, Q, Fs?) :- ground(F?), ground(M?), ground(Q?) |
    same_mpart(Q?, mate(N?, B?, G?, F?), M?, S),
    part_firsts(Ms?, M?, Q?, Fs1),
    keep_peer(S?, F?, Fs1?, Fs).
%% The people in the first role of the schema-bindings of All that determine the part of M, of a schema with a listed role whose base is not a guarding role, and that are not guards of the part, G (vGLP a890465, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications").
procedure part_gfirsts(Mates?, Mate?, Peers?, Peers?, Peers).
part_gfirsts([], _, _, _, []).
part_gfirsts([mate(N, B, G1, F)|Ms], M, Q, G, Fs?) :- ground(N?), ground(F?), ground(M?), ground(Q?), ground(G?) |
    same_mpart(Q?, mate(N?, B?, G1?, F?), M?, S),
    opens_guarded(N?, O),
    mem(F?, G?, InG),
    neg(InG?, NotG),
    and(S?, O?, S1),
    and(S1?, NotG?, K),
    part_gfirsts(Ms?, M?, Q?, G?, Fs1),
    keep_peer(K?, F?, Fs1?, Fs).
%% Whether a schema is one with a listed role whose base is not a guarding role: its listed roles have one base (local.glp), its first role.
procedure opens_guarded(Constant?, YesNo).
opens_guarded(Nm, B?) :- schema_entry(Nm?, E), opens_guarded1(E?, B).
procedure opens_guarded1(Schema?, YesNo).
opens_guarded1(schema(_, _, _), no).
opens_guarded1(lschema(_, _, _, []), no).
opens_guarded1(lschema(_, _, Rs, [listing(_, Bi, _, _)|_]), B?) :- ground(Rs?), integer(Bi?) |
    nth_spec(Rs?, Bi?, R),
    spec_unguarded(R?, B).
procedure spec_unguarded(RoleSpec?, YesNo).
spec_unguarded(rs(unguarded, _, _, _, _), yes).
spec_unguarded(rs(guarded, _, _, _, _), no).
%% The opener of an unguarded part, from the people Fs in the first role of its schema-bindings, and of a guarded part, from those of Fo.
procedure part_opener(Peers?, Peers?, Peers?, Opener).
part_opener([], Fs, _, Op?) :- sort_peers(Fs?, Ss), least_opener(Ss?, Op).
part_opener([_|_], _, Fo, Op?) :- sort_peers(Fo?, Ss), least_opener(Ss?, Op).
%% A schema-binding is of its own part, so the people of an unguarded part are never none; a guarded part none of whose schema-bindings opens it has no opener, guarded_part.
procedure least_opener(Peers?, Opener).
least_opener([P|_], opener(P?)).
least_opener([], guarded_part).
%% Whether two schema-bindings of a class, each with the people it marks, determine one part.
procedure same_mpart(Peers?, Mate?, Mate?, YesNo).
same_mpart(Q, mate(N1, B1, G1, _), mate(N2, B2, G2, _), B?) :-
    same_bpart(Q?, N1?, B1?, G1?, N2?, B2?, G2?, B).

%% --- The class of a schema-binding: what a chain of links joins -----------
%% "The classes are those of the contract's equivalence, generated by relating two transactions when one schema-binding determines both" (vGLP 099f876, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications").  A schema-binding determines a transaction where its deleted and added atoms are disjoint at each participant and, at each, no atom is both required and forbidden and no atom of a reflexive predicate naming the participant is forbidden (live_at).  Two such schema-bindings of the same participants and the same atoms deleted and added at each determine a common transaction, and are linked, where no atom one requires at a participant the other forbids there (linked).  The contract being effective, every variable of an atom a schema requires or forbids is a variable of an atom it deletes or adds (local.glp), so matching the deleted and added atoms binds every variable of a schema-binding, and a variable left free, cmp_free, is never met: the clauses on it cover the type.  The class of a schema-binding is the schema-bindings a chain of links joins to it (class_mates); one that determines a transaction is of the class of an entry exactly when it is linked to one of the entry's schema-bindings (in_class).  The entry's parts are taken over it, the domain of each part being that of its schema-binding (part_dom).

%% in_class(Rs, B, Ps, Ps1, Q, Ms, R): whether the schema-binding of the role specifications Rs at the binding B, of the participants and atoms Ps, is of the class of an entry of the participants and atoms Ps1, the participants Q and the schema-bindings Ms.
procedure in_class(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Deltas?, Deltas?, Peers?, Mates?, YesNo).
in_class(Rs, B, Ps, Ps1, Q, Ms, R?) :-
    deltas_eq(Ps?, Ps1?, E),
    in_class1(E?, Rs?, B?, Q?, Ms?, R).
procedure in_class1(YesNo?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peers?, Mates?, YesNo).
in_class1(no, _, _, _, _, no).
in_class1(yes, Rs, B, Q, Ms, R?) :-
    reflexive_preds(Rf),
    linked_any(Ms?, Rs?, B?, Q?, Rf?, R).
procedure linked_any(Mates?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peers?, Preds?, YesNo).
linked_any([], _, _, _, _, no).
linked_any([mate(N, B2, _, _)|Ms], Rs, B, Q, Rf, L?) :-
    ground(Rs?), ground(B?), ground(B2?), ground(Q?), ground(Rf?) |
    bound_spec(N?, B2?, Rs2),
    linked(Q?, Rs?, B?, Rs2?, B2?, Rf?, L1),
    linked_any1(L1?, Ms?, Rs?, B?, Q?, Rf?, L).
procedure linked_any1(YesNo?, Mates?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peers?, Preds?, YesNo).
linked_any1(yes, _, _, _, _, _, yes).
linked_any1(no, Ms, Rs, B, Q, Rf, L?) :- linked_any(Ms?, Rs?, B?, Q?, Rf?, L).

%% class_mates(Nm, B, Ms, Q, Rf, Cls): the class of the schema-binding of the schema Nm at the binding B among the schema-bindings Ms of its participants Q and its atoms, those a chain of links joins to it, in the order of Ms.
procedure class_mates(Constant?, Binding?, Mates?, Peers?, Preds?, Mates).
class_mates(Nm, B, Ms, Q, Rf, Cls?) :- ground(Nm?), ground(B?), ground(Ms?) |
    bound_spec(Nm?, B?, Rs),
    mate_of(yes, B?, Nm?, Rs?, M0),
    grow(M0?, Ms?, Q?, Rf?, [], In),
    keep_mates(Ms?, In?, Cls).
%% grow(Front, Rest, Q, Rf, Done, Out): Out is Done, Front and every schema-binding of Rest that a chain through those of Front reaches; one of Front is moved to Done once those of Rest linked to it have joined Front.
procedure grow(Mates?, Mates?, Peers?, Preds?, Mates?, Mates).
grow([], _, _, _, Done, Done?).
grow([mate(N, B, G, F)|Fs], Rest, Q, Rf, Done, Out?) :-
    ground(N?), ground(B?), ground(Rest?), ground(Q?), ground(Rf?) |
    bound_spec(N?, B?, Rs),
    split_linked(Rest?, Rs?, B?, Q?, Rf?, New, Keep),
    app(Fs?, New?, Fs1),
    grow(Fs1?, Keep?, Q?, Rf?, [mate(N?, B?, G?, F?)|Done?], Out).
procedure split_linked(Mates?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peers?, Preds?, Mates, Mates).
split_linked([], _, _, _, _, [], []).
split_linked([mate(N2, B2, G2, F2)|Ms], Rs, B, Q, Rf, New?, Keep?) :-
    ground(N2?), ground(B2?), ground(Rs?), ground(B?), ground(Q?), ground(Rf?) |
    bound_spec(N2?, B2?, Rs2),
    linked(Q?, Rs?, B?, Rs2?, B2?, Rf?, L),
    split_linked(Ms?, Rs?, B?, Q?, Rf?, New1, Keep1),
    split_one(L?, mate(N2?, B2?, G2?, F2?), New1?, Keep1?, New, Keep).
procedure split_one(YesNo?, Mate?, Mates?, Mates?, Mates, Mates).
split_one(yes, M, New, Keep, [M?|New?], Keep?).
split_one(no, M, New, Keep, New?, [M?|Keep?]).
procedure keep_mates(Mates?, Mates?, Mates).
keep_mates([], _, []).
keep_mates([M|Ms], In, R?) :- ground(M?), ground(In?) |
    mem(M?, In?, B),
    keep_mates(Ms?, In?, R1),
    keep_mate(B?, M?, R1?, R).
procedure keep_mate(YesNo?, Mate?, Mates?, Mates).
keep_mate(yes, M, R, [M?|R?]).
keep_mate(no, _, R, R?).

%% The schema-bindings Ms of the participants Q that determine a transaction.
procedure live_mates(Mates?, Peers?, Preds?, Mates).
live_mates([], _, _, []).
live_mates([mate(N, B, G, F)|Ms], Q, Rf, R?) :- ground(N?), ground(B?), ground(Q?), ground(Rf?) |
    bound_spec(N?, B?, Rs),
    live_at(Q?, Rs?, B?, Rf?, L0),
    con_live(N?, B?, Lc),
    and(L0?, Lc?, L),
    live_mates(Ms?, Q?, Rf?, R1),
    keep_mate(L?, mate(N?, B?, G?, F?), R1?, R).

%% live_at(Q, Rs, B, Rf, Ok): at each participant of Q, no atom both required and forbidden, and no atom of a reflexive predicate naming the participant forbidden.
procedure live_at(Peers?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Preds?, YesNo).
live_at([], _, _, _, yes).
live_at([P|Ps], Rs, B, Rf, Ok?) :- ground(P?), ground(Rs?), ground(B?), ground(Rf?) |
    reqs_at(Rs?, B?, P?, Rf?, R),
    forbs_at(Rs?, B?, P?, F),
    live_one(R?, F?, P?, Rf?, Ok1),
    live_at1(Ok1?, Ps?, Rs?, B?, Rf?, Ok).
procedure live_at1(YesNo?, Peers?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Preds?, YesNo).
live_at1(no, _, _, _, _, no).
live_at1(yes, Ps, Rs, B, Rf, Ok?) :- live_at(Ps?, Rs?, B?, Rf?, Ok).
procedure live_one(CAtoms?, CAtoms?, Peer?, Preds?, YesNo).
live_one(R, F, P, Rf, Ok?) :- ground(F?) |
    ms_meets(R?, F?, M1),
    own_reflexive_in(F?, P?, Rf?, M2),
    or(M1?, M2?, M),
    neg(M?, Ok).

%% linked(Q, Rs1, B1, Rs2, B2, Rf, L): whether two schema-bindings of the participants Q, of the same atoms deleted and added at each, are linked: no atom one requires at a participant the other forbids there.
procedure linked(Peers?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Preds?, YesNo).
linked([], _, _, _, _, _, yes).
linked([P|Ps], Rs1, B1, Rs2, B2, Rf, L?) :-
    ground(P?), ground(Rs1?), ground(B1?), ground(Rs2?), ground(B2?), ground(Rf?) |
    reqs_at(Rs1?, B1?, P?, Rf?, R1),
    reqs_at(Rs2?, B2?, P?, Rf?, R2),
    forbs_at(Rs1?, B1?, P?, F1),
    forbs_at(Rs2?, B2?, P?, F2),
    bound_cs(R1?, Rb1),
    bound_cs(R2?, Rb2),
    ms_meets(Rb1?, F2?, C1),
    ms_meets(Rb2?, F1?, C2),
    or(C1?, C2?, C),
    linked1(C?, Ps?, Rs1?, B1?, Rs2?, B2?, Rf?, L).
procedure linked1(YesNo?, Peers?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Preds?, YesNo).
linked1(yes, _, _, _, _, _, _, no).
linked1(no, Ps, Rs1, B1, Rs2, B2, Rf, L?) :- linked(Ps?, Rs1?, B1?, Rs2?, B2?, Rf?, L).

%% The atoms the roles sent to P require, less those of a reflexive predicate naming P, which hold at every person of that person (Section 5.4, the paragraph on act schemas); and those they forbid.
procedure reqs_at(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peer?, Preds?, CAtoms).
reqs_at(Rs, B, P, Rf, R?) :- ground(B?), ground(P?) |
    specs_at(Rs?, 1, B?, P?, RsP),
    reqs_of(RsP?, Q),
    cimg_atoms(Q?, B?, R0),
    drop_own_reflexive(R0?, P?, Rf?, R).
procedure forbs_at(RoleSpecs?, Binding?, Peer?, CAtoms).
forbs_at(Rs, B, P, F?) :- ground(B?) |
    specs_at(Rs?, 1, B?, P?, RsP),
    forbs_of(RsP?, Fs),
    cimg_atoms(Fs?, B?, F).
procedure forbs_of(RoleSpecs?, SAtoms).
forbs_of([], []).
forbs_of([R|Rs], F?) :- rs_forb(R?, F1), forbs_of(Rs?, F2), app(F1?, F2?, F).
procedure drop_own_reflexive(CAtoms?, Peer?, Preds?, CAtoms).
drop_own_reflexive([], _, _, []).
drop_own_reflexive([A|As], P, Rf, R?) :- ground(A?), ground(P?), ground(Rf?) |
    own_atom(A?, P?, Rf?, Own),
    drop_own_reflexive(As?, P?, Rf?, R1),
    keep_c(Own?, A?, R1?, R).
procedure own_reflexive_in(CAtoms?, Peer?, Preds?, YesNo).
own_reflexive_in([], _, _, no).
own_reflexive_in([A|As], P, Rf, B?) :- ground(P?), ground(Rf?) |
    own_atom(A?, P?, Rf?, B1),
    own_reflexive_in1(B1?, As?, P?, Rf?, B).
procedure own_reflexive_in1(YesNo?, CAtoms?, Peer?, Preds?, YesNo).
own_reflexive_in1(yes, _, _, _, yes).
own_reflexive_in1(no, As, P, Rf, B?) :- own_reflexive_in(As?, P?, Rf?, B).
%% An atom of a reflexive predicate naming P.
procedure own_atom(CAtom?, Peer?, Preds?, YesNo).
own_atom(cmp_atom(N, [cmp_val(p(Q))]), P, Rf, B?) :- Q? =?= P? | mem(N?, Rf?, B).
own_atom(_, _, _, no) :- otherwise | true.
procedure bound_cs(CAtoms?, CAtoms).
bound_cs([], []).
bound_cs([A|As], R?) :- ground(A?) |
    has_free(A?, Fr),
    bound_cs(As?, R1),
    keep_c(Fr?, A?, R1?, R).
procedure has_free(CAtom?, YesNo).
has_free(cmp_atom(_, Xs), B?) :- has_free1(Xs?, B).
procedure has_free1(CVals?, YesNo).
has_free1([], no).
has_free1([cmp_free(_)|_], yes).
has_free1([cmp_val(_)|Xs], B?) :- has_free1(Xs?, B).
%% keep_c(Drop?, A?, R?, R1): R with A in front, where A is not dropped.
procedure keep_c(YesNo?, CAtom?, CAtoms?, CAtoms).
keep_c(no, A, R, [A?|R?]).
keep_c(yes, _, R, R?).

%% The atoms of a schema-binding as compared (CAtom): a variable the binding leaves free stands for itself, cmp_free(V); a signed term sgn(y, i) for the speech act bound to y, signed by the person in role i (GSC, Definition "Binding").
procedure cimg_atoms(SAtoms?, Binding?, CAtoms).
cimg_atoms([], _, []).
cimg_atoms([A|As], B, Cs?) :- ground(B?) |
    cimg_one(A?, B?, C1),
    cimg_atoms(As?, B?, C2),
    app(C1?, C2?, Cs).
procedure cimg_one(SAtom?, Binding?, CAtoms).
cimg_one(atom(P, Vs), B, [cmp_atom(P?, Xs?)]) :- cimg_args(Vs?, B?, Xs).
cimg_one(times(V, A), B, Cs?) :- ground(B?) |
    num_of(V?, B?, K),
    cimg_one(A?, B?, C1),
    copies(K?, C1?, Cs).
procedure cimg_args(Vars?, Binding?, CVals).
cimg_args([], _, []).
cimg_args([sgn(Y, I)|Vs], B, [X?|Xs?]) :- ground(B?), ground(Y?), ground(I?) |
    lookup(svar(Y?), B?, F),
    role_person(I?, B?, P),
    cimg_sgn(F?, P?, sgn(Y?, I?), X),
    cimg_args(Vs?, B?, Xs).
cimg_args([num(X)|Vs], B, [cmp_val(n(N?))|Xs?]) :- integer(X?) | N := X?, cimg_args(Vs?, B?, Xs).
cimg_args([nterm(N)|Vs], B, [X?|Xs?]) :- ground(B?), ground(N?) |
    nt_vars(N?, Ws),
    vars_bound(Ws?, B?, Bd),
    cimg_name(Bd?, N?, B?, X),
    cimg_args(Vs?, B?, Xs).
cimg_args([V|Vs], B, [X?|Xs?]) :- otherwise, ground(B?), ground(V?) |
    lookup(V?, B?, F),
    cimg_val(F?, V?, X),
    cimg_args(Vs?, B?, Xs).
procedure cimg_val(Found?, Var?, CVal).
cimg_val(found(X), _, cmp_val(X?)).
cimg_val(free, V, cmp_free(V?)).
procedure cimg_name(YesNo?, NTerm?, Binding?, CVal).
cimg_name(yes, N, B, cmp_val(c(C?))) :- nt_img(N?, B?, C).
cimg_name(no, N, _, cmp_free(nterm(N?))).
procedure cimg_sgn(Found?, Peer?, Var?, CVal).
