cimg_sgn(found(s(S)), P, _, cmp_val(s(speech(S?, P?)))).
cimg_sgn(_, _, V, cmp_free(V?)) :- otherwise | true.

%% ===========================================================================
%% Atoms, bindings and matching
%% ===========================================================================

%% The roles of a schema-binding, each with its atoms: those of the schema, and, for a schema with listed roles, each listed role's place bound to the base person with no atom, and one role more for each person of the list of each listed role, of that listed role's atoms, the roles after its own, the lists in the order of the roles.
procedure bound_spec(Constant?, Binding?, RoleSpecs).
bound_spec(Nm, B, Rs?) :- schema_entry(Nm?, E), bound_spec1(E?, B?, Rs).
procedure bound_spec1(Schema?, Binding?, RoleSpecs).
bound_spec1(schema(_, _, Rs), _, Rs?).
bound_spec1(lschema(_, _, Rs, Lsts), B, Rs1?) :- ground(Rs?), ground(B?), ground(Lsts?) |
    lists_of(Lsts?, B?, Ls),
    spec_for(Rs?, Lsts?, Ls?, Rs1).
%% The lists of the people of a schema-binding's listed roles, in the order of the roles.
procedure lists_of(Listings?, Binding?, PeerLists).
lists_of([], _, []).
lists_of([listing(I, _, _, _)|Lsts], B, [L?|Ls?]) :- ground(B?) |
    copies_of(B?, I?, L),
    lists_of(Lsts?, B?, Ls).
%% The roles of the schema, each listed role's place blanked, and then, for each listed role in the order of the roles, a copy of it for each person of its list.
procedure spec_for(RoleSpecs?, Listings?, PeerLists?, RoleSpecs).
spec_for(Rs, Lsts, Ls, Rs1?) :- ground(Rs?), ground(Lsts?) |
    blank_listed(Lsts?, Rs?, Rs0),
    listed_copies(Lsts?, Ls?, Rs?, Cs),
    app(Rs0?, Cs?, Rs1).
procedure blank_listed(Listings?, RoleSpecs?, RoleSpecs).
blank_listed([], Rs, Rs?).
blank_listed([listing(I, _, _, _)|Lsts], Rs, Rs2?) :-
    blank_at(Rs?, I?, 1, Rs1),
    blank_listed(Lsts?, Rs1?, Rs2).
procedure listed_copies(Listings?, PeerLists?, RoleSpecs?, RoleSpecs).
listed_copies([], _, _, []).
listed_copies([listing(I, _, _, _)|Lsts], [L|Ls], Rs, Cs?) :- ground(Rs?) |
    nth_spec(Rs?, I?, R),
    spec_copies(L?, R?, C1),
    listed_copies(Lsts?, Ls?, Rs?, C2),
    app(C1?, C2?, Cs).
listed_copies([_|_], [], _, []).
procedure blank_at(RoleSpecs?, Integer?, Integer?, RoleSpecs).
blank_at([], _, _, []).
blank_at([R|Rs], I, J, [X?|Xs?]) :- integer(I?), integer(J?) |
    blank_one(I?, J?, R?, X),
    J1 := J? + 1,
    blank_at(Rs?, I?, J1?, Xs).
procedure blank_one(Integer?, Integer?, RoleSpec?, RoleSpec).
blank_one(I, J, _, rs(unguarded, [], [], [], [])) :- I? =:= J? | true.
blank_one(_, _, R, R?) :- otherwise | true.
procedure spec_copies(Peers?, RoleSpec?, RoleSpecs).
spec_copies([], _, []).
spec_copies([_|Ps], R, [R?|Rs?]) :- ground(R?) | spec_copies(Ps?, R?, Rs).
%% The people of the listed role of index I at a schema-binding B, those B binds to role(-I), in the order of identifiers, its place in the class term (class_of).
procedure copies_of(Binding?, Integer?, List(Peer)).
copies_of(B, I, L?) :- ground(B?), integer(I?) |
    NI := 0 - I?,
    neg_people(B?, NI?, Ps0),
    sort_peers(Ps0?, Ps1),
    dedup(Ps1?, L).
procedure neg_people(Binding?, Integer?, Peers).
neg_people([], _, []).
neg_people([b(role(J), p(Q))|Bs], NI, [Q?|Ps?]) :- J? =:= NI? | neg_people(Bs?, NI?, Ps).
neg_people([_|Bs], NI, Ps?) :- otherwise | neg_people(Bs?, NI?, Ps).
%% The binding of a class term of a schema with listed roles: the binding B0 of its other roles and its variables; each listed role's place bound to the base person; and, for the lists Ls of the people of the listed roles, in the order of the roles, a role after the schema's own for each person of each list, in the order of identifiers, and the entries naming the people of each listed role (tuple_binds).
procedure listed_binding(Constant?, Binding?, PeerLists?, Binding).
listed_binding(Nm, B0, Ls, B?) :- schema_entry(Nm?, E), listed_binding1(E?, B0?, Ls?, B).
procedure listed_binding1(Schema?, Binding?, PeerLists?, Binding).
listed_binding1(schema(_, _, _), B0, _, B0?).
listed_binding1(lschema(_, _, Rs, Lsts), B0, Ls, B?) :- ground(Rs?), ground(B0?), ground(Lsts?) |
    rs_len(Rs?, K),
    base_binds(Lsts?, B0?, Bb),
    sorted_lists(Ls?, Ls1),
    K1 := K? + 1,
    tuple_binds(Lsts?, Ls1?, K1?, Cs),
    app(Bb?, Cs?, Bc),
    app(B0?, Bc?, B).
%% Each listed role's place bound to its base person.
procedure base_binds(Listings?, Binding?, Binding).
base_binds([], _, []).
base_binds([listing(I, Bi, _, _)|Lsts], B0, [b(role(I?), p(P?))|Bs?]) :- ground(B0?) |
    role_person(Bi?, B0?, P),
    base_binds(Lsts?, B0?, Bs).
procedure sorted_lists(PeerLists?, PeerLists).
sorted_lists([], []).
sorted_lists([L|Ls], [L1?|Ls1?]) :-
    sort_peers(L?, L0),
    dedup(L0?, L1),
    sorted_lists(Ls?, Ls1).
%% For the lists Ls of the people of the listed roles Lsts, in the order of the roles: the roles of index J, J+1, ..., one for each person of each list, the first list first, and the entries b(role(-I), p(Q)) naming the people Q of the listed role of index I.
procedure tuple_binds(Listings?, PeerLists?, Integer?, Binding).
tuple_binds([], _, _, []).
tuple_binds([listing(I, _, _, _)|Lsts], [L|Ls], J, Bs?) :- ground(L?), integer(I?) |
    copy_binds(L?, J?, Cs, J1),
    NI := 0 - I?,
    neg_binds(L?, NI?, Ns),
    tuple_binds(Lsts?, Ls?, J1?, Bs1),
    app(Ns?, Bs1?, Bs2),
    app(Cs?, Bs2?, Bs).
tuple_binds([_|_], [], _, []).
procedure copy_binds(Peers?, Integer?, Binding, Integer).
copy_binds([], J, [], J?).
copy_binds([Q|Qs], J, [b(role(J?), p(Q?))|Bs?], J2?) :- integer(J?) | J1 := J? + 1, copy_binds(Qs?, J1?, Bs, J2).
procedure neg_binds(Peers?, Integer?, Binding).
neg_binds([], _, []).
neg_binds([Q|Qs], NI, [b(role(NI?), p(Q?))|Bs?]) :- integer(NI?) | neg_binds(Qs?, NI?, Bs).
%% The people of each listed role at the state S of its base person, in the order of the roles: the persons q with rho(q, u_2, ..., u_r) in S, u_2, ..., u_r as the binding B0 binds them, in the order of identifiers (vGLP c649c0d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications").
procedure listed_people(Constant?, Binding?, GAtoms?, PeerLists).
listed_people(Nm, B0, S, Ls?) :- schema_entry(Nm?, E), listed_people1(E?, B0?, S?, Ls).
procedure listed_people1(Schema?, Binding?, GAtoms?, PeerLists).
listed_people1(schema(_, _, _), _, _, []).
listed_people1(lschema(_, _, _, Lsts), B0, S, Ls?) :- lists_at(Lsts?, B0?, S?, Ls).
procedure lists_at(Listings?, Binding?, GAtoms?, PeerLists).
lists_at([], _, _, []).
lists_at([listing(_, _, Rho, As)|Lsts], B0, S, [L?|Ls?]) :- ground(B0?), ground(S?) |
    list_at(Rho?, As?, B0?, S?, L),
    lists_at(Lsts?, B0?, S?, Ls).
procedure list_at(Constant?, Vars?, Binding?, GAtoms?, List(Peer)).
list_at(Rho, As, B0, S, L?) :- ground(As?), ground(B0?), ground(S?) |
    img_args(As?, B0?, Vs),
    listing_in(S?, Rho?, Vs?, Ps0),
    sort_peers(Ps0?, Ps1),
    dedup(Ps1?, L).
procedure listing_in(GAtoms?, Constant?, Vals?, Peers).
listing_in([], _, _, []).
listing_in([g(F, [p(Q)|Xs])|Gs], Rho, Vs, Ps?) :- ground(F?), ground(Xs?), ground(Rho?), ground(Vs?) |
    same(F?, Rho?, E1),
    same(Xs?, Vs?, E2),
    and(E1?, E2?, E),
    listing_in(Gs?, Rho?, Vs?, Ps1),
    keep_peer(E?, Q?, Ps1?, Ps).
listing_in([_|Gs], Rho, Vs, Ps?) :- otherwise | listing_in(Gs?, Rho?, Vs?, Ps).
%% The class term a request name of a schema with listed roles names at an agent of the state S: the binding B0 of the name, and the people its state lists at the place of each listed role, "so the base agent of close completes L from its listed atoms" (vGLP #15 Cowork to Code, 2026-10-19 14:24 UTC, item 2), "the base agent filling in each from its own listed atoms" (vGLP #16 Cowork to Code, 2026-10-19 15:51 UTC).
procedure listed_class(Constant?, Binding?, GAtoms?, Class).
listed_class(Nm, B0, S, C?) :- ground(Nm?), ground(B0?) |
    listed_people(Nm?, B0?, S?, Ls),
    listed_binding(Nm?, B0?, Ls?, B),
    role_person(1, B0?, D),
    class_of(Nm?, B?, D?, C).
%% For the person p in the base of each listed role, the domain of the effect asks besides the atoms that "p lists in d_p exactly the people of that role in L" (vGLP c649c0d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications").
procedure listing_ok(Constant?, Binding?, Peer?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
listing_ok(Nm, B, Id, S, Ok?) :- schema_entry(Nm?, E), listing_ok1(E?, B?, Id?, S?, Ok).
procedure listing_ok1(Schema?, Binding?, Peer?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
listing_ok1(schema(_, _, _), _, _, _, yes).
listing_ok1(lschema(_, _, _, Lsts), B, Id, S, Ok?) :- listings_ok(Lsts?, B?, Id?, S?, Ok).
procedure listings_ok(Listings?, Binding?, Peer?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
listings_ok([], _, _, _, yes).
listings_ok([listing(I, Bi, Rho, As)|Lsts], B, Id, S, Ok?) :- ground(B?), ground(Id?), ground(S?) |
    role_person(Bi?, B?, P),
    same(P?, Id?, Base),
    listing_one(Base?, I?, Rho?, As?, B?, S?, Ok1),
    listings_ok1(Ok1?, Lsts?, B?, Id?, S?, Ok).
procedure listing_one(YesNo?, Integer?, Constant?, Vars?, Binding?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
listing_one(no, _, _, _, _, _, yes).
listing_one(yes, I, Rho, As, B, S, Ok?) :- ground(B?) |
    copies_of(B?, I?, L),
    list_at(Rho?, As?, B?, S?, L1),
    same(L?, L1?, Ok).
procedure listings_ok1(YesNo?, Listings?, Binding?, Peer?, GAtoms?, YesNo).
listings_ok1(no, _, _, _, _, no).
listings_ok1(yes, Lsts, B, Id, S, Ok?) :- listings_ok(Lsts?, B?, Id?, S?, Ok).
%% The roles Definition "Binding" constrains (rule_ok): the schema's own, each listed role's place with no atom, a listed role's people being no roles a binding sends to people.
procedure rule_spec_ok(Constant?, Binding?, YesNo).
rule_spec_ok(Nm, B, Ok?) :- schema_entry(Nm?, E), rule_spec(E?, Rs0), rule_ok(Rs0?, B?, Ok).
procedure rule_spec(Schema?, RoleSpecs).
rule_spec(schema(_, _, Rs), Rs?).
rule_spec(lschema(_, _, Rs, Lsts), Rs0?) :- blank_listed(Lsts?, Rs?, Rs0).
%% A class term's schema, its roles with their atoms and its binding.
procedure term_spec(Class?, Constant, RoleSpecs, Binding).
term_spec(C, Nm?, Rs?, B?) :- ground(C?) |
    binding_of(C?, Nm0, B0),
    term_spec1(Nm0?, B0?, Nm, Rs, B).
procedure term_spec1(Constant?, Binding?, Constant, RoleSpecs, Binding).
term_spec1(Nm0, B0, Nm0?, Rs?, B0?) :- ground(Nm0?), ground(B0?) | bound_spec(Nm0?, B0?, Rs).
procedure nth_spec(RoleSpecs?, Integer?, RoleSpec).
nth_spec([], _, rs(unguarded, [], [], [], [])).
nth_spec([R|_], I, R?) :- I? =:= 1 | true.
nth_spec([_|Rs], I, R?) :- I? > 1 | I1 := I? - 1, nth_spec(Rs?, I1?, R).
procedure rs_len(RoleSpecs?, Integer).
rs_len([], 0).
rs_len([_|Rs], N?) :- rs_len(Rs?, M), N := M? + 1.
procedure rs_add(RoleSpec?, SAtoms).
rs_add(rs(_, A, _, _, _), A?).
procedure rs_del(RoleSpec?, SAtoms).
rs_del(rs(_, _, D, _, _), D?).
procedure rs_req(RoleSpec?, SAtoms).
%% The atoms a role requires: those it keeps, and those it deletes but its cleared atoms, which it deletes and does not require (vGLP f8127b1, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications": "the act deletes every atom of the state that it matches, and requires none"; GSC 327e035, =(i) u -(i)).
rs_req(rs(_, _, D, K, _), R?) :- uncleared(D?, D1), app(K?, D1?, R).
procedure uncleared(SAtoms?, SAtoms).
uncleared([], []).
uncleared([A|As], R?) :- ground(A?) |
    s_cleared(A?, C),
    uncleared(As?, R1),
    keep_s(C?, A?, R1?, R).
procedure keep_s(YesNo?, SAtom?, SAtoms?, SAtoms).
keep_s(yes, _, R, R?).
keep_s(no, A, R, [A?|R?]).
procedure s_cleared(SAtom?, YesNo).
s_cleared(atom(_, Vs), C?) :- vars_wild(Vs?, C).
s_cleared(times(_, A), C?) :- s_cleared(A?, C).
procedure vars_wild(Vars?, YesNo).
vars_wild([], no).
vars_wild([any|_], yes).
vars_wild([nterm(N)|Vs], C?) :- snt_wild(N?, C1), vars_wild1(C1?, Vs?, C).
vars_wild([V|Vs], C?) :- otherwise, ground(V?) | vars_wild(Vs?, C).
procedure vars_wild1(YesNo?, Vars?, YesNo).
vars_wild1(yes, _, yes).
vars_wild1(no, Vs, C?) :- vars_wild(Vs?, C).
procedure snt_wild(NTerm?, YesNo).
snt_wild(own(_), no).
snt_wild(own_var(_), no).
snt_wild(ext(N, _), C?) :- snt_wild(N?, C).
snt_wild(ext_any(_), yes).
procedure rs_forb(RoleSpec?, SAtoms).
rs_forb(rs(_, _, _, _, F), F?).

procedure role_person(Integer?, Binding?, Peer).
role_person(I, B, P?) :- lookup(role(I?), B?, F), found_peer(F?, P).
procedure found_peer(Found?, Peer).
found_peer(found(p(P)), P?).
found_peer(found(s(_)), unbound).
found_peer(found(c(_)), unbound).
found_peer(found(n(_)), unbound).
found_peer(found(lv(_, _)), unbound).
found_peer(free, unbound).
found_peer(found(any), unbound).
procedure lookup(Var?, Binding?, Found).
lookup(_, [], free).
lookup(V, [b(W, X)|_], found(X?)) :- V? =?= W? | true.
lookup(V, [_|Bs], F?) :- otherwise | lookup(V?, Bs?, F).
%% The atoms under a binding, a multiplicity k giving k copies of its atom (vGLP 613ee8d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications": "a multiplicity k deleting or adding k copies"); a multiplicity no number is bound to, a variable a binding leaves free, gives one, and is met only where a class's atoms are matched (count_bind).
procedure img_atoms(SAtoms?, Binding?, GAtoms).
img_atoms([], _, []).
img_atoms([A|As], B, Gs?) :- ground(B?) |
    img_one(A?, B?, G1),
    img_atoms(As?, B?, G2),
    app(G1?, G2?, Gs).
procedure img_one(SAtom?, Binding?, GAtoms).
img_one(atom(P, Vs), B, [g(P?, Xs?)]) :- img_args(Vs?, B?, Xs).
img_one(times(V, A), B, Gs?) :- ground(B?) |
    num_of(V?, B?, K),
    img_one(A?, B?, G1),
    copies(K?, G1?, Gs).
procedure(X) copies(NumRes?, Stream(X)?, Stream(X)).
copies(num_is(K), G, Gs?) :- K? > 0, ground(G?) |
    K1 := K? - 1,
    copies(num_is(K1?), G?, Gs1),
    app(G?, Gs1?, Gs).
copies(num_is(K), _, []) :- K? =< 0 | true.
copies(no_num, G, G?).
procedure img_atom(SAtom?, Binding?, GAtom).
img_atom(atom(P, Vs), B, g(P?, Xs?)) :- img_args(Vs?, B?, Xs).
img_atom(times(_, A), B, G?) :- img_atom(A?, B?, G).
procedure img_args(Vars?, Binding?, Vals).
img_args([], _, []).
img_args([sgn(Y, I)|Vs], B, [X?|Xs?]) :- ground(B?), ground(Y?), ground(I?) |
    lookup(svar(Y?), B?, F),
    role_person(I?, B?, P),
    img_sgn(F?, P?, X),
    img_args(Vs?, B?, Xs).
img_args([nterm(N)|Vs], B, [c(C?)|Xs?]) :- ground(B?), ground(N?) |
    nt_img(N?, B?, C),
    img_args(Vs?, B?, Xs).
img_args([num(X)|Vs], B, [n(N?)|Xs?]) :- integer(X?) | N := X?, img_args(Vs?, B?, Xs).
%% The wildcard of a cleared atom is itself under a binding (GSC 327e035, Definition "Binding": beta(*) := *).
img_args([any|Vs], B, [any|Xs?]) :- img_args(Vs?, B?, Xs).
img_args([V|Vs], B, [X?|Xs?]) :- otherwise, ground(B?) |
    lookup(V?, B?, F),
    img_val(F?, X),
    img_args(Vs?, B?, Xs).
%% The community name a name term denotes at a binding (vGLP c649c0d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications").
procedure nt_img(NTerm?, Binding?, CName).
nt_img(own(I), B, community(P?)) :- role_person(I?, B?, P).
nt_img(own_var(X), B, community(P?)) :- val_peer(pvar(X?), B?, unbound, P).
nt_img(ext_any(N), B, dot_any(C?)) :- nt_img(N?, B?, C).
nt_img(ext(N, Y), B, dot(C?, S?)) :- ground(B?) |
    nt_img(N?, B?, C),
    val_speech(svar(Y?), B?, unbound, S).
%% The variables of a name term: its base, a role or an agent variable, and its speech-act variables; "a variable inside a name term counts" for effectiveness, as one inside a signed term does (vGLP c649c0d, Section 5.4).
procedure nt_vars(NTerm?, Vars).
nt_vars(own(I), [role(I?)]).
nt_vars(own_var(X), [pvar(X?)]).
nt_vars(ext(N, Y), Vs?) :- nt_vars(N?, Vs0), app(Vs0?, [svar(Y?)], Vs).
%% The wildcard of N.* is no variable.
nt_vars(ext_any(N), Vs?) :- nt_vars(N?, Vs).
%% The arguments with each name term taken as its variables.
procedure flat_names(Vars?, Vars).
flat_names([], []).
flat_names([nterm(N)|Vs], R?) :- nt_vars(N?, Ws), flat_names(Vs?, R1), app(Ws?, R1?, R).
flat_names([V|Vs], [V?|R?]) :- otherwise | flat_names(Vs?, R).
procedure img_val(Found?, Val).
img_val(found(X), X?).
img_val(free, p(unbound)).
%% The image of a signed term sgn(y, i): the speech act bound to y, signed by
%% the person in role i (GSC, Definition "Binding": beta(sgn(y, pi)) :=
%% (beta(y), beta(pi))).  A signed term occurs only in an added atom (GSC,
%% Definition "Act schema"), whose matching binds y to a speech act, so the
%% second clause, a free variable's image as img_val gives it, covers the type
%% and is never reached.
procedure img_sgn(Found?, Peer?, Val).
img_sgn(found(s(S)), P, s(speech(S?, P?))).
img_sgn(_, _, p(unbound)) :- otherwise | true.
procedure atom_bound(SAtom?, Binding?, YesNo).
atom_bound(atom(_, Vs), B, R?) :- vars_bound(Vs?, B?, R).
atom_bound(times(_, A), B, R?) :- atom_bound(A?, B?, R).
procedure vars_bound(Vars?, Binding?, YesNo).
vars_bound([], _, yes).
vars_bound([num(X)|Vs], B, R?) :- integer(X?) | vars_bound(Vs?, B?, R).
vars_bound([nterm(N)|Vs], B, R?) :- ground(N?) |
    nt_vars(N?, Ws),
    app(Ws?, Vs?, Vs1),
    vars_bound(Vs1?, B?, R).
vars_bound([V|Vs], B, R?) :- otherwise, ground(B?) |
    lookup(V?, B?, F),
    vars_bound1(F?, Vs?, B?, R).
procedure vars_bound1(Found?, Vars?, Binding?, YesNo).
vars_bound1(free, _, _, no).
vars_bound1(found(_), Vs, B, R?) :- vars_bound(Vs?, B?, R).

%% The bindings extending B under which every atom of As is one of Gs, each once: the copies of an atom in a state match it in one way, so equal bindings from equal atoms are one (vGLP, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications": "with the local variables bound by them in one way").
procedure match_all(SAtoms?, GAtoms?, Binding?, Bindings).
match_all([], _, B, [B?]).
match_all([A|As], Gs, B, R?) :- ground(Gs?) |
    match_into(A?, Gs?, B?, Bs0),
    dedup(Bs0?, Bs),
    match_all_each(Bs?, As?, Gs?, R).
procedure match_all_each(Bindings?, SAtoms?, GAtoms?, Bindings).
match_all_each([], _, _, []).
match_all_each([B|Bs], As, Gs, R?) :- ground(As?), ground(Gs?) |
    match_all(As?, Gs?, B?, R1),
    match_all_each(Bs?, As?, Gs?, R2),
    app(R1?, R2?, R).
procedure match_into(SAtom?, GAtoms?, Binding?, Bindings).
match_into(times(V, A), Gs, B, R?) :- ground(V?), ground(A?), ground(Gs?), ground(B?) |
    match_into(A?, Gs?, B?, Bs),
    count_bind(Bs?, V?, A?, Gs?, R).
match_into(_, [], _, []).
match_into(A, [G|Gs], B, R?) :- ground(A?), ground(B?) |
    match_atom(A?, G?, B?, M),
    match_into1(M?, A?, Gs?, B?, R).
procedure match_into1(Match?, SAtom?, GAtoms?, Binding?, Bindings).
match_into1(match(B1), A, Gs, B, [B1?|R?]) :- match_into(A?, Gs?, B?, R).
match_into1(nomatch, A, Gs, B, R?) :- match_into(A?, Gs?, B?, R).
procedure match_atom(SAtom?, GAtom?, Binding?, Match).
match_atom(atom(P, Vs), g(Q, Xs), B, R?) :- P? =?= Q? | match_args(Vs?, Xs?, B?, R).
match_atom(_, _, _, nomatch) :- otherwise | true.
procedure match_args(Vars?, Vals?, Binding?, Match).
match_args([], [], B, match(B?)).
match_args([], [_|_], _, nomatch).
match_args([_|_], [], _, nomatch).
%% A signed term sgn(y, i) matches a speech act whose utterance is a speech
%% act, y matching that speech act and role i its signer (GSC, Definition
%% "Binding": beta(sgn(y, pi)) := (beta(y), beta(pi))); an utterance signed
%% once, or a person, it does not match.
match_args([sgn(Y, I)|Vs], [X|Xs], B, R?) :- ground(Y?), ground(I?), ground(X?), ground(B?) |
    sgn_parts(X?, Ps),
    match_sgn(Ps?, Y?, I?, Vs?, Xs?, B?, R).
%% A name term matches a community name of its form, its base its person and each speech-act variable its speech act.
match_args([nterm(N)|Vs], [X|Xs], B, R?) :- ground(N?), ground(X?), ground(B?) |
    name_parts(N?, X?, Ps),
    match_name(Ps?, Vs?, Xs?, B?, R).
match_args([num(X)|Vs], [Y|Ys], B, R?) :- integer(X?), ground(Y?), ground(B?) |
    lit_val(X?, Y?, E),
    lit_then(E?, Vs?, Ys?, B?, R).
%% The wildcard of a cleared atom matches the wildcard of the image of a cleared atom, and nothing else, binding nothing: the deleted atoms of a class carry the images of the cleared atoms of its schema-bindings (joins), and a schema-binding found by matching them has the same cleared atoms.
match_args([any|Vs], [X|Xs], B, R?) :- ground(X?), ground(B?) |
    any_val(X?, E),
    lit_then(E?, Vs?, Xs?, B?, R).
match_args([V|Vs], [X|Xs], B, R?) :- otherwise, ground(V?), ground(X?), ground(B?) |
    lookup(V?, B?, F),
    kind_ok(V?, X?, K),
    match_one(F?, K?, V?, X?, Vs?, Xs?, B?, R).
%% A number in an atom of a schema matches that number.
procedure lit_val(Integer?, Val?, YesNo).
lit_val(X, n(K), yes) :- X? =:= K? | true.
lit_val(_, _, no) :- otherwise | true.
procedure any_val(Val?, YesNo).
any_val(any, yes).
any_val(_, no) :- otherwise | true.
procedure lit_then(YesNo?, Vars?, Vals?, Binding?, Match).
lit_then(yes, Vs, Ys, B, R?) :- match_args(Vs?, Ys?, B?, R).
lit_then(no, _, _, _, nomatch).
%% An atom with a multiplicity k matched with the atoms Gs: where no number is bound to k, k is bound to the number of copies of its atom in Gs, which are its copies there (count_g).
procedure count_bind(Bindings?, Var?, SAtom?, GAtoms?, Bindings).
count_bind([], _, _, _, []).
count_bind([B|Bs], V, A, Gs, [B1?|R?]) :- ground(B?), ground(V?), ground(A?), ground(Gs?) |
    num_of(V?, B?, K),
    count_bind1(K?, V?, A?, Gs?, B?, B1),
    count_bind(Bs?, V?, A?, Gs?, R).
procedure count_bind1(NumRes?, Var?, SAtom?, GAtoms?, Binding?, Binding).
count_bind1(num_is(_), _, _, _, B, B?).
count_bind1(no_num, V, A, Gs, B, [b(V?, n(N?))|B?]) :- ground(B?), ground(V?) |
    img_atom(A?, B?, G),
    count_g(G?, Gs?, N).
procedure count_g(GAtom?, GAtoms?, Integer).
count_g(_, [], 0).
count_g(G, [H|Hs], N?) :- G? =?= H? | count_g(G?, Hs?, M), N := M? + 1.
count_g(G, [_|Hs], N?) :- otherwise | count_g(G?, Hs?, N).
procedure name_parts(NTerm?, Val?, NameParts).
name_parts(N, c(C), Ps?) :- nt_parts(N?, C?, Ps).
name_parts(_, p(_), noparts).
name_parts(_, s(_), noparts).
name_parts(_, n(_), noparts).
name_parts(_, lv(_, _), noparts).
name_parts(_, any, noparts).
procedure nt_parts(NTerm?, CName?, NameParts).
nt_parts(own(I), community(P), parts([role(I?)], [p(P?)])).
nt_parts(own_var(X), community(P), parts([pvar(X?)], [p(P?)])).
nt_parts(ext(N, Y), dot(C, S), Ps?) :- nt_parts(N?, C?, Ps0), nt_more(Ps0?, Y?, S?, Ps).
%% N.* matches the image of N.*, dot_any(C), its wildcard binding nothing.
nt_parts(ext_any(N), dot_any(C), Ps?) :- nt_parts(N?, C?, Ps).
nt_parts(_, _, noparts) :- otherwise | true.
procedure nt_more(NameParts?, Constant?, Speech?, NameParts).
nt_more(parts(Vs, Xs), Y, S, parts(Vs1?, Xs1?)) :- app(Vs?, [svar(Y?)], Vs1), app(Xs?, [s(S?)], Xs1).
nt_more(noparts, _, _, noparts).
procedure match_name(NameParts?, Vars?, Vals?, Binding?, Match).
match_name(parts(Ws, Ys), Vs, Xs, B, R?) :- app(Ws?, Vs?, Vs1), app(Ys?, Xs?, Xs1), match_args(Vs1?, Xs1?, B?, R).
match_name(noparts, _, _, _, nomatch).
procedure sgn_parts(Val?, SgnParts).
sgn_parts(s(speech(speech(U, Q), P)), signed(s(speech(U?, Q?)), P?)).
sgn_parts(s(speech(utterance(_), _)), unsigned).
sgn_parts(p(_), unsigned).
sgn_parts(c(_), unsigned).
sgn_parts(n(_), unsigned).
sgn_parts(lv(_, _), unsigned).
sgn_parts(any, unsigned).
procedure match_sgn(SgnParts?, Constant?, Integer?, Vars?, Vals?, Binding?, Match).
match_sgn(signed(S, P), Y, I, Vs, Xs, B, R?) :-
    match_args([svar(Y?), role(I?)|Vs?], [S?, p(P?)|Xs?], B?, R).
match_sgn(unsigned, _, _, _, _, _, nomatch).
procedure match_one(Found?, YesNo?, Var?, Val?, Vars?, Vals?, Binding?, Match).
match_one(found(W), _, _, X, Vs, Xs, B, R?) :- W? =?= X? | match_args(Vs?, Xs?, B?, R).
match_one(found(_), _, _, _, _, _, _, nomatch) :- otherwise | true.
match_one(free, yes, V, X, Vs, Xs, B, R?) :- match_args(Vs?, Xs?, [b(V?, X?)|B?], R).
match_one(free, no, _, _, _, _, _, nomatch).
procedure kind_ok(Var?, Val?, YesNo).
kind_ok(role(_), p(_), yes).
kind_ok(role(_), s(_), no).
kind_ok(pvar(_), p(_), yes).
kind_ok(pvar(_), s(_), no).
kind_ok(svar(_), p(_), no).
kind_ok(svar(_), s(_), yes).
%% A signed term is matched by its parts (match_sgn); the clauses cover the type.
kind_ok(sgn(_, _), p(_), no).
kind_ok(sgn(_, _), s(_), no).
%% A name term is matched by its parts (match_name), and a community name matches no variable; the clauses cover the type.
kind_ok(sgn(_, _), c(_), no).
kind_ok(nterm(_), _, no).
kind_ok(role(_), c(_), no).
kind_ok(pvar(_), c(_), no).
kind_ok(svar(_), c(_), no).
%% A numeric variable matches a number, and lv(S, X), which a schema-binding gives a variable local to a role (local_norm); and nothing else matches either.
kind_ok(num(_), n(_), yes).
kind_ok(num(_), lv(_, _), yes).
kind_ok(num(_), p(_), no).
kind_ok(num(_), s(_), no).
kind_ok(num(_), c(_), no).
kind_ok(role(_), n(_), no).
kind_ok(role(_), lv(_, _), no).
kind_ok(pvar(_), n(_), no).
kind_ok(pvar(_), lv(_, _), no).
kind_ok(svar(_), n(_), no).
kind_ok(svar(_), lv(_, _), no).
kind_ok(sgn(_, _), n(_), no).
kind_ok(sgn(_, _), lv(_, _), no).
%% The wildcard is matched by match_args, and matches no variable; the clauses cover the types.
kind_ok(any, _, no).
kind_ok(V, any, no) :- ground(V?) | true.

%% The value a binding gives a variable, the agent's own name for one it
%% leaves free.
procedure val_peer(Var?, Binding?, Peer?, Peer).
val_peer(V, B, D, P?) :- lookup(V?, B?, F), val_peer1(F?, D?, P).
procedure val_peer1(Found?, Peer?, Peer).
val_peer1(found(p(P)), _, P?).
val_peer1(found(s(_)), D, D?).
val_peer1(found(c(_)), D, D?).
val_peer1(found(n(_)), D, D?).
val_peer1(found(lv(_, _)), D, D?).
val_peer1(free, D, D?).
val_peer1(found(any), D, D?).
procedure val_speech(Var?, Binding?, Peer?, Speech).
val_speech(V, B, D, S?) :- lookup(V?, B?, F), val_speech1(F?, D?, S).
procedure val_speech1(Found?, Peer?, Speech).
val_speech1(found(s(S)), _, S?).
val_speech1(found(p(_)), D, speech(utterance(none), D?)).
val_speech1(found(c(_)), D, speech(utterance(none), D?)).
val_speech1(found(n(_)), D, speech(utterance(none), D?)).
val_speech1(found(lv(_, _)), D, speech(utterance(none), D?)).
val_speech1(free, D, speech(utterance(none), D?)).
val_speech1(found(any), D, speech(utterance(none), D?)).

%% ===========================================================================
%% Numbers (vGLP 613ee8d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications")
%% ===========================================================================

%% The number a binding gives a numeric argument: the number itself, n(K) bound to the variable, or none.
procedure num_of(Var?, Binding?, NumRes).
num_of(num(X), _, num_is(N?)) :- integer(X?) | N := X?.
num_of(V, B, R?) :- otherwise, ground(B?) | lookup(V?, B?, F), num_found(F?, R).
procedure num_found(Found?, NumRes).
num_found(found(n(K)), num_is(K?)).
num_found(found(p(_)), no_num).
num_found(found(s(_)), no_num).
num_found(found(c(_)), no_num).
num_found(found(lv(_, _)), no_num).
num_found(free, no_num).
num_found(found(any), no_num).
%% The number of a numeric variable of a class term, written in the term (class_of); 0 where none is bound, which a schema-binding of a class never leaves.
procedure val_num(Var?, Binding?, Integer).
val_num(V, B, K?) :- num_of(V?, B?, R), num_val(R?, K).
procedure num_val(NumRes?, Integer).
num_val(num_is(K), K?).
num_val(no_num, 0).
%% Whether the constraint holds under the binding, every number it names bound: and(C1, C2), C1 and C2; eq(X, Y), X = Y; le(X, Y), X =< Y; lt(X, Y), X < Y; ge(X, Y), X >= Y; gt(X, Y), X > Y; succ(X, Y), Y = X + 1; or(C1, C2), C1 or C2, X and Y the values of the expressions under the binding.  A number not bound makes a comparison false.
procedure con_holds(Constraint?, Binding?, YesNo).
con_holds(true, _, yes).
con_holds(and(C1, C2), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | con_holds(C1?, B?, R1), con_holds(C2?, B?, R2), and(R1?, R2?, R).
con_holds(eq(X, Y), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | expr_val(X?, B?, A), expr_val(Y?, B?, C), num_eq(A?, C?, R).
con_holds(le(X, Y), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | expr_val(X?, B?, A), expr_val(Y?, B?, C), num_le(A?, C?, R).
con_holds(lt(X, Y), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | expr_val(X?, B?, A), expr_val(Y?, B?, C), num_gt(C?, A?, R).
con_holds(ge(X, Y), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | expr_val(X?, B?, A), expr_val(Y?, B?, C), num_le(C?, A?, R).
con_holds(gt(X, Y), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | expr_val(X?, B?, A), expr_val(Y?, B?, C), num_gt(A?, C?, R).
con_holds(succ(X, Y), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | num_of(X?, B?, A), num_of(Y?, B?, C), num_succ(A?, C?, R).
con_holds(or(C1, C2), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | con_holds(C1?, B?, R1), con_holds(C2?, B?, R2), or(R1?, R2?, R).
%% A signing condition, evaluated at the binding: signed(U, Y) holds where the person the binding gives U is the signer of the speech act it gives Y or of a speech act inside it, and unsigned(U, Y) where that person is not (GSC 10fcc92, def:numbers: "signed(u, y) holding when beta(u) is the signer of beta(y) or of a speech act inside it and unsigned(u, y) otherwise"; vGLP dd37d2a, Section 5.4).  A person or a speech act not bound makes either false, as a number not bound makes a comparison false.
con_holds(signed(U, Y), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | lookup(U?, B?, P), lookup(Y?, B?, S), signing(P?, S?, yes, R).
con_holds(unsigned(U, Y), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | lookup(U?, B?, P), lookup(Y?, B?, S), signing(P?, S?, no, R).
procedure signing(Found?, Found?, YesNo?, YesNo).
signing(found(p(P)), found(s(S)), W, R?) :- ground(S?) | signed_by(P?, S?, G), same(G?, W?, R).
signing(_, _, _, no) :- otherwise | true.
%% Whether the person P signed the speech act or a speech act inside it.
procedure signed_by(Peer?, Utterance?, YesNo).
signed_by(P, speech(_, Q), yes) :- P? =?= Q? | true.
signed_by(P, speech(U, _), R?) :- otherwise | signed_by(P?, U?, R).
signed_by(_, utterance(_), no).
%% The value of an expression under the binding, num_is(K), or no_num where a number it names is not bound.
procedure expr_val(Expr?, Binding?, NumRes).
expr_val(plus(X, Y), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | expr_val(X?, B?, A), expr_val(Y?, B?, C), num_op(plus, A?, C?, R).
expr_val(minus(X, Y), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | expr_val(X?, B?, A), expr_val(Y?, B?, C), num_op(minus, A?, C?, R).
expr_val(mul(X, Y), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | expr_val(X?, B?, A), expr_val(Y?, B?, C), num_op(mul, A?, C?, R).
expr_val(num(X), B, R?) :- ground(B?) | num_of(num(X?), B?, R).
expr_val(role(_), _, no_num).
expr_val(pvar(_), _, no_num).
expr_val(svar(_), _, no_num).
expr_val(sgn(_, _), _, no_num).
expr_val(nterm(_), _, no_num).
%% The wildcard of a cleared atom is in no constraint (GSC 327e035); the clause covers the type.
expr_val(any, _, no_num).
procedure num_op(Constant?, NumRes?, NumRes?, NumRes).
num_op(plus, num_is(A), num_is(C), num_is(K?)) :- integer(A?), integer(C?) | K := A? + C?.
num_op(minus, num_is(A), num_is(C), num_is(K?)) :- integer(A?), integer(C?) | K := A? - C?.
num_op(mul, num_is(A), num_is(C), num_is(K?)) :- integer(A?), integer(C?) | K := A? * C?.
num_op(_, _, _, no_num) :- otherwise | true.
procedure num_eq(NumRes?, NumRes?, YesNo).
num_eq(num_is(A), num_is(C), yes) :- A? =:= C? | true.
num_eq(_, _, no) :- otherwise | true.
procedure num_gt(NumRes?, NumRes?, YesNo).
num_gt(num_is(A), num_is(C), yes) :- A? > C? | true.
num_gt(_, _, no) :- otherwise | true.
procedure num_le(NumRes?, NumRes?, YesNo).
num_le(num_is(A), num_is(C), yes) :- A? =< C? | true.
num_le(_, _, no) :- otherwise | true.
procedure num_succ(NumRes?, NumRes?, YesNo).
num_succ(num_is(A), num_is(C), R?) :- integer(A?), integer(C?) | A1 := A? + 1, same_int(A1?, C?, R).
num_succ(_, _, no) :- otherwise | true.
%% The constraint the agent Id checks for the schema-binding B: "a constraint is local to the role whose local variables it names, and to every role where it names none, which each checks" (vGLP 613ee8d, Section 5.4, "Act schemas as local specifications"): the constraint where it is local to every role, or to a role sent to Id, and true otherwise.
procedure con_at(Constant?, Binding?, Peer?, Constraint).
con_at(Nm, B, Id, C?) :- ground(Nm?), ground(B?) |
    schema_numeric(Nm?, N),
    con_at0(N?, B?, Id?, C).
procedure con_at0(Numeric?, Binding?, Peer?, Constraint).
con_at0(numeric(C, _, every), _, _, C?).
con_at0(numeric(C, _, at(I)), B, Id, C1?) :- ground(B?) |
    role_person(I?, B?, P),
    same(P?, Id?, Me),
    con_if(Me?, C?, C1).
procedure con_if(YesNo?, Constraint?, Constraint).
con_if(yes, C, C?).
con_if(no, _, true).
%% Whether the schema-binding B can hold its constraint: where the constraint names no variable local to a role, every number it names is bound by B, and it holds under B or the schema-binding determines no transaction; where it names some, a state binds them, and that is asked of the state (dom_bindings).
procedure con_live(Constant?, Binding?, YesNo).
con_live(Nm, B, V?) :- ground(Nm?) | schema_numeric(Nm?, N), con_live1(N?, B?, V).
procedure con_live1(Numeric?, Binding?, YesNo).
con_live1(numeric(C, _, every), B, V?) :- con_holds(C?, B?, V).
con_live1(numeric(_, _, at(_)), _, yes).
%% The binding less the values lv(S, X) of the variables local to a role, which the state binds (dom_bindings).
procedure unlocal(Binding?, Binding).
unlocal([], []).
unlocal([b(_, lv(_, _))|Bs], R?) :- unlocal(Bs?, R).
unlocal([E|Bs], [E?|R?]) :- otherwise | unlocal(Bs?, R).
%% The bindings extending B by the numbers the constraint gives the numeric variables B leaves free once those it binds are bound, taken again on each extension until it binds no variable more: succ(X, Y) gives Y = X + 1 where X is bound and Y not, and X = Y - 1 where Y is bound and X not; eq(X, Y) gives its one variable B leaves free, where it has one, the whole number at which the two expressions are equal, where there is one (eq_ext); and(C1, C2) the extensions by C1 of the extensions by C2; or(C1, C2) the extensions of each; true and the inequalities give none, B itself.
procedure con_extend(Constraint?, Binding?, Bindings).
con_extend(C, B, Bs?) :- ground(C?), ground(B?) | con_ext1(C?, B?, Bs1), con_again(Bs1?, C?, B?, Bs).
procedure con_again(Bindings?, Constraint?, Binding?, Bindings).
con_again([], _, _, []).
con_again([B1|Bs], C, B, R?) :- ground(B1?), ground(B?), ground(C?) |
    blen(B1?, N1),
    blen(B?, N),
    con_again1(N1?, N?, B1?, C?, R1),
    con_again(Bs?, C?, B?, R2),
    app(R1?, R2?, R).
procedure con_again1(Integer?, Integer?, Binding?, Constraint?, Bindings).
con_again1(N1, N, B1, C, R?) :- N1? > N? | con_extend(C?, B1?, R).
con_again1(_, _, B1, _, [B1?]) :- otherwise | true.
procedure blen(Binding?, Integer).
blen([], 0).
blen([_|Bs], N?) :- blen(Bs?, M), N := M? + 1.
procedure con_ext1(Constraint?, Binding?, Bindings).
con_ext1(true, B, [B?]).
con_ext1(and(C1, C2), B, Bs?) :- ground(B?) | con_ext1(C2?, B?, Bs2), ext_by(Bs2?, C1?, Bs).
con_ext1(eq(X, Y), B, Bs?) :- ground(X?), ground(Y?), ground(B?) | eq_ext(X?, Y?, B?, Bs).
con_ext1(le(_, _), B, [B?]).
con_ext1(lt(_, _), B, [B?]).
con_ext1(ge(_, _), B, [B?]).
con_ext1(gt(_, _), B, [B?]).
con_ext1(succ(X, Y), B, Bs?) :- ground(B?), ground(X?), ground(Y?) |
    num_of(X?, B?, A),
    num_of(Y?, B?, C),
    succ_ext(A?, C?, X?, Y?, B?, Bs).
con_ext1(signed(_, _), B, [B?]).
con_ext1(unsigned(_, _), B, [B?]).
con_ext1(or(C1, C2), B, Bs?) :- ground(B?) |
    con_ext1(C1?, B?, Bs1),
    con_ext1(C2?, B?, Bs2),
    app(Bs1?, Bs2?, Bs).
procedure ext_by(Bindings?, Constraint?, Bindings).
ext_by([], _, []).
ext_by([B|Bs], C, R?) :- ground(C?) | con_ext1(C?, B?, R1), ext_by(Bs?, C?, R2), app(R1?, R2?, R).
%% An equality of two linear expressions gives its one numeric variable V that the binding leaves free the number K at which X - Y is 0: with D0 and D1 the values of X - Y at V = 0 and at V = 1, K = -D0 / (D1 - D0), where D1 - D0 is not 0 and divides D0; otherwise it gives none.
procedure eq_ext(Expr?, Expr?, Binding?, Bindings).
eq_ext(X, Y, B, Bs?) :- ground(X?), ground(Y?), ground(B?) |
    expr_free(X?, B?, [], F1),
    expr_free(Y?, B?, F1?, F),
    eq_ext1(F?, X?, Y?, B?, Bs).
procedure eq_ext1(Vars?, Expr?, Expr?, Binding?, Bindings).
eq_ext1([V], X, Y, B, Bs?) :- ground(V?), ground(X?), ground(Y?), ground(B?) |
    expr_val(minus(X?, Y?), [b(V?, n(0))|B?], D0),
    expr_val(minus(X?, Y?), [b(V?, n(1))|B?], D1),
    eq_solve(D0?, D1?, V?, B?, Bs).
eq_ext1(_, _, _, B, [B?]) :- otherwise | true.
procedure eq_solve(NumRes?, NumRes?, Var?, Binding?, Bindings).
eq_solve(num_is(D0), num_is(D1), V, B, Bs?) :- integer(D0?), integer(D1?) |
    C := D1? - D0?,
    eq_solve1(C?, D0?, V?, B?, Bs).
eq_solve(_, _, _, B, [B?]) :- otherwise | true.
procedure eq_solve1(Integer?, Integer?, Var?, Binding?, Bindings).
eq_solve1(C, D0, V, B, [[b(V?, n(K?))|B?]]) :- C? =\= 0, D0? mod C? =:= 0 | K := (0 - D0?) // C?.
eq_solve1(_, _, _, B, [B?]) :- otherwise | true.
%% The numeric variables of an expression that the binding leaves free, each once, added to F0.
procedure expr_free(Expr?, Binding?, Vars?, Vars).
expr_free(plus(X, Y), B, F0, F?) :- ground(B?) | expr_free(X?, B?, F0?, F1), expr_free(Y?, B?, F1?, F).
expr_free(minus(X, Y), B, F0, F?) :- ground(B?) | expr_free(X?, B?, F0?, F1), expr_free(Y?, B?, F1?, F).
expr_free(mul(X, Y), B, F0, F?) :- ground(B?) | expr_free(X?, B?, F0?, F1), expr_free(Y?, B?, F1?, F).
expr_free(num(X), _, F0, F0?) :- integer(X?) | true.
expr_free(num(X), B, F0, F?) :- otherwise, ground(X?), ground(B?), ground(F0?) |
    num_of(num(X?), B?, R),
    leaf_free1(R?, num(X?), F0?, F).
expr_free(role(_), _, F0, F0?).
expr_free(pvar(_), _, F0, F0?).
expr_free(svar(_), _, F0, F0?).
expr_free(sgn(_, _), _, F0, F0?).
expr_free(nterm(_), _, F0, F0?).
expr_free(any, _, F0, F0?).
procedure leaf_free1(NumRes?, Var?, Vars?, Vars).
leaf_free1(num_is(_), _, F0, F0?).
leaf_free1(no_num, V, F0, F?) :- ground(V?), ground(F0?) | var_in(V?, F0?, In), add_var(In?, V?, F0?, F).
procedure var_in(Var?, Vars?, YesNo).
var_in(_, [], no).
var_in(V, [W|_], yes) :- V? =?= W? | true.
var_in(V, [_|Ws], R?) :- otherwise | var_in(V?, Ws?, R).
procedure add_var(YesNo?, Var?, Vars?, Vars).
add_var(yes, _, F0, F0?).
add_var(no, V, F0, [V?|F0?]).
procedure succ_ext(NumRes?, NumRes?, Var?, Var?, Binding?, Bindings).
succ_ext(num_is(A), no_num, _, Y, B, [[b(Y?, n(A1?))|B?]]) :- integer(A?) | A1 := A? + 1.
succ_ext(no_num, num_is(C), X, _, B, [[b(X?, n(C1?))|B?]]) :- integer(C?) | C1 := C? - 1.
succ_ext(_, _, _, _, B, [B?]) :- otherwise | true.
%% Whether the binding binds a number to every numeric variable of the schema's head, its variables local to a role apart, which the compiler leaves out of it.
procedure nums_bound(Constant?, Binding?, YesNo).
nums_bound(Nm, B, Ok?) :- ground(Nm?) | schema_entry(Nm?, E), schema_head(E?, Hd), hd_nums_bound(Hd?, B?, Ok).
procedure schema_head(Schema?, Vars).
schema_head(schema(_, Hd, _), Hd?).
schema_head(lschema(_, Hd, _, _), Hd?).
procedure hd_nums_bound(Vars?, Binding?, YesNo).
hd_nums_bound([], _, yes).
hd_nums_bound([num(X)|Vs], B, Ok?) :- ground(X?), ground(B?) |
    num_of(num(X?), B?, K),
    is_num(K?, O1),
    hd_nums_bound(Vs?, B?, O2),
    and(O1?, O2?, Ok).
hd_nums_bound([_|Vs], B, Ok?) :- otherwise | hd_nums_bound(Vs?, B?, Ok).
procedure is_num(NumRes?, YesNo).
is_num(num_is(_), yes).
is_num(no_num, no).

%% The persons the agent knows, in the order of identifiers.
procedure st_known(St?, List(Key)).
st_known(st(_, _, _, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, _, _, _, _, _, _, _), Ks?) :- ground(Se?), ground(ISe?) |
    app(Se?, ISe?, Ps),
    known_sorted(Ps?, kn(Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?), Ks).
procedure known_sorted(Peers?, Kn?, List(Key)).
known_sorted(Ps, Kn, Ks?) :- ground(Ps?) |
    dedup(Ps?, Ps1),
    known_of(Ps1?, Kn?, K0),
    sort_peers(K0?, Ks).
procedure known_of(Peers?, Kn?, Peers).
known_of([], _, []).
known_of([P|Ps], Kn, Ks?) :- ground(P?), ground(Kn?) |
    known_kn(P?, Kn?, B),
    known_of(Ps?, Kn?, K1),
    keep_peer(B?, P?, K1?, Ks).
procedure keep_peer(YesNo?, Peer?, Peers?, Peers).
keep_peer(yes, P, Ks, [P?|Ks?]).
keep_peer(no, _, Ks, Ks?).

st_isent(st(_, _, _, _, _, ISe, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _), ISe?).

st_irecd(st(_, _, _, _, _, _, IRc, _, _, _, _, _, _, _), IRc?).

st_ix(st(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, Ix, _), Ix?).

set_ix(st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, Pd, Pr, Hd, _, Rq), Ix, st(Id?, Ap?, D?, Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?, W?, Ca?, Pd?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)).
procedure st_trie(St?, Trie).
st_trie(st(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, ix(Tr, _, _, _), _), Tr?).
procedure st_kn(St?, Kn).
st_kn(st(_, _, _, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, _, _, _, _, _, _, _), kn(Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?)).

st_view(st(Id, app(S, _, L, R), _, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, _, _, Pd, _, _, _, _), v(Id?, S?, L?, R?, Pd?, kn(Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?))).
procedure v_id(V?, Peer).
v_id(v(Id, _, _, _, _, _), Id?).

v_ms(v(_, S, _, _, _, _), S?).

v_kn(v(_, _, _, _, _, Kn), Kn?).
procedure set_app(St?, App?, St).
set_app(st(Id, _, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, Pd, Pr, Hd, Ix, Rq), Ap, st(Id?, Ap?, D?, Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?, W?, Ca?, Pd?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)).
procedure set_waits(St?, Waits?, St).
set_waits(st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, _, Ca, Pd, Pr, Hd, Ix, Rq), W, st(Id?, Ap?, D?, Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?, W?, Ca?, Pd?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)).

st_made(st(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, Pr, _, _, _), Pr?).
procedure set_made(St?, Rhos?, St).
set_made(st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, Pd, _, Hd, Ix, Rq), Pr, st(Id?, Ap?, D?, Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?, W?, Ca?, Pd?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)).
procedure st_held(St?, Helds).
st_held(st(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, Hd, _, _), Hd?).
procedure set_held(St?, Helds?, St).
set_held(st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, Pd, Pr, _, Ix, Rq), Hd, st(Id?, Ap?, D?, Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?, W?, Ca?, Pd?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)).
%% The requests of its person the agent holds while it is not free for their classes (vGLP, Section 5.4, "The compilation": "where the agent is not free for a class of such a Request, it holds the request and puts it up again after every dispatch").
procedure st_reqs(St?, Proposals).
st_reqs(st(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, Rq), Rq?).
procedure set_reqs(St?, Proposals?, St).
set_reqs(st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, Pd, Pr, Hd, Ix, _), Rq, st(Id?, Ap?, D?, Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?, W?, Ca?, Pd?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)).

set_pends(st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, _, Pr, Hd, Ix, Rq), Pd, st(Id?, Ap?, D?, Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?, W?, Ca?, Pd?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)).
%% A start held waiting, once: added where not held already; and dropped.
procedure add_pend_once(Pend?, St?, St).
add_pend_once(X, st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, Pd, Pr, Hd, Ix, Rq),
        st(Id?, Ap?, D?, Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?, W?, Ca?, Pd1?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)) :-
    ground(X?), ground(Pd?) |
    mem(X?, Pd?, In),
    add_pend1(In?, X?, Pd?, Pd1).
procedure add_pend1(YesNo?, Pend?, Pends?, Pends).
add_pend1(yes, _, Pd, Pd?).
add_pend1(no, X, Pd, Pd1?) :- app(Pd?, [X?], Pd1).
procedure drop_pend(Pend?, St?, St).
drop_pend(X, st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, Pd, Pr, Hd, Ix, Rq),
        st(Id?, Ap?, D?, Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?, W?, Ca?, Pd1?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)) :-
    remove_all(X?, Pd?, Pd1).
procedure add_sent(Peer?, St?, St).
add_sent(Q, st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, Pd, Pr, Hd, Ix, Rq),
        st(Id?, Ap?, D?, [Q?|Se?], Rc?, ISe?, IRc?, W?, Ca?, Pd?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)).
procedure add_isent(Peer?, St?, St).
add_isent(Q, st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, Pd, Pr, Hd, Ix, Rq),
        st(Id?, Ap?, D?, Se?, Rc?, [Q?|ISe?], IRc?, W?, Ca?, Pd?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)).
procedure add_irecd(Peer?, St?, St).
add_irecd(P, st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, Pd, Pr, Hd, Ix, Rq),
        st(Id?, Ap?, D?, Se?, Rc?, ISe?, [P?|IRc?], W?, Ca?, Pd?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)).
procedure add_recd(Peer?, St?, St).
add_recd(P, st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, Pd, Pr, Hd, Ix, Rq),
        st(Id?, Ap?, D?, Se?, [P?|Rc?], ISe?, IRc?, W?, Ca?, Pd?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)).
procedure advance(St?, St).
advance(st(Id, Ap, D, Se, Rc, ISe, IRc, W, Ca, Pd, Pr, Hd, Ix, Rq), st(Id?, Ap?, D1?, Se?, Rc?, ISe?, IRc?, W?, Ca?, Pd?, Pr?, Hd?, Ix?, Rq?)) :-
    D1 := D? + 1.

app_recs(app(_, _, _, R), R?).

app_count(app(_, K, _, _), K?).
procedure app_state(App?, GAtoms).
app_state(app(S, _, _, _), S?).

attempt_id(attempt(I, _, _, _, _), I?).

attempt_k(attempt(_, K, _, _, _), K?).

attempt_rank(attempt(_, _, P, _, _), P?).

attempt_class(attempt(_, _, _, C, _), C?).

attempt_names(attempt(_, _, _, _, Nm), Nm?).

procedure and(YesNo?, YesNo?, YesNo).
and(yes, B, B?).
and(no, _, no).
procedure or(YesNo?, YesNo?, YesNo).
or(yes, _, yes).
or(no, B, B?).
procedure neg(YesNo?, YesNo).
neg(yes, no).
neg(no, yes).
procedure(X) same(X?, X?, YesNo).
same(P, Q, yes) :- P? =?= Q? | true.
same(_, _, no) :- otherwise | true.
procedure same_int(Integer?, Integer?, YesNo).
same_int(M, N, yes) :- M? =:= N? | true.
same_int(_, _, no) :- otherwise | true.

procedure sort_peers(Peers?, Peers).
sort_peers([], []).
sort_peers([P|Ps], S?) :- sort_peers(Ps?, S1), insert_peer(P?, S1?, S).
procedure insert_peer(Peer?, Peers?, Peers).
insert_peer(P, [], [P?]).
insert_peer(P, [Q|Qs], [P?, Q?|Qs?]) :- P? @< Q? | true.
insert_peer(P, [Q|Qs], [Q?|R?]) :- otherwise | insert_peer(P?, Qs?, R).

procedure(X) app(Stream(X)?, Stream(X)?, Stream(X)).
app([], Ys, Ys?).
app([X|Xs], Ys, [X?|Zs?]) :- app(Xs?, Ys?, Zs).
procedure(X) mem(X?, Stream(X)?, YesNo).
mem(_, [], no).
mem(X, [Y|_], yes) :- X? =?= Y? | true.
mem(X, [_|Ys], R?) :- otherwise | mem(X?, Ys?, R).
procedure(X) dedup(Stream(X)?, Stream(X)).
dedup([], []).
dedup([X|Xs], [X?|Ys?]) :- ground(X?) | remove_all(X?, Xs?, Xs1), dedup(Xs1?, Ys).
procedure(X) remove_all(X?, Stream(X)?, Stream(X)).
remove_all(_, [], []).
remove_all(X, [Y|Ys], Zs?) :- X? =?= Y? | remove_all(X?, Ys?, Zs).
remove_all(X, [Y|Ys], [Y?|Zs?]) :- otherwise | remove_all(X?, Ys?, Zs).
procedure(X) ms_remove(X?, Stream(X)?, YesNo, Stream(X)).
ms_remove(_, [], no, []).
ms_remove(X, [Y|Ys], yes, Ys?) :- X? =?= Y? | true.
ms_remove(X, [Y|Ys], F?, [Y?|Zs?]) :- otherwise | ms_remove(X?, Ys?, F, Zs).
procedure(X) ms_diff(Stream(X)?, Stream(X)?, Stream(X)).
ms_diff(A, [], A?).
ms_diff(A, [X|Xs], C?) :- ms_remove(X?, A?, _, A1), ms_diff(A1?, Xs?, C).
procedure(X) ms_sub(Stream(X)?, Stream(X)?, YesNo).
ms_sub([], _, yes).
ms_sub([X|Xs], B, R?) :- ms_remove(X?, B?, F, B1), ms_sub1(F?, Xs?, B1?, R).
procedure(X) ms_sub1(YesNo?, Stream(X)?, Stream(X)?, YesNo).
ms_sub1(no, _, _, no).
ms_sub1(yes, Xs, B, R?) :- ms_sub(Xs?, B?, R).
procedure(X) ms_eq(Stream(X)?, Stream(X)?, YesNo).
ms_eq(A, B, R?) :- ground(A?), ground(B?) |
    ms_sub(A?, B?, R1),
    ms_sub(B?, A?, R2),
    and(R1?, R2?, R).
procedure(X) ms_join(Stream(X)?, Stream(X)?, Stream(X)).
ms_join(A, B, C?) :- ground(A?) | ms_diff(B?, A?, D), app(A?, D?, C).
procedure(X) ms_meets(Stream(X)?, Stream(X)?, YesNo).
ms_meets([], _, no).
ms_meets([X|Xs], B, R?) :- ground(B?) | mem(X?, B?, R1), ms_meets1(R1?, Xs?, B?, R).
procedure(X) ms_meets1(YesNo?, Stream(X)?, Stream(X)?, YesNo).
ms_meets1(yes, _, _, yes).
ms_meets1(no, Xs, B, R?) :- ms_meets(Xs?, B?, R).
files.self.glp:
%% The live harness of the canonical CVA platform of GSN (platform.vglp,
%% as cascade.sh prints it): four persons, alice, bob, carol and dave, in one
%% heap, their networks joined; the host (the live server) is every person.
%% Generated by gen_harness.py; the types are the platform's, copied.

Class ::=
establish(Peer)
;
acquaint(Peer, Peer)
;
introduce(Peer, Peer, Peer)
;
befriend(Peer, Peer)
;
unfriend(Peer, Peer)
;
message(Peer, Peer, Speech)
;
create(Peer, Speech)
;
join(Peer, Peer, Speech)
;
leave(Peer, Peer, Speech)
;
remove(Peer, Peer, Speech)
;
close(Peer, List(Peer), Speech)
;
post_own(Peer, Speech, Speech)
;
post(Peer, Peer, Speech, Speech)
;
deliver(Peer, Peer, Speech, Speech)
.
Proposal ::=
establish(Peer)
;
acquaint(Peer, Peer)
;
introduce(Peer, Peer, Peer)
;
befriend(Peer, Peer)
;
unfriend(Peer, Peer)
;
message(Peer, Peer, Speech)
;
create(Peer, Speech)
;
join(Peer, Peer, Speech)
;
leave(Peer, Peer, Speech)
;
remove(Peer, Peer, Speech)
;
close(Peer, Speech)
;
post_own(Peer, Speech, Speech)
;
post(Peer, Peer, Speech, Speech)
.
Request ::= propose(Proposal).
Atom ::=
identity
;
knows(Peer)
;
friend(Peer)
;
received(Speech, Peer)
;
member(CName)
;
listed(Peer, Speech)
;
closed(Speech)
;
posted(Speech, Speech)
;
delivered(Speech, Peer, Speech)
;
received_in(Speech, Peer, Speech)
.
Speech    ::= speech(Utterance, Peer).
Utterance ::= utterance(String) ; Speech.
YesNo     ::= yes ; no.
Reason    ::= declined ; unable ; unable(List(Atom), List(Atom)).
Vote      ::= yes ; no(Reason).
Decision  ::= commit ; abort(Peer, Reason) ; yield.
Rho       ::= one(Class) ; rho(Proposal).
Names     ::= none ; request(Rho, Integer).
Attempt   ::= attempt(Peer, Integer, Integer, Class, Names).
Cargo     ::= start(Attempt) ; vote(Attempt, Vote) ; outcome(Attempt, Decision)
            ; yield(Attempt) ; request(Rho, Integer).
Content   ::= hello(Peer, Proposal) ; ihello(Peer) ; intro(Peer, Peer) ; cargo(Peer, Cargo).
Net       ::= msg(Peer, Content).
Asking    ::= Attempt ; hello(Peer, Proposal).
Approval  ::= approval(Asking, List(Word), YesNo?).
Word      ::= text(String) ; person(Peer) ; named(String, Peer) ; valued(String, Integer).
Menu      ::= menu(Key, List(Key), Request?).
CName     ::= community(Peer) ; dot(CName, Speech) ; dot_any(CName).
Approved  ::= Proposal.
Output    ::= view(List(Atom), List(Key), List(Approved), List(Tab)) ; refused(Approved, Key, Reason).
Tab       ::= tab(String, Constant) ; tab(String, Constant, Constant).

Question ::= menu_w(Menu) ; approval_w(Approval).
Drawn    ::= menu_w(_) ; approval_w(_) ; output(List(Output)) ; Request ; YesNo.
Ask(Q)   ::= ask(Constant, Q).
HostIn   ::= [_ | HostIn].

imported procedure platform#agent(Peer?, Stream(Net)?, Stream(Net), Stream(Output), Stream(Ask(Question))).
imported procedure platform#dispatch(Stream(Ask(Question))?,
    PersonChannel(Drawn)?, Channel(Stream(Input(Drawn)), Stream(Output))).

%% The agent's initial goal, every agent's, agent(ch(_?,_),ch(_?,_)) (IGLP,
%% Implementation Notes, "Boot"): the host's acts are the first channel's
%% input, and the harness writes to the person itself, by send_to_user/1.
%% The host's first act says which agent this is: me(Person), one person
%% alone, whose network is the agent's (live_person/3); or world, the four
%% persons, their networks joined inside it (live_ui/1).
exported procedure agent(Channel(HostIn, Stream(Constant))?, Channel(Stream(Net), Stream(Net))?).
agent(ch(Ins, []), ch(N, [])) :- start(Ins?, N?).

procedure start(HostIn?, Stream(Net)?).
start([me(P) | Ins], N) :- ground(P?) | live_person(P?, Ins?, N?).
start([world | Ins], _) :- live_ui(Ins?).

procedure live_ui(HostIn?).
live_ui(Ins) :-
    split4(Ins?, GA, GB, GC, GD),
    platform # agent(alice, InA?, OutA, TA, AsA),
    platform # dispatch(AsA?, ch(GA?, DA), MA),
    to_person(MA?, TA?),
    tag(alice, DA?, SA),
    platform # agent(bob, InB?, OutB, TB, AsB),
    platform # dispatch(AsB?, ch(GB?, DB), MB),
    to_person(MB?, TB?),
    tag(bob, DB?, SB),
    platform # agent(carol, InC?, OutC, TC, AsC),
    platform # dispatch(AsC?, ch(GC?, DC), MC),
    to_person(MC?, TC?),
    tag(carol, DC?, SC),
    platform # agent(dave, InD?, OutD, TD, AsD),
    platform # dispatch(AsD?, ch(GD?, DD), MD),
    to_person(MD?, TD?),
    tag(dave, DD?, SD),
    merge(OutA?, OutB?, Net1),
    merge(OutC?, OutD?, Net2),
    merge(Net1?, Net2?, Net),
    route4(Net?, alice, InA, bob, InB, carol, InC, dave, InD, N),
    tag_net(N?, SN),
    merge(SA?, SB?, S1),
    merge(SC?, SD?, S2),
    merge(S1?, S2?, S3),
    merge(S3?, SN?, S),
    send_to_user(S?).

procedure split4(HostIn?, PersonIn(Drawn), PersonIn(Drawn), PersonIn(Drawn), PersonIn(Drawn)).
split4([in(alice, G)|Ins], [G?|A?], B?, C?, D?) :- split4(Ins?, A, B, C, D).
split4([in(bob, G)|Ins], A?, [G?|B?], C?, D?) :- split4(Ins?, A, B, C, D).
split4([in(carol, G)|Ins], A?, B?, [G?|C?], D?) :- split4(Ins?, A, B, C, D).
split4([in(dave, G)|Ins], A?, B?, C?, [G?|D?]) :- split4(Ins?, A, B, C, D).
split4([_|Ins], A?, B?, C?, D?) :- otherwise | split4(Ins?, A, B, C, D).

procedure tag(Peer?, Stream(_)?, Stream(_)).
tag(N, [X|Xs], [d(N?, X?)|Ts?]) :- ground(N?) | tag(N?, Xs?, Ts).
tag(_, [], []).

procedure tag_net(Stream(_)?, Stream(_)).
tag_net([X|Xs], [net(X?)|Ts?]) :- tag_net(Xs?, Ts).
tag_net([], []).

procedure live_person(Peer?, HostIn?, Stream(Net)?).
live_person(P, Ins, NetIn) :- ground(P?) |
    split_person(Ins?, G),
    platform # agent(P?, NetIn?, Out, T, As),
    platform # dispatch(As?, ch(G?, D), M),
    to_person(M?, T?),
    tee_net(Out?, Net, L),
    send_to_net(Net?),
    tag(P?, D?, S),
    tag_net(L?, SN),
    merge(S?, SN?, S1),
    send_to_user(S1?).

procedure split_person(HostIn?, PersonIn(Drawn)).
split_person([g(G)|Ins], [G?|Gs?]) :- split_person(Ins?, Gs).
split_person([_|Ins], Gs?) :- otherwise | split_person(Ins?, Gs).

%% The agent's network output, passed on whole, each message noted as route4 notes it.
procedure tee_net(Stream(Net)?, Stream(Net), Stream(Sent(Cargo))).
tee_net([msg(To, M)|Ms], [msg(To?, M?)|Os?], Log?) :-
    ground(To?), ground(M?) |
    note(M?, To?, Log, Log1?),
    tee_net(Ms?, Os, Log1).
tee_net([], [], []).
